verses.sa:
उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे ।
अभि देवां इयक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
upasmai gayata narah pavamanayendave |
abhi devam iyakshate ||
verses.en: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who now is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods!

verses.sa:
अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः ।
देवं देवाय देवयु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi te madhuna payo'tharvano ashishrayuh |
devam devaya devayu ||
verses.en: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled. milk. Divine, God-loving, for the God.

verses.sa:
स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते ।
शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah pavasva sham gave sham janaya shamarvate |
sham rajannoshadhibhyah ||
verses.en: Bring health to cattle with thy flow, health to the people, health, to steeds, Health, O thou King, to growing plants!

verses.sa:
दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा ।
सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
davidyutatya rucha parishtobhantya kripa |
somah shukra gavashirah ||
verses.en: Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly, And form that shouteth all around.

verses.sa:
हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्हित आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् ।
सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
hinvano hetribhirhita a vajam vajyakramit |
sidanto vanusho yatha ||
verses.en: Roused by his drivers and sent forth, the strong Steed hath come: nigh for spoil, As warriors when they stand arrayed.

verses.sa:
ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवा कवे ।
पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
ridhaksoma svastaye samjagmano diva kave |
pavasva suryo drishe ||
verses.en: Specially, Soma, Sage, by day, coming together for our weal, Like Surya, flow for us to see!

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन्त्सर्गा असृक्षते ।
अर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya te kave vajintsarga asrikshate |
arvanto na shravasyavah ||
verses.en: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, mighty one, have poured them forth, Like coursers eager for renown.

verses.sa:
अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये ।
अवावशन्त धीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha kosham madhushchutamasrigram vare avyaye |
avavashanta dhitayah ||
verses.en: They have been poured upon the Reece towards the meath-distilling vat: The holy songs have rung aloud.

verses.sa:
अच्छा समुद्रमिन्दवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः ।
अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
achchha samudramindavo'stam gavo na dhenavah |
agmannritasya yonima ||
verses.en: Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake, Have reached the shrine of sacrifice

verses.sa:
अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये ।
नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
agna a yahi vitaye grinano havyadataye |
ni hota satsi barhishi ||
verses.en: Come, Agni, praised with song to feast and sacrificial offerings: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!

verses.sa:
तं त्वा समिद्भिरङ्गिरो घृतेन वर्धयामसि ।
बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva samidbhirangiro ghritena vardhayamasi |
brihachchhocha yavishthya ||
verses.en: So, Angiras, we make thee strong with fuel and with holy oil. Blaze high, thou youngest of the Gods!

verses.sa:
स नः पृथु श्रवाय्यमच्छा देव विवाससि ।
बृहदग्ने सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah prithu shravayyamachchha deva vivasasi |
brihadagne suviryam ||
verses.en: For us thou winnest, Agni, God, heroic strength exceeding great, Far-spreading and of high renown.

verses.sa:
आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतं ।
मध्वा रजांसि सुक्रतू ॥
verses.rom:
a no mitravaruna ghritairgavyutimukshatam |
madhva rajamsi sukratu ||
verses.en: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!

verses.sa:
उरुशंसा नमोवृधा मह्ना दक्षस्य राजथः ।
द्राघिष्ठाभिः शुचिव्रता ॥
verses.rom:
urushamsa namovridha mahna dakshasya rajathah |
draghishthabhih shuchivrata ||
verses.en: Gladdened by homage, ruling far, ye reign by majesty of might, Pure in your ways, for evermore.

verses.sa:
गृणाना जमदग्निना योनावृतस्य सीदतं ।
पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
grinana jamadagnina yonavritasya sidatam |
patam somamritavridha ||
verses.en: Lauded by Jamadagni's song, sit in the shrine of sacrifice: Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law!

verses.sa:
आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमं ।
एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
verses.rom:
a yahi sushuma hi ta indra somam piba imam |
edam barhih sado mama ||
verses.en: Come, we have pressed theJuice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass!

verses.sa:
आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना ।
उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
a tva brahmayuja hari vahatamindra keshina |
upa brahmani nah shrinu ||
verses.en: O Indra, let thy long-maned bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward! Give ear and listen to our prayers!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माणस्त्वा युजा वयं सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः ।
सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanastva yuja vayam somapamindra sominah |
sutavanto havamahe ||
verses.en: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यं ।
अस्य पातं धियेषिता ॥
verses.rom:
indragni a gatam sutam girbhirnabho varenyam |
asya patam dhiyeshita ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, moved by songs, come to the juice, the precious dew: Drink ye thereof, impelled by prayer!

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः ।
अया पातमिमं सुतं ॥
verses.rom:
indragni jarituh sacha yajno jigati chetanah |
aya patamimam sutam ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, with the man who lauds comes visible sacrifice: So drink ye both this flowing juice!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे ।
ता सोमस्येह तृम्पतां ॥
verses.rom:
indramagnim kavichchhada yajnasya jutya vrine |
ta somasyeha trimpatam ||
verses.en: With force of sacrifice I seek Indra, Agni who love the wise: With Soma let them sate them here!

verses.sa:
उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे ।
उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
uchcha te jatamandhaso divi sadbhumya dade |
ugram sharma mahi shravah ||
verses.en: High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Dread sheltering power and great renown.

verses.sa:
स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
वरिवोवित्परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
sa na indraya yajyave varunaya marudbhyah |
varivovitpari srava ||
verses.en: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuna and the Marut host!

verses.sa:
एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणां ।
सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ena vishvanyarya a dyumnani manushanam |
sishasanto vanamahe ||
verses.en: Striving to win, with him we gain all riches from the enemy, Yea, all the glories of mankind,

verses.sa:
पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि ।
आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देवो हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
punanah soma dharayapo vasano arshasi |
a ratnadha yonimritasya sidasyutso devo hiranyayah ||
verses.en: Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in watery robe. Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.

verses.sa:
दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नं सधस्थमासदत् ।
आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षसि नृभिर्धौतो विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
duhana udhardivyam madhu priyam pratnam sadhasthamasadat |
aprichchhyam dharunam vajyarshasi nribhirdhauto vichakshanah ||
verses.en: He, milking for dear meath the heavenly udder, hath sat in the ancient gathering-place. Washed by the men, far-sighted, strong, thou streamest to ther honourable reservoir.

verses.sa:
प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष ।
अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
pra tu drava pari kosham ni shida nribhih punano abhi vajamarsha |
ashvam na tva vajinam marjayanto'chchha barhi rashanabhirnayanti ||

verses.sa:
स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वृजना रक्षमाणः ।
पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
svayudhah pavate deva indurashastiha vrijana rakshamanah |
pita devanam janita sudaksho vishtambho divo dharunah prithivyah ||

verses.sa:
ऋषिर्विप्रः पुरएता जनानामृभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन ।
स चिद्विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्या३ं गुह्यं नाम गोनां ॥
verses.rom:
rishirviprah puraeta jananamribhurdhira ushana kavyena |
sa chidviveda nihitam yadasamapichya3m guhyam nama gonam ||

prose.en:
Run onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle. Making thee glossy like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.

Indu, the well-armed God is flowing onward, he who averts the curse and guards the homesteads. Father, begetter of the Gods, most skilful, the buttress of the heavens and earth's supporter.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः ।
ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva shura nonumo'dugdha iva dhenavah |
ishanamasya jagatah svardrishamishanamindra tasthushah ||
verses.en: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.

verses.sa:
न त्वावां अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते ।
अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
na tvavam anyo divyo na parthivo na jato na janishyate |
ashvayanto maghavannindra vajino gavyantastva havamahe ||
verses.en: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra Maghavan! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.

verses.sa:
कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा ।
कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥
verses.rom:
kaya nashchitra a bhuvaduti sadavridhah sakha |
kaya shachishthaya vrita ||
verses.en: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, everwaxing friend? With what most mighty company?

verses.sa:
कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः ।
दृढा चिदारुजे वसु ॥
verses.rom:
kastva satyo madanam mamhishtho matsadandhasah |
dridha chidaruje vasu ||
verses.en: What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e'en strongly-guarded wealth?

verses.sa:
अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् ।
शतं भवास्यूतये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shu nah sakhinamavita jaritrinam |
shatam bhavasyutaye ||
verses.en: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us!

verses.sa:
तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः ।
अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo dasmamritishaham vasormandanamandhasah |
abhi vatsam na svasareshu dhenava indram girbhirnavamahe ||
verses.en: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.

verses.sa:
द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसं ।
क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
dyuksham sudanum tavishibhiravritam girim na purubhojasam |
kshumantam vajam shatinam sahasrinam makshu gomantamimahe ||
verses.en: Celestial, bounteous giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in pleasant things,-- Him swift we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

verses.sa:
तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रं सबाध ऊतये ।
बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणं ॥
verses.rom:
tarobhirvo vidadvasumindram sabadha utaye |
brihadgayantah sutasome adhvare huve bharam na karinam ||
verses.en: Loud-singing at tbe sacred rite where Soma flows, we priests invoke. With haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher. Indra who findeth wealth for you.

verses.sa:
न यं दुध्रा वरन्ते न स्थिरा मुरो मदेषु शिप्रमन्धसः ।
य आदृत्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यं ॥
verses.rom:
na yam dudhra varante na sthira muro madeshu shipramandhasah |
ya adritya shashamanaya sunvate data jaritra ukthyam ||
verses.en: Whom, fair of cheek, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not: Giver of glorious wealth to him who sings his praise, honouring him who toils and pours.

verses.sa:
स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया ।
इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
svadishthaya madishthaya pavasva soma dharaya |
indraya patave sutah ||
verses.en: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink!

verses.sa:
रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहते ।
द्रोणे सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
rakshoha vishvacharshanirabhi yonimayohate |
drone sadhasthamasadat ||
verses.en: Fiend-queller, friend of all men, he hath reached his shrine, his dwelling-place. Within the iron-hammered vat.

verses.sa:
वरिवोधातमो भुवो मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः ।
पर्षि राधो मघोनां ॥
verses.rom:
varivodhatamo bhuvo mamhishtho vritrahantamah |
parshi radho maghonam ||
verses.en: Be thou best Vritra-slaver, best granter of room, most liberal: Promote our wealthy princes' gifts!

verses.sa:
पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः ।
महि द्युक्षतमो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva madhumattama indraya soma kratuvittamo madah |
mahi dyukshatamo madah ||
verses.en: For Indra flow, thou Soma, on, as most inspiring drink, most rich in sweets, Great, most Celestial, gladdening drink!

verses.sa:
यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीत्वा स्वर्विदः ।
स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te pitva vrishabho vrishayate'sya pitva svarvidah |
sa supraketo abhyakramidisho'chchha vajam naitashah ||
verses.en: Thou of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer: having drunk this that finds the light, He, excellently wise, hath come anear to food and booty, even as Etasa.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः ।
श्रुष्टे जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
indramachchha suta ime vrishanam yantu harayah |
shrushte jatasa indavah svarvidah ||
verses.en: To Indra, to the mighty let these golden-coloured juices go, Drops born as Law prescribes, that find the light of heaven!

verses.sa:
अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः ।
सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam bharaya sanasirindraya pavate sutah |
somo jaitrasya chetati yatha vide ||
verses.en: This juice that gathers spoil flows, pressed, for Indra, for his maintenance. Soma bethinks him of the conqueror, as he knows.

verses.sa:
अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णाति सानसिं ।
वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित् ॥
verses.rom:
asyedindro madeshva grabham gribhnati sanasim |
vajram cha vrishanam bharatsamapsujit ||
verses.en: Yea, Indra in the joys of this obtains the grasp that gathers spoil, And, winning waters, wields the mighty thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे ।
अप श्वानं श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यं ॥
verses.rom:
purojiti vo andhasah sutaya madayitnave |
apa shvanam shnathishtana sakhayo dirghajihvyam ||
verses.en: For first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink, Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away!

verses.sa:
यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः ।
इन्दुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yo dharaya pavakaya pariprasyandate sutah |
indurashvo na kritvyah ||
verses.en: He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward, Indu, is like an able steed.

verses.sa:
तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया ।
यज्ञाय सन्त्वद्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
tam duroshamabhi narah somam vishvachya dhiya |
yajnaya santvadrayah ||
verses.en: With prayer all-reaching let the men tend unassailable Soma: be- The stones prepared for sacrifice!

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते ।
आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priyani pavate chanohito namani yahvo adhi yeshu vardhate |
a suryasya brihato brihannadhi ratham vishvanchamaruhadvichakshanah ||
verses.en: Graciously- minded he is flowing on his way to win dear names o'er which the youthful one grows great. The mighty and far-seeing one hath mounted now the mighty Surya's car which moves to every side.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु प्रियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः ।
दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्या३ं नाम तृतीयमधि रोचनं दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya jihva pavate madhu priyam vakta patirdhiyo asya adabhyah |
dadhati putrah pitrorapichya3m nama tritiyamadhi rochanam divah ||
verses.en: The speaker, unassailable master of this prayer, the tongue of sacrifice, pours forth the pleasant meath. As son be sets the name of mother and of sire in the far distance, in the third bright realm of heaven.

verses.sa:
अव द्युतानः कलशां अचिक्रदन्नृभिर्येमाणः कोश आ हिरण्यये ।
अभी ऋतस्य दोहना अनूषताधि त्रिपृष्ठ उषसो वि राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
ava dyutanah kalasham achikradannribhiryemanah kosha a hiranyaye |
abhi ritasya dohana anushatadhi triprishtha ushaso vi rajasi ||
verses.en: Sending forth flashes he hath bellowed to the jars, led by the men into the golden reservoir. The milkers of the sacrifice have sung to him: Lord of three heights, thou shinest brightly o'er the Dawns.

verses.sa:
यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे ।
प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषं ॥
verses.rom:
yajnayajna vo agnaye giragira cha dakshase |
prapra vayamamritam jatavedasam priyam mitram na shamsisham ||
verses.en: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength! Come, let us praise the wise and everlasting God, even as a well-beloved friend:

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपातं स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये ।
भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनां ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napatam sa hinayamasmayurdashema havyadataye |
bhuvadvajeshvavita bhuvadvridha uta trata tanunam ||
verses.en: The Son of Strength; for is be not our gracious Lord? Let us serve him who bears our gifts! In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives!

verses.sa:
एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः ।
एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ehyu shu bravani te'gna itthetara girah |
ebhirvardhasa indubhih ||
verses.en: O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma drops!

verses.sa:
यत्र क्व च ते मनो दक्षं दधस उत्तरं ।
तत्रा योनिं कृणवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatra kva cha te mano daksham dadhasa uttaram |
tatra yonim krinavase ||
verses.en: Where'er thy mind applies itself, vigour preeminent hast thou: There wilt thou gain a dwelling-place.

verses.sa:
न हि ते पूर्तमक्षिपद्भुवन्नेमानां पते ।
अथा दुवो वनवसे ॥
verses.rom:
na hi te purtamakshipadbhuvannemanam pate |
atha duvo vanavase ||
verses.en: Not for a moment only lasts thy bounty, Lord of many men: Our service therefore shalt thou gain.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः ।
वज्रिञ्चित्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tvamapurvya sthuram na kachchidbharanto'vasyavah |
vajrinchitram havamahe ||
verses.en: We call on thee, O matchless one. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves. Call on thee, wondrous, thunder-armed:

verses.sa:
उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् ।
त्वामिध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिं ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva karmannutaye sa no yuvograshchakrama yo dhrishat |
tvamidhyavitaram vavrimahe sakhaya indra sanasim ||
verses.en: On thee for aid in sacrifice, This youth of ours, the bold, the terrible, bath gone forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, spoil winner, as our succourer.

verses.sa:
अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा काम ईमहे ससृग्महे ।
उदेव ग्मन्त उदभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hindra girvana upa tva kama imahe sasrigmahe |
udeva gmanta udabhih ||
verses.en: So, Indra, friend of song, do we draw near to thee with longing; we have streamed to thee Coming like floods that follow floods.

verses.sa:
वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि ।
ववृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
varna tva yavyabhirvardhanti shura brahmani |
vavridhvamsam chidadrivo divedive ||
verses.en: As rivers swell the ocean, so, hero, our prayers increase thy might, Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे वचोयुजा ।
इन्द्रवाहा स्वर्विदा ॥
verses.rom:
yunjanti hari ishirasya gathayorau ratha uruyuge vachoyuja |
indravaha svarvida ||
verses.en: With holy song they bind to the broad wide-yoked car the bay steeds of the quickening God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.

verses.sa:
पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत ।
विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनां ॥
verses.rom:
pantama vo andhasa indramabhi pra gayata |
vishvasaham shatakratum mamhishtham charshaninam ||
verses.en: Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live!

verses.sa:
पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्या३ं सनश्रुतं ।
इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥
verses.rom:
puruhutam purushtutam gathanya3m sanashrutam |
indra iti bravitana ||
verses.en: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song renowned of old: His name is Indra, tell it forth!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इन्नो महोनां दाता वाजानां नृतुः ।
महां अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥
verses.rom:
indra inno mahonam data vajanam nrituh |
maham abhijnva yamat ||
verses.en: Indra, the dancer, be to us the giver of abundant wealth: The mighty bring it us knee-deep!

verses.sa:
प्र व इन्द्राय मादनं हर्यश्वाय गायत ।
सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥
verses.rom:
pra va indraya madanam haryashvaya gayata |
sakhayah somapavne ||
verses.en: Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny steeds, The Soma-drinker, O my friends!

verses.sa:
शंसेदुक्थं सुदानव उत द्युक्षं यथ नरः ।
चकृमा सत्यराधसे ॥
verses.rom:
shamseduktham sudanava uta dyuksham yatha narah |
chakrima satyaradhase ||
verses.en: To him, the bounteous, say the laud, and let us glorify, as men May do, the giver of true gifts!

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र वाजयुस्त्वं गव्युः शतक्रतो ।
त्वं हिरण्ययुर्वसो ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra vajayustvam gavyuh shatakrato |
tvam hiranyayurvaso ||
verses.en: O Indra, Lord of boundless might, for us thou seekest spoil and kine, Thou seekest gold for us, good Lord!

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः ।
कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tva tadidartha indra tvayantah sakhayah |
kanva ukthebhirjarante ||
verses.en: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.

verses.sa:
न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ ।
तवेदु स्तोमैश्चिकेत ॥
verses.rom:
na ghemanyada papana vajrinnapaso navishtau |
tavedu stomaishchiketa ||
verses.en: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy; On thy laud only have I thought.

verses.sa:
इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति ।
यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः ॥
verses.rom:
ichchhanti devah sunvantam na svapnaya sprihayanti |
yanti pramadamatandrah ||
verses.en: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep: They punish sloth unweariedly

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः ।
अर्कमर्च्चन्तु कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya madvane sutam pari shtobhantu no girah |
arkamarchchantu karavah ||
verses.en: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः ।
इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvishva adhi shriyo rananti sapta samsadah |
indram sute havamahe ||
verses.en: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत ।
तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukeshu chetanam devaso yajnamatnata |
tamidvardhantu no girah ||
verses.en: At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it!

verses.sa:
अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि ।
एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
ayam ta indra somo niputo adhi barhishi |
ehimasya drava piba ||
verses.en: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof!

verses.sa:
शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः ।
आखण्डल प्र हूयसे ॥
verses.rom:
shachigo shachipujanayam ranaya te sutah |
akhandala pra huyase ||
verses.en: Strong-rayed! adored with earnest hymns! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Akhandala!

verses.sa:
यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो णपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः ।
न्यस्मिं दध्र आ मनः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste shringavrisho napatpranapatkundapayyah |
nyasmim dadhra a manah ||
verses.en: To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Sringavrish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय ।
महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indra kshumantam chitram grabham sam gribhaya |
mahahasti dakshinena ||
verses.en: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand, Manifold and nutritious spoil!

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघं ।
तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi tva tuvikurmim tuvideshnam tuvimagham |
tuvimatramavobhih ||
verses.en: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth. Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.

verses.sa:
न हि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तं ।
भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
na hi tva shura deva na martaso ditsantam |
bhimam na gam varayante ||
verses.en: Hero when thou wouldst give thy gifts, neither the Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful bull.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये ।
तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva vrishabha sute sutam srijami pitaye |
trimpa vyashnuhi madam ||
verses.en: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse!

verses.sa:
मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् ।
मा कीं ब्रह्मद्विषं वनः ॥
verses.rom:
ma tva mura avishyavo mopahasvana a dabhan |
ma kim brahmadvisham vanah ||
verses.en: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemy of prayer!

verses.sa:
इह त्वा गोपरीणसं महे मन्दन्तु राधसे ।
सरो गौरो यथा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
iha tva goparinasam mahe mandantu radhase |
saro gauro yatha piba ||
verses.en: Here let them cheer thee well supplied with milk to great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake!

verses.sa:
इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरं ।
अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥
verses.rom:
idam vaso sutamandhah piba supurnamudaram |
anabhayinrarima te ||
verses.en: Here is the Soma juice expressed: O Vasu, drink till thou art full! Undaunted God, we give it thee!

verses.sa:
नृभिर्धौतः सुतो अश्नैरव्या वारैः परिपूतः ।
अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु ॥
verses.rom:
nribhirdhautah suto ashnairavya varaih pariputah |
ashvo na nikto nadishu ||
verses.en: Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool, 'Tis like a courser bathed in streams.

verses.sa:
तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणन्तः ।
इन्द्र त्वास्मिंत्सधमादे ॥
verses.rom:
tam te yavam yatha gobhih svadumakarma shrinantah |
indra tvasmimtsadhamade ||
verses.en: This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk. Indra, I call thee to our feast.

verses.sa:
इदं ह्यन्वोजसा सुतं राधानां पते ।
पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
idam hyanvojasa sutam radhanam pate |
piba tva3sya girvanah ||
verses.en: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!

verses.sa:
यस्ते अनु स्वधामसत्सुते नि यच्छ तन्वं ।
स त्वा ममत्तु सोम्यं ॥
verses.rom:
yaste anu svadhamasatsute ni yachchha tanvam |
sa tva mamattu somyam ||
verses.en: Incline thy body to the juice which suits thy godlike nature well: Thee, Soma-lover! let it cheer!

verses.sa:
प्र ते अश्नोतु कुक्ष्योः प्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मणा शिरः ।
प्र बाहू शूर राधसा ॥
verses.rom:
pra te ashnotu kukshyoh prendra brahmana shirah |
pra bahu shura radhasa ||
verses.en: O Indra, let it enter both thy flanks, enter thy head with prayer, With bounty, hero! both thine arms!

verses.sa:
आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत ।
सखाय स्तोमवाहसः ॥
verses.rom:
a tveta ni shidatendramabhi pra gayata |
sakhaya stomavahasah ||
verses.en: O Come ye hither, sit ye down; to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise,

verses.sa:
पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणां ।
इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
verses.rom:
purutamam purunamishanam varyanam |
indram some sacha sute ||
verses.en: Laud Indra, richest of the rich, who ruleth over noblest wealth, Beside the flowing Soma juice!

verses.sa:
स घा नो योग आ भुवत्स राये स पुरन्ध्या ।
गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha no yoga a bhuvatsa raye sa purandhya |
gamadvajebhira sa nah ||
verses.en: May he stand near us in our need with all abundance, for our wealth: With strength may he come nigh to us!

verses.sa:
योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
yogeyoge tavastaram vajevaje havamahe |
sakhaya indramutaye ||
verses.en: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.

verses.sa:
अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरं ।
यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratim naram |
yam te purvam pita huve ||
verses.en: I call him, mighty to resist, the hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

verses.sa:
आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः ।
वाजेभिरुप नो हवं ॥
verses.rom:
a gha gamadyadi shravatsahasrinibhirutibhih |
vajebhirupa no havam ||
verses.en: If he will hear us, let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, With strength and riches, to our call!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीष उक्थ्यं ।
विदे वृधस्य दक्षस्य महां हि षः ॥
verses.rom:
indra suteshu someshu kratum punisha ukthyam |
vide vridhasya dakshasya maham hi shah ||
verses.en: When Somas flow thou makest pure, Indra, thy mind that merits laud, For gain of strength that ever grows: for great is he.

verses.sa:
स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः ।
सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥
verses.rom:
sa prathame vyomani devanam sadane vridhah |
suparah sushravastamah samapsujit ||
verses.en: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the waterfloods.

verses.sa:
तमु हुवे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणं ।
भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
tamu huve vajasataya indram bharaya shushminam |
bhava nah sumne antamah sakha vridhe ||
verses.en: Him I invoke, to win the spoil, even mighty Indra for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a friend to aid!

verses.sa:
एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे ।
प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतं ॥
verses.rom:
ena vo agnim namasorjo napatama huve |
priyam chetishthamaratim svadhvaram vishvasya dutamamritam ||
verses.en: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength. Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal, messenger of all.

verses.sa:
स योजते अरुषा विश्वभोजसा स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः ।
सुब्रह्मा यज्ञः सुशमी वसूनां देवं राधो जनानां ॥
verses.rom:
sa yojate arusha vishvabhojasa sa dudravatsvahutah |
subrahma yajnah sushami vasunam devam radho jananam ||
verses.en: His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast! Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, the heavenly gift of wealth to men.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यू३च्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः ।
अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी ॥
verses.rom:
pratyu adarshyayatyu3chchhanti duhita divah |
apo mahi vrinute chakshusha tamo jyotishkrinoti sunari ||
verses.en: Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.

verses.sa:
उदुस्रियाः सृजते सूर्यः सचा उद्यन्नक्षत्रमर्चिवत् ।
तवेदुषो व्युषि सूर्यस्य च सं भक्तेन गमेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
udusriyah srijate suryah sacha udyannakshatramarchivat |
tavedusho vyushi suryasya cha sam bhaktena gamemahi ||
verses.en: The Sun ascending, the refulgent star, pours down his beams. together with the Dawn. O Dawn, at thine arising, and, the Sun's, may we attain the share allotted us!

verses.sa:
इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना ।
अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशं हि गच्छथः ॥
verses.rom:
ima u vam divishtaya usra havante ashvina |
ayam vamahve'vase shachivasu vishamvisham hi gachchhathah ||
verses.en: These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.

verses.sa:
युवं चित्रं ददथुर्भोजनं नरा चोदेथां सूनृतावते ।
अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam chitram dadathurbhojanam nara chodetham sunritavate |
arvagratham samanasa ni yachchhatam pibatam somyam madhu ||
verses.en: Ye, heroes, have bestowed wonderful nourishment: send it to him whose songs are sweet. One-minded, both of you, drive your car down to us: drink yethe savoury Soma juice!

verses.sa:
अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः ।
पयः सहस्रसामृषिं ॥
verses.rom:
asya pratnamanu dyutam shukram duduhre ahrayah |
payah sahasrasamrishim ||
verses.en: After his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand spoils.

verses.sa:
अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति ।
सप्त प्रवत आ दिवं ॥
verses.rom:
ayam surya ivopadrigayam saramsi dhavati |
sapta pravata a divam ||
verses.en: In aspect he is like the Sun: he runneth forward to the lakes: Seven currents flowing to the sky.

verses.sa:
अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि ।
सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vishvani tishthati punano bhuvanopari |
somo devo na suryah ||
verses.en: He, while they purify him, stands high over all things that exist Soma, a God as Surya is.

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratnena janmana devo devebhyah sutah |
harih pavitre arshati ||
verses.en: By generation long ago this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining cloth.

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि ।
कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratnena manmana devo devebhyaspari |
kavirviprena vavridhe ||
verses.en: According to primeval plan this poet hath been strengthened by, The sage as God for all the Gods.

verses.sa:
दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यसे ।
क्रन्दं देवां अजीजनः ॥
verses.rom:
duhanah pratnamitpayah pavitre pari shichyase |
krandam devam ajijanah ||
verses.en: Shedding the ancient fiuid thou art poured into the cleansing sieve: Roaring, thou hast produced the Gods.

verses.sa:
उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रवे ।
पवमान विदा रयिं ॥
verses.rom:
upa shikshapatasthusho bhiyasama dhehi shatrave |
pavamana vida rayim ||
verses.en: Bring near us those who stand aloof: strike fear into our enemy: O Pavamana, find us wealth!

verses.sa:
उषो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतं ।
इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
usho shu jatamapturam gobhirbhangam parishkritam |
indum deva ayasishuh ||
verses.en: To him the active, nobly born.

verses.sa:
उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे ।
अभि देवां इयक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
upasmai gayata narah pavamanayendave |
abhi devam iyakshate ||
verses.en: Sing ye your songs to him, O men!

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपो नयन्त ऊर्मयः ।
वनानि महिषा इव ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaso vipashchito'po nayanta urmayah |
vanani mahisha iva ||
verses.en: The Somas skilled in song, the waves have led the water forward, like Buffaloes speeding to the woods.

verses.sa:
अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया ।
वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dronani babhravah shukra ritasya dharaya |
vajam gomantamaksharan ||
verses.en: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.

verses.sa:
सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
suta indraya vayave varunaya marudbhyah |
soma arshantu vishnave ||
verses.en: To Indra, Vayu. Varuna to Vishnu and the Maruts let The Soma juices flow expressed.

verses.sa:
प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा ।
अंशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.rom:
pra soma devavitaye sindhurna pipye arnasa |
amshoh payasa madiro na jagrivirachchha kosham madhushchutam ||
verses.en: O Soma, for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, Sweet with the liquor of the stalk, as one who wakes, into the vat that drops with meath.

verses.sa:
आ हर्यतो अर्जुनो अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः ।
तमीं हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
a haryato arjuno atke avyata priyah sunurna marjyah |
tamim hinvantyapaso yatha ratham nadishva gabhastyoh ||
verses.en: Like a dear son how must be decked, the bright and shining one hath clad him in his robe. Men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their hands.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनां ।
सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaso madachyutah shravase no maghonam |
suta vidathe akramuh ||
verses.en: The rapture-shedding Somas have flowed forth in our assembly, pressed. To glorify our liberal lords.

verses.sa:
आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिं ।
अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
adim hamso yatha ganam vishvasyavivashanmatim |
atyo na gobhirajyate ||
verses.en: Now like a swan hemaketh all the company sing each his hymm He like steed is bathed in milk.

verses.sa:
आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
adim tritasya yoshano harim hinvantyadribhih |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en: And Trita's maidens onward urge the tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
अया पवस्व देवयु रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः ।
मधोर्धारा असृक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
aya pavasva devayu rebhanpavitram paryeshi vishvatah |
madhordhara asrikshata ||
verses.en: Herewith flow on, thou friend of Gods! Singing, thou runnest round the sieve oni every side. The streams of meath have been effused.

verses.sa:
पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वरांसि रंह्या ।
अभ्यर्ष स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
pavate haryato harirati hvaramsi ramhya |
abhyarsha stotribhyo viravadyashah ||
verses.en: Lovely, gold-coloured, on he flows.

verses.sa:
प्र सुन्वानास्यान्धसो मर्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः ।
अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sunvanasyandhaso marto na vashta tadvachah |
apa shvanamaradhasam hata makham na bhrigavah ||
verses.en: For him who presses, of the juice.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः ।
अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vacho agriyah soma chitrabhirutibhih |
abhi vishvani kavya ||

verses.sa:
त्वं समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् ।
पवस्व विश्वचर्षणे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam samudriya apo'griyo vacha irayan |
pavasva vishvacharshane ||

verses.sa:
तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे ।
तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyema bhuvana kave mahimne soma tasthire |
tubhyam dhavanti dhenavah ||

prose.en:
Soma, as leader of the song, flow onward with thy wondrous aid. For holy lore of every sort!

Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, Flow onward, known to all mankind! 1 O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to enhance thy might: The milch-kine run for thy behoof.

verses.sa:
पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने ।
विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
pavasvendo vrisha sutah kridhi no yashaso jane |
vishva apa dvisho jahi ||
verses.en: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: Drive all our enernies away!

verses.sa:
यस्य ते सख्ये वयं सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ।
तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te sakhye vayam sasahyama pritanyatah |
tavendo dyumna uttame ||
verses.en: And in thy friendship, Indu, most sublime and glorious, may we Subdue all those who war with us!

verses.sa:
या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे ।
रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ॥
verses.rom:
ya te bhimanyayudha tigmani santi dhurvane |
raksha samasya no nidah ||
verses.en: Those awful weapons which thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-- Guard us therewith from every foe!

verses.sa:
वृषा सोम द्युमां असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः ।
वृषा धर्माणि दध्रिषे ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha soma dyumam asi vrisha deva vrishavratah |
vrisha dharmani dadhrishe ||
verses.en: O Soma, thou art strong and bright, potent, O God, with potent sway,

verses.sa:
वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वनं वृषा सुतः ।
स त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
verses.rom:
vrishnaste vrishnyam shavo vrisha vanam vrisha sutah |
sa tvam vrishanvrishedasi ||
verses.en: Steer-strong thy might is like a steer's, steer-strong the wood, steer-strong the juice: A steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.

verses.sa:
अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः ।
वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ashvo na chakrado vrisha sam ga indo samarvatah |
vi no raye duro vridhi ||
verses.en: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: Unbar for us the doors to wealth!

verses.sa:
वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे ।
पवमान स्वर्दृशं ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha hyasi bhanuna dyumantam tva havamahe |
pavamana svardrisham ||
verses.en: For thou art strong by splendour: we, O Pavamana call on thee, The brilliant looker on the light.

verses.sa:
यदद्भिः परिशिच्यसे मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः ।
द्रोणे सधस्थमश्नुषे ॥
verses.rom:
yadadbhih parishichyase marmrijyamana ayubhih |
drone sadhasthamashnushe ||
verses.en: When thou art sprinkled with the streams, thou reachest, purified by men, Thy dwelling in the wooden vat.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध ।
इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva suviryam mandamanah svayudha |
iho shvindava gahi ||
verses.en: Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength. O Indu, come thou hitherward!

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः ।
सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya te vayam pavitramabhyundatah |
sakhitvama vrinimahe ||
verses.en: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o'er The limit of the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया ।
तेभिर्नः सोम मृडय ॥
verses.rom:
ye te pavitramurmayo'bhiksharanti dharaya |
tebhirnah soma mridaya ||
verses.en: With those same waves which in their stream o'erflow the purifying sieve, Soma, be gracious unto us!

verses.sa:
स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम्
ईशानः सोम विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah punana a bhara rayim viravatimisham
ishanah soma vishvatah ||
verses.en: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides-for thou canst- Riches and food with hero sons!

verses.sa:
अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसं ।
अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dutam vrinimahe hotaram vishvavedasam |
asya yajnasya sukratum ||
verses.en: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिं ।
हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियं ॥
verses.rom:
agnimagnim havimabhih sada havanta vishpatim |
havyavaham purupriyam ||
verses.en: With constant calls they invocate Agni, Agni, Lord of the house, Oblation-bearer, much-beloved

verses.sa:
अग्ने देवां इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे ।
असि होता न ईड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agne devam iha vaha jajnano vriktabarhishe |
asi hota na idyah ||
verses.en: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who trims the Sacred grass: Thou art our Hotar, meet for praise!

verses.sa:
मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये ।
य जाता पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
mitram vayam havamahe varunam somapitaye |
ya jata putadakshasa ||
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna we call to drink the draught of Soma juice, Those born endowed with holy strength.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती ।
ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
ritena yavritavridhavritasya jyotishaspati |
ta mitravaruna huve ||
verses.en: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuna.

verses.sa:
वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
करतां नः सुराधसः ॥
verses.rom:
varunah pravita bhuvanmitro vishvabhirutibhih |
karatam nah suradhasah ||
verses.en: Let Varuna be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids, Both make us rich exceedingly!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः ।
इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
indramidgathino brihadindramarkebhirarkinah |
indram vaniranushata ||
verses.en: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा ।
इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
indra iddharyoh sacha sammishla a vachoyuja |
indro vajri hiranyayah ||
verses.en: Indra is close to his two bays, with chariot ready at his word, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च ।
उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra vajeshu no'va sahasrapradhaneshu cha |
ugra ugrabhirutibhih ||
verses.en: Help us in battles Indra, in battles where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful one!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद्दिवि ।
वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् ॥
verses.rom:
indro dirghaya chakshasa a suryam rohayaddivi |
vi gobhiradrimairayat ||
verses.en: Indra raised up the son aloft in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहत्सुवृक्तिमेरयामहे ।
धिया धेना अवस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
indre agna namo brihatsuvriktimerayamahe |
dhiya dhena avasyavah ||
verses.en: To Indra and to Agni we bring reverence high and holy hymn, And, craving help, soft words with prayer.

verses.sa:
ता हि शश्वन्त ईडत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये ।
सबाधो वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
ta hi shashvanta idata ittha viprasa utaye |
sabadho vajasataye ||
verses.en: For all these holy singers thus implore these twain to succour them, And priests that they may win them strength.

verses.sa:
ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्युवः प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे ।
मेधसाता सनिष्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam girbhirvipanyuvah prayasvanto havamahe |
medhasata sanishyavah ||
verses.en: Eager to laud you, we with songs invoke you, bearing sacred food, Fain for success in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः ।
विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha pavasva dharaya marutvate cha matsarah |
vishva dadhana ojasa ||
verses.en: Flow onward, mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the Marut's Lord, Winning all riches with thy power!

verses.sa:
तं त्वा धर्त्तारमोण्यो३ः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् ।
हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनं ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva dharttaramonyo3h pavamana svardrisham |
hinve vajeshu vajinam ||
verses.en: I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, strong, Sustainer, looker on the light!

verses.sa:
अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया ।
युजं वाजेषु चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
aya chitto vipanaya harih pavasva dharaya |
yujam vajeshu chodaya ||
verses.en: Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawnycoloured, with thy stream: Incite to battle thine ally!

verses.sa:
वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेषि पृथिवीमुत द्यां ।
इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचोदयन्नर्षसि वाचमेमां ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha shono abhikanikradadga nadayanneshi prithivimuta dyam |
indrasyeva vagnura shrinva ajau prachodayannarshasi vachamemam ||
verses.en: A Red Bull bellowing to the kine, thou goest, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder. A shout is heard like Indra's in the battle: thou flowest on, sending this voice before thee.

verses.sa:
रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमंशुं ।
पवमान सन्तनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
rasayyah payasa pinvamana irayanneshi madhumantamamshum |
pavamana santanimeshi krinvannindraya soma parishichyamanah ||
verses.en: Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet juices, urging the meathrich plant thou goest onward. Making loud clamour, Soma Pavamana, thou flowest when thou art effused for Indra.

verses.sa:
एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नुं ।
परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः ॥
verses.rom:
eva pavasva madiro madayodagrabhasya namayanvadhasnum |
pari varnam bharamano rushantam gavyurno arsha pari soma siktah ||
verses.en: So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, turning the weapon of the water's holder! Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine. O Soma!

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः ।
त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamiddhi havamahe satau vajasya karavah |
tvam vritreshvindra satpatim narastvam kashthasvarvatah ||
verses.en: That we may win us wealth and power we poets verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee

verses.sa:
स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया मह स्तवानो अद्रिवः ।
गामश्वं रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam nashchitra vajrahasta dhrishnuya maha stavano adrivah |
gamashvam rathyamindra sam kira satra vajam na jigyushe ||
verses.en: As such, O wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds, ever to be the conqueror's strength!

verses.sa:
अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे ।
यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra vah suradhasamindramarcha yatha vide |
yo jaritribhyo maghava puruvasuh sahasreneva shikshati ||
verses.en: To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts, as we I we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.

verses.sa:
शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे ।
गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः ॥
verses.rom:
shatanikeva pra jigati dhrishnuya hanti vritrani dashushe |
gireriva pra rasa asya pinvire datrani purubhojasah ||
verses.en: As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain fiow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.

verses.sa:
त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः ।
स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamida hyo naro'pipyanvajrinbhurnayah |
sa indra stomavahasa iha shrudhyupa svasarama gahi ||
verses.en: O Thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: So, Indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto our dwelling-place!

verses.sa:
मत्स्वा सुशिप्रिन्हरिवस्तमीमहे त्वया भूषन्ति वेधसः ।
तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्य सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
matsva sushiprinharivastamimahe tvaya bhushanti vedhasah |
tava shravamsyupamanyukthya suteshvindra girvanah ||
verses.en: Lord of bay steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: thee we seek. Here the disposers wait on thee. Thy glories, meet for praise! are highest by the juice, O Indra, lover of the song.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado varenyastena pavasvandhasa |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods!

verses.sa:
जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे ।
गोषातिरश्वसा असि ॥
verses.rom:
jaghnirvritramamitriyam sasnirvajam divedive |
goshatirashvasa asi ||
verses.en: Killing the foeman and his hate, and daily winning spoil and strength, Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.

verses.sa:
सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भुवः सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभि ।
सीदं च्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
sammishlo arusho bhuvah supasthabhirna dhenubhi |
sidam chchhyeno na yonima ||
verses.en: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, Falcon-like resting in thine home!

verses.sa:
अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ।
पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam pusha rayirbhagah somah punano arshati |
patirvishvasya bhumano vyakhyadrodasi ubhe ||
verses.en: As Pashan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure. He, Lord of all the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः ।
सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
samu priya anushata gavo madaya ghrishvayah |
somasah krinvate pathah pavamanasa indavah ||
verses.en: The dear cows sang in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink. The drops as they are purified, the Soma juices, make the paths.

verses.sa:
य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यं ।
यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya ojishthastama bhara pavamana shravayyam |
yah pancha charshanirabhi rayim yena vanamahe ||
verses.en: O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed, Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence!

verses.sa:
वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसां दिवः ।
प्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशां अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha matinam pavate vichakshanah somo ahnam prataritoshasam divah |
prana sindhunam kalasham achikradadindrasya hardyavishanmanishibhih ||
verses.en: Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the furtherer of days, of mornings, and of heaven. Breath of the rivers, he hath roared into the jars, and with the help of sages entered Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशां असिष्यदत् ।
त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरन्निन्द्रस्य वायूं सख्याय वर्धयन् ॥
verses.rom:
manishibhih pavate purvyah kavirnribhiryatah pari kosham asishyadat |
tritasya nama janayanmadhu ksharannindrasya vayum sakhyaya vardhayan ||
verses.en: On, with the sages, flows the poet on his way, and guided by the men, hath streamed into the vats. He, showing Trita's name, hath caused the meath to flow, increasing Vayu's strength to make him Indra's friend.

verses.sa:
अयं पुनान उषसो अरोचयदयं सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् ।
अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरं सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam punana ushaso arochayadayam sindhubhyo abhavadu lokakrit |
ayam trih sapta duduhana ashiram somo hride pavate charu matsarah ||
verses.en: He, being purified, hath made the mornings shine, and it is he who gave the rivers room to flow. Making the three-times seven pour out the milky stream, Soma, the cheerer, yields whate'er the heart finds sweet.

verses.sa:
एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः ।
एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
verses.rom:
eva hyasi virayureva shura uta sthirah |
eva te radhyam manah ||
verses.en: For so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thy heart be won us!

verses.sa:
एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः ।
अधा चिदिन्द्र नः सचा ॥
verses.rom:
eva ratistuvimagha vishvebhirdhayi dhatribhih |
adha chidindra nah sacha ||
verses.en: So hath the offering. wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers. So dwell thou, Indra, even with us!

verses.sa:
मो षु ब्रह्मेव तदिन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते ।
मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu brahmeva tadindrayurbhuvo vajanam pate |
matsva sutasya gomatah ||
verses.en: Be not thou like a slothful priest, O Lord of spoil and strength: rejoice In the pressed Soma blent with milk!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः ।
रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
indram vishva avivridhantsamudravyachasam girah |
rathitamam rathinam vajanam satpatim patim ||
verses.en: All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea. Best of all warriors borne on cars, the Lord of heroes, Lord of strength.

verses.sa:
सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते ।
त्वामभि प्र नोनुमो जेतारमपराजितं ॥
verses.rom:
sakhye ta indra vajino ma bhema shavasaspate |
tvamabhi pra nonumo jetaramaparajitam ||
verses.en: Lord of might, Indra, may we ne'er, strong in thy friendship, be afraid! We glorify with praises thee, the never conquered conqueror.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः ।
यदा वाजस्य गोमत स्तोतृभ्यो मंहते मघं ॥
verses.rom:
purvirindrasya ratayo na vi dasyantyutayah |
yada vajasya gomata stotribhyo mamhate magham ||
verses.en: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours never fail, When to his worshippers he gives the boon of booty rich in kine.

verses.sa:
एत असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।
विश्वान्यभि सौभगा ॥
verses.rom:
eta asrigramindavastirah pavitramashavah |
vishvanyabhi saubhaga ||
verses.en: These rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve. To bring us all felicities.

verses.sa:
विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः ।
त्मना कृण्वन्तो अर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
vighnanto durita puru suga tokaya vajinah |
tmana krinvanto arvatah ||
verses.en: Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny, Yea, and the warrior steed's, success.

verses.sa:
कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिं ।
इडामस्मभ्यं संयतं ॥
verses.rom:
krinvanto varivo gave'bhyarshanti sushtutim |
idamasmabhyam samyatam ||
verses.en: Bringing prosperity to kine, they pour perpetual strengthening food On us for noble eulogy.

verses.sa:
राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि ।
अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
raja medhabhiriyate pavamano manavadhi |
antarikshena yatave ||
verses.en: King Pavamana is implored with holy songs, on man's behalf, To travel through, the realm of air.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर ।
सुष्वाणो देववीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a nah soma saho juvo rupam na varchase bhara |
sushvano devavitaye ||
verses.en: Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might,and speed, Like beauty for a'brilliant show!

verses.sa:
आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यं ।
वहा भगत्तिमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
a na indo shatagvinam gavam posham svashvyam |
vaha bhagattimutaye ||
verses.en: Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds. The gift of fortune for our help!

verses.sa:
तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः ।
चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva nrimnani bibhratam sadhastheshu maho divah |
charum sukrityayemahe ||
verses.en: With sacrifice we seek to thee fair cherisher of manly might In mansons of the lofty heavens.

verses.sa:
संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदं ।
शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिं ॥
verses.rom:
samvriktadhrishnumukthyam mahamahivratam madam |
shatam puro rurukshanim ||
verses.en: Drink gladdening, crusher of the bold, praiseworthy, with most mighty sway, Destroyer of a hundred forts.

verses.sa:
अतस्त्वा रयिरभ्ययद्राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः ।
सुपर्णो अव्यथी भरत् ॥
verses.rom:
atastva rayirabhyayadrajanam sukrato divah |
suparno avyathi bharat ||
verses.en: Hence riches came to thee, the King, O sapient one: the strong-winged bird, Unwearied, brought thee from the sky.

verses.sa:
अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे ।
अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hinvana indriyam jyayo mahitvamanashe |
abhishtikridvicharshanih ||
verses.en: And now, sent forth, he hath attained to mighty power and majesty, Active and ready to assist.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरं ।
गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasma itsvardrishe sadharanam rajasturam |
gopamritasya virbharat ||
verses.en: That each may see the light, the bird brought us the guard of Law, the friend O fall, the speeder through the air.

verses.sa:
इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः ।
इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥
verses.rom:
ishe pavasva dharaya mrijyamano manishibhih |
indo ruchabhi ga ihi ||
verses.en: For food, flow onward with thy stream, cleansed and made bright by sapient men: Indu, with sheen approach the milk!

verses.sa:
पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः ।
हरे सृजान आशिरं ॥
verses.rom:
punano varivaskridhyurjam janaya girvanah |
hare srijana ashiram ||
verses.en: While thou art cleansed, song-lover. bring comfort and vigourto the folk, Poured, tawny one! on milk and curds!

verses.sa:
पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतं ।
द्युतानो वाजिभिर्हितः ॥
verses.rom:
punano devavitaya indrasya yahi nishkritam |
dyutano vajibhirhitah ||
verses.en: Purified for feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's resting-place, Resplendent, furthered by the strong!

verses.sa:
अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ।
हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agninagnih samidhyate kavirgrihapatiryuva |
havyavadjuhvasyah ||
verses.en: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the house, wise, young,. who bears Our gifts: the ladle is his mouth.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति ।
तस्य स्म प्राविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
yastvamagne havishpatirdutam deva saparyati |
tasya sma pravita bhava ||
verses.en: God, Agni, be his sure defence who, lord of sacrificial gifts. Worshippeth thee the messenger.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्मां आविवासति ।
तस्मै पावक मृडय ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnim devavitaye havishmam avivasati |
tasmai pavaka mridaya ||
verses.en: Be gracious, brilliant Godl to him who, rich in sacred gifts,would fain Call Agni to the feast of Gods!

verses.sa:
मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसं ।
धियं घृताचीं साधन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
mitram huve putadaksham varunam cha rishadasam |
dhiyam ghritachim sadhanta ||
verses.en: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who perfect prayer with offered oil.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा ।
क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे ॥
verses.rom:
ritena mitravarunavritavridhavritasprisha |
kratum brihantamashathe ||
verses.en: By Law, O Mitra, Varuna, Law-strengtheners who cleave to Law, Have ye obtained your lofty power.

verses.sa:
कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया ।
दक्षं दधाते अपसं ॥
verses.rom:
kavi no mitravaruna tuvijata urukshaya |
daksham dadhate apasam ||
verses.en: The Sages, Mitra, Varuna, of wide dominion, mighty ones, Bestow on us effectual strength.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा ।
मन्दू समानवर्च्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
indrena sam hi drikshase samjagmano abibhyusha |
mandu samanavarchchasa ||
verses.en: So mayst thou verily be seen coming with fearless Indra: both Of equal splendour, bringing bliss!

verses.sa:
आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे ।
दधाना नाम यज्ञियं ॥
verses.rom:
adaha svadhamanu punargarbhatvamerire |
dadhana nama yajniyam ||
verses.en: Thereafter they, as is their wont, resumed the state of new-born babes, Taking their sacrificial name.

verses.sa:
वीडु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः ।
अविन्द उस्रिया अनु ॥
verses.rom:
vidu chidarujatnubhirguha chidindra vahnibhih |
avinda usriya anu ||
verses.en: Thou, Indra, with the rapid Gods who shatter even what is firm, Even in the cave didst find the cows.

verses.sa:
ता हुवे ययोरिदं पप्ने विश्वं पुरा कृतं ।
इन्द्राग्नी न मर्धतः ॥
verses.rom:
ta huve yayoridam papne vishvam pura kritam |
indragni na mardhatah ||
verses.en: I call the twain whose deed wrought here hath all been famed in ancient time: Indra and Agni harm us not!

verses.sa:
उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे ।
ता नो मृडात ईदृशे ॥
verses.rom:
ugra vighanina mridha indragni havamahe |
ta no mridata idrishe ||
verses.en: The strong, the scatterers of the foe, Indra and Agni we invoke: May they be kind to one like me:

verses.sa:
हथो वृत्राण्यार्या हथो दासानि सत्पती ।
हथो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
hatho vritranyarya hatho dasani satpati |
hatho vishva apa dvishah ||
verses.en: Ye slay our Arya foes, O Lords of heroes, slay our Dasa foes: Ye drive all enemies away.

verses.sa:
अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदं ।
समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपे मनीषिणो मत्सरासो मदच्युतः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi somasa ayavah pavante madyam madam |
samudrasyadhi vishtape manishino matsaraso madachyutah ||
verses.en: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow the gladdening drink, Intelligent drops above the station of the sea, exhilarating, dropping meath.

verses.sa:
तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ।
अर्षा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
taratsamudram pavamana urmina raja deva ritam brihat |
arsha mitrasya varunasya dharmana pra hinvana ritam brihat ||
verses.en: May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite! Do thou by Mitra's and by Varuna's decree flow furthering the lofty rite:

verses.sa: नृभिर्येमाणो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्र्यः ॥
verses.rom: nribhiryemano haryato vichakshano raja devah samudryah ||
verses.en: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose habitation is the sea!

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निरृतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषां ।
गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः ॥
verses.rom:
tisro vacha irayati pra vahnirritasya dhitim brahmano manisham |
gavo yanti gopatim prichchhamanah somam yanti matayo vavashanah ||
verses.en: Three are the voices that the car-steed utters: he speaks the lore of prayer, the thought of Order. To the cows' master come the cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.

verses.sa:
सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः ।
सोमः सुत ऋच्यते पूयमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
somam gavo dhenavo vavashanah somam vipra matibhih prichchhamanah |
somah suta richyate puyamanah some arkastrishtubhah sam navante ||
verses.en: To Soma come the cows, the milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hymns inquiring. Soma, effused, is purified and lauded: our hymns and Trishtup songs unite in Soma.

verses.sa:
एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति ।
इन्द्रमा विश बृहता मदेन वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरन्धिं ॥
verses.rom:
eva nah soma parishichyamana a pavasva puyamanah svasti |
indrama visha brihata madena vardhaya vacham janaya purandhim ||
verses.en: Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified, flow for our welfare! Pass into Indra. with great joy and rapture: make the voice swell, and generate abundance!

verses.sa:
यद्याव इन्द्र ते शतंशतं भूमीरुत स्युः ।
न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
yadyava indra te shatamshatam bhumiruta syuh |
na tva vajrintsahasram surya anu na jatamashta rodasi ||
verses.en: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.

verses.sa:
आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा ।
अस्मां अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a papratha mahina vrishnya vrishanvishva shavishtha shavasa |
asmam ava maghavangomati vraje vajrinchitrabhirutibhih ||
verses.en: Thou, hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O strongest one. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids!

verses.sa:
वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha tva sutavanta apo na vriktabarhishah |
pavitrasya prasravaneshu vritrahanpari stotara asate ||
verses.en: We compass thee like water, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.

verses.sa:
स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः ।
कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः ॥
verses.rom:
svaranti tva sute naro vaso nireka ukthinah |
kada sutam trishana oka a gama indra svabdiva vamsagah ||
verses.en: Men, Vasu! by the Soma with lauds call thee to the foremost place. When cometh he athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

verses.sa:
कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणं ।
पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
kanvebhirdhrishnava dhrishadvajam darshi sahasrinam |
pishangarupam maghavanvicharshane makshu gomantamimahe ||
verses.en: O valiant hero, boldly win thousandfold spoil with Kanva's sons! O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellowhued with store of kine.

verses.sa:
तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा ।
आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवं ॥
verses.rom:
taraniritsishasati vajam purandhya yuja |
a va indram puruhutam name gira nemim tashteva sudruvam ||
verses.en: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.

verses.sa:
न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते न स्रेधन्तं रयिर्नशत् ।
सुशक्तिरिन्मघवं तुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
na dushtutirdravinodeshu shasyate na sredhantam rayirnashat |
sushaktirinmaghavam tubhyam mavate deshnam yatparye divi ||
verses.en: They who bestow great riches love not paltry praise: wealth comes not to the niggard churl. Light is the task to give, O Maghavan, to one like me on the decisive day.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः ।
हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
tisro vacha udirate gavo mimanti dhenavah |
harireti kanikradat ||
verses.en: Three several words are uttered: kine are lowing cows. who give the milk: The tawny-hued goes bellowing on.

verses.sa:
अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीरृतस्य मातरः ।
मर्जयन्तीर्दिवः शिशुं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi brahmiranushata yahvirritasya matarah |
marjayantirdivah shishum ||
verses.en: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise, Embellishing the Child of Heaven.

verses.sa:
रायः समुद्रांश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
rayah samudramshchaturo'smabhyam soma vishvatah |
a pavasva sahasrinah ||
verses.en: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas. Filled full of riches thousandfold!

verses.sa:
सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः ।
पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरं देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः ॥
verses.rom:
sutaso madhumattamah soma indraya mandinah |
pavitravanto aksharam devangachchhantu vo madah ||
verses.en: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is distined, flow Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may you strong juices reach the Gods!

verses.sa:
इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् ।
वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसाः ॥
verses.rom:
indurindraya pavata iti devaso abruvan |
vachaspatirmakhasyate vishvasyeshana ojasah ||
verses.en: Indu flows on for Indra's sake,-thus have the deities declared. The Lord of Speech exerts himself, controller of all power and might.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः ।
सोमस्पती रयीणां सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradharah pavate samudro vachaminkhayah |
somaspati rayinam sakhendrasya divedive ||
verses.en: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows. Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the friend of Indra, day by day.

verses.sa:
पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः ।
अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तः सं तदाशत ॥
verses.rom:
pavitram te vitatam brahmanaspate prabhurgatrani paryeshi vishvatah |
ataptatanurna tadamo ashnute shritasa idvahantah sam tadashata ||
verses.en: SPREAD is thy cleansing filter, Brahmanaspati: as prince thou enterest its limbs from every side. The raw; whose mass bath not been heated. gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.

verses.sa:
तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदेऽर्चन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् ।
अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवः पृष्ठमधि रोहन्ति तेजसा ॥
verses.rom:
taposhpavitram vitatam divaspade'rchanto asya tantavo vyasthiran |
avantyasya pavitaramashavo divah prishthamadhi rohanti tejasa ||
verses.en: High in the seat of heaven is placed the scorcher's sieve: its, threads are standing separate, glittering with light. The swift ones favour him who purifieth this: with brilliancy they mount up to the height of heaven.

verses.sa:
अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा मिमेति भुवनेषु वाजयुः ।
मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः ॥
verses.rom:
aruruchadushasah prishniragriya uksha mimeti bhuvaneshu vajayuh |
mayavino mamire asya mayaya nrichakshasah pitaro garbhama dadhuh ||
verses.en: The foremost spotted Steer bath made the Mornings shine: he bellows, fain for war, among created things. By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ.

verses.sa:
प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे ।
उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
pra mamhishthaya gayata ritavne brihate shukrashochishe |
upastutaso agnaye ||
verses.en: Sing forth to him, the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas

verses.sa:
आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः ।
कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्भवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
a vamsate maghava viravadyashah samiddho dyumnyahutah |
kuvinno asya sumatirbhaviyasyachchha vajebhiragamat ||
verses.en: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame: And will not his more plentiful benevolence come to us with abundant strength?

verses.sa:
तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिं ।
उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियं ॥
verses.rom:
tam te madam grinimasi vrishanam prikshu sasahim |
u lokakritnumadrivo harishriyam ||
verses.en: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.

verses.sa:
येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ ।
मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
yena jyotimshyayave manave cha viveditha |
mandano asya barhisho vi rajasi ||
verses.en: Wherewith thou foundest shining lights for Ayu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou bearnest forth.

verses.sa:
तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ।
वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
tadadya chitta ukthino'nu shtuvanti purvatha |
vrishapatnirapo jaya divedive ||
verses.en: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine: Win thou the waters every day, thralls of the strong!

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति ।
सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महां असि ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi havam tirashchya indra yastva saparyati |
suviryasya gomato rayaspurdhi maham asi ||
verses.en: O Indra, hear Tirschi's call, the call of him who serveth thee. Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valient offspring! Great art thou.

verses.sa:
यस्त इन्द्र नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् ।
चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीं ॥
verses.rom:
yasta indra naviyasim giram mandramajijanat |
chikitvinmanasam dhiyam pratnamritasya pipyushim ||
verses.en: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song, A hymn that springs from careful drop thought, ancient and full of sacred truth.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः ।
पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tamu shtavama yam gira indramukthani vavridhuh |
purunyasya paumsya sishasanto vanamahe ||
verses.en: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified. Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.

verses.sa:
प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धेनवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि ।
प्रान्तरिक्षात्स्थाविरीस्ते असृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ta ashvinih pavamana dhenavo divya asrigranpayasa dharimani |
prantarikshatsthaviriste asrikshata ye tva mrijantyrishishana vedhasah ||
verses.en: Fleet as swift steeds thy cows celestial have been poured, O Pavamana, with the milk into the vat. Sages who make thee bright, O friend whom Rishis love, have shed continuous streams from out the realm of air.

verses.sa:
उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः ।
यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योनौ कलशेषु सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayatah pavamanasya rashmayo dhruvasya satah pari yanti ketavah |
yadi pavitre adhi mrijyate harih satta ni yonau kalasheshu sidati ||
verses.en: The beams of Pavamana, sent from earth and heaven his ensigns who is ever stedfast, travel round. When on the sieve the golden-hued is cleansed he rests within the jars as one who seats him in his place.

verses.sa:
विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोष्टे सतः परि यन्ति केतवः ।
व्यानशी पवसे सोम धर्मणा पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
vishva dhamani vishvachaksha ribhvasah prabhoshte satah pari yanti ketavah |
vyanashi pavase soma dharmana patirvishvasya bhuvanasya rajasi ||
verses.en: O thou who seest all things, sovran as thou art and passing strong, thy rays encompass every form. Pervading with thy natural powers thou flowest on, and as the whole world's Lord, O Soma, thou art King.

verses.sa:
पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुं ।
ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano ajijanaddivashchitram na tanyatum |
jyotirvaishvanaram brihat ||
verses.en: From heaven hath Pavamana, made, as 'twere, the marvellous thunder, and The lofty light of all mankind.

verses.sa:
पवमान रसस्तव मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः ।
वि वारमव्यमर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana rasastava mado rajannaduchchhunah |
vi varamavyamarshati ||
verses.en: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, O Pavamana, King! Flows o'cr the woollen straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य ते रसो दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् ।
ज्योतिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya te raso daksho vi rajati dyuman |
jyotirvishvam svardrishe ||
verses.en: Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad fixe splendid skill, Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः ।
घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचं ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadgavo na bhurnayastvesha ayaso akramuh |
ghnantah krishnamapa tvacham ||
verses.en: Impetuous, bright, have they come forth, unwearied in their speed, like bulls, Driving the black skin far away.

verses.sa:
सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराय्यं ।
साह्याम दस्युमव्रतं ॥
verses.rom:
suvitasya manamahe'ti setum durayyam |
sahyama dasyumavratam ||
verses.en: May we attain the bridge of bliss, leaving the bridge of woe behind: The riteless Dasa may we quell!

verses.sa:
शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः ।
चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
shrinve vrishteriva svanah pavamanasya shushminah |
charanti vidyuto divi ||
verses.en: The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as 'twere the rush of rain The lightning-Rashes move in heaven.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् ।
अश्ववत्सोम वीरवत् ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva mahimisham gomadindo hiranyavat |
ashvavatsoma viravat ||
verses.en: Indu, pour out abundant food with store of cattle and of gold, Of heroes, Soma! and of steeds!

verses.sa:
पवस्व विश्वचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण ।
उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vishvacharshana a mahi rodasi prina |
ushah suryo na rashmibhih ||
verses.en: Flow onward, dear to all mankind fi full the mighty heaven and earth, As Dawn, as Surya with his beams

verses.sa:
परि नः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः ।
सरा रसेव विष्टपं ॥
verses.rom:
pari nah sharmayantya dharaya soma vishvatah |
sara raseva vishtapam ||
verses.en: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream, As Rasa flows around the world!

verses.sa:
आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना ।
यत्र देवा इति ब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
ashurarsha brihanmate pari priyena dhamna |
yatra deva iti bruvan ||
verses.en: Flow on, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form, Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.

verses.sa:
परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः ।
वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
parishkrinvannanishkritam janaya yatayannishah |
vrishtim divah pari srava ||
verses.en: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man, Make thou the rain descend from heaven

verses.sa:
अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ ।
सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa yo divaspari raghuyama pavitra a |
sindhorurma vyaksharat ||
verses.en: Even here is he who, swift of course, hath with the river's wave Rowed down. From heaven upon the straining cloth.

verses.sa:
सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा ।
विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥
verses.rom:
suta eti pavitra a tvishim dadhana ojasa |
vichakshano virochayan ||
verses.en: With might. producing glare, the juice enters the purifying sieve, Far-seeing, sending forth its light.

verses.sa:
आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः ।
इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥
verses.rom:
avivasanparavato atho arvavatah sutah |
indraya sichyate madhu ||
verses.en: Inviting him from far away, and even from near at hand, the juice For Indra is poured forth as meath.

verses.sa:
समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
samichina anushata harim hinvantyadribhih |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the golden-hued, Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिं ।
महामिन्दुं महीयुवः ॥
verses.rom:
hinvanti suramusrayah svasaro jamayaspatim |
mahamindum mahiyuvah ||
verses.en: The glittering maids send Sdra forth, the glorious sisters, closeallied, Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.

verses.sa:
पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
विश्वा वसून्या विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana rucharucha devo devebhyah sutah |
vishva vasunya visha ||
verses.en: Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light, Pressed out, O God thyself, for Gods!

verses.sa:
आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः ।
इषे पवस्व संयतं ॥
verses.rom:
a pavamana sushtutim vrishtim devebhyo duvah |
ishe pavasva samyatam ||
verses.en: Pour on us, Pavamana! rain, as service and fair praise for Gods: Pour forth unceasingly for food!

verses.sa:
जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे ।
घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृषा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः ॥
verses.rom:
janasya gopa ajanishta jagriviragnih sudakshah suvitaya navyase |
ghritapratiko brihata divisprisha dyumadvi bhati bharatebhyah shuchih ||
verses.en: The watchful guardian of the people hath been born, Agni, the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face. with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure, for the Bharatas.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वनेवने ।
स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne angiraso guha hitamanvavindanchhishriyanam vanevane |
sa jayase mathyamanah saho mahatvamahuh sahasasputramangirah ||
