verses.en: O Agni, the Angirasas discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समिन्धते ।
इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya ketum prathamam purohitamagnim narastrishadhasthe samindhate |
indrena devaih saratham sa barhishi sidanni hota yajathaya sukratuh ||
verses.en: The men enkindle Agni in his threefold seat, ensign of sacrifice, the earliest bousehold- priest. With Indra and the Gods together on the grass let the wise priest sit to complete the sacrifice!

verses.sa:
अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा ।
ममेदिह श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam mitravaruna sutah soma ritavridha |
mamediha shrutam havam ||
verses.en: This Soma hath been pressed for you, Low-strengtheners, Mitra, Varuna! List, list ye here to this may call!

verses.sa:
राजानावनभिद्रुहा ध्रुवे सदस्युत्तमे ।
सहस्रस्थूण आशाते ॥
verses.rom:
rajanavanabhidruha dhruve sadasyuttame |
sahasrasthuna ashate ||
verses.en: Both Kings who never injure aught have come to their sublimest home, The thousand-pillared, firmly based.

verses.sa:
ता सम्राजा घृतासुती आदित्या दानुनस्पती ।
सचेते अनवह्वरं ॥
verses.rom:
ta samraja ghritasuti aditya danunaspati |
sachete anavahvaram ||
verses.en: Worshipped with fat libation. Lords of gifts, Adityas, sovran Kings, They wait on him whose life is true.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः ।
जघान नवतीर्नव ॥
verses.rom:
indro dadhicho asthabhirvritranyapratishkutah |
jaghana navatirnava ||
verses.en: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra with unresisted. might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.

verses.sa:
इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितं ।
तद्विदच्छर्यणावति ॥
verses.rom:
ichchhannashvasya yachchhirah parvateshvapashritam |
tadvidachchharyanavati ||
verses.en: He, searching for the horse's head that in the mountains lay concealed, Found it in Saryandvdn lake.

verses.sa:
अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यं ।
इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
atraha goramanvata nama tvashturapichyam |
ittha chandramaso grihe ||
verses.en: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer. There in the mansion of the Moon.

verses.sa:
इयं वामस्य मन्मन इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिः ।
अभ्राद्वृष्टिरिवाजनि ॥
verses.rom:
iyam vamasya manmana indragni purvyastutih |
abhradvrishtirivajani ||
verses.en: As rain from out the cloud, for you, Indra and Agni, from my thought This noblest praise hath been produced.

verses.sa:
शृणुतं जरितुर्हवमिन्द्राग्नी वनतं गिरः ।
ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
verses.rom:
shrinutam jariturhavamindragni vanatam girah |
ishana pipyatam dhiyah ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, listen to the singer's call: accept his songs. Fulfil, ye mighty Lords, his prayers!

verses.sa:
मा पापत्वाय नो नरेन्द्राग्नी माभिशस्तये ।
मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥
verses.rom:
ma papatvaya no narendragni mabhishastaye |
ma no riradhatam nide ||
verses.en: Give us not up to indigence, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, nor To Slander and reproach of men!

verses.sa:
पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे ।
मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva dakshasadhano devebhyah pitaye hare |
marudbhyo vayave madah ||
verses.en: Gold-Hued! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught For Vayu and the Marut host!

verses.sa:
सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः ।
पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sam devaih shobhate vrisha kaviryonavadhi priyah |
pavamano adabhyah ||
verses.en: The Steer shines brightly with the Gods, dear Sage in his appointed home. Even Pavamana unbeguiled.

verses.sa:
पवमान धिया हितो३ऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ।
धर्मणा वायुमारुहः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana dhiya hito3'bhi yonim kanikradat |
dharmana vayumaruhah ||
verses.en: O Pavamana, sent by prayer, roaring about thy dwelling-place, Ascend to Vayu as Law bids!

verses.sa:
तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे ।
पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीं रति तांइहि ॥
verses.rom:
tavaham soma rarana sakhya indo divedive |
puruni babhro ni charanti mamava paridhim rati tamihi ||
verses.en: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. Many fiends follow me; help me, thou tawny-hued: pass on beyond these barriers!

verses.sa:
तवाहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा दुहानो बभ्र ऊधनि ।
घृणा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम ॥
verses.rom:
tavaham naktamuta soma te diva duhano babhra udhani |
ghrina tapantamati suryam parah shakuna iva paptima ||
verses.en: Close to thy bosom am I. Soma, day and night draining the milk, O golden hued. Surya himself refulgent with his glow have we, as birds, o'ertaken in his course.

verses.sa:
पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः ।
शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
punano akramidabhi vishva mridho vicharshanih |
shumbhanti vipram dhitibhih ||
verses.en: Active, while being purified, he hath assailed all enemies: They deck the Sage with holy hymns.

verses.sa:
आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रो वृषा सुतं ।
ध्रुवे सदसि सीदतु ॥
verses.rom:
a yonimaruno ruhadgamadindro vrisha sutam |
dhruve sadasi sidatu ||
verses.en: The Red hath mounted to his shrine; strong Indra hath approached the juice: In his firm dwelling let him rest!

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.rom:
nu no rayim mahamindo'smabhyam soma vishvatah |
a pavasva sahasrinam ||
verses.en: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side: Pour on us treasures thousandfold!

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममिन्द्र मदन्तु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः ।
सोतुर्बाहुभ्यां सुयतो नार्वा ॥
verses.rom:
piba somamindra madantu tva yam te sushava haryashvadrih |
soturbahubhyam suyato narva ||
verses.en: Drink Soma, Indra Lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser, Directed by the presser's arms bath pressed it.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो युज्यश्चारुरस्ति येन वृत्राणि हर्यश्व हंसि ।
स त्वामिन्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado yujyashcharurasti yena vritrani haryashva hamsi |
sa tvamindra prabhuvaso mamattu ||
verses.en: So let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, O Lord of bays, thou slayest Vritras, Delight thee, Indra, Lord of princely treasuresl

verses.sa:
बोधा सु मे मघवन्वाचमेमां यां ते वसिष्ठो अर्चति प्रशस्तिं ।
इमा ब्रह्म सधमादे जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
bodha su me maghavanvachamemam yam te vasishtho archati prashastim |
ima brahma sadhamade jushasva ||
verses.en: Mark closely, Maghavan, the word I utter, this eulogy recited by Vasislitha: Accept the prayers I offer at thy banquet!

verses.sa:
विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरः सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे ।
क्रत्वे वरे स्थेमन्यामुरीमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तरसं तरस्विनं ॥
verses.rom:
vishvah pritana abhibhutaram narah sajustatakshurindram jajanushcha rajase |
kratve vare sthemanyamurimutogramojishtham tarasam tarasvinam ||
verses.en: Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

verses.sa:
नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरे ।
सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
nemim namanti chakshasa mesham vipra abhisvare |
suditayo vo adruho'pi karne tarasvinah samrikvabhih ||
verses.en: The holy sages form a ring, to view and sing unto the Ram. Inciters, very brilliant, from all deceit, are with your chariters nigh to hear.

verses.sa:
समु रेभसो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ।
स्वःपतिर्यदी वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
samu rebhaso asvarannindram somasya pitaye |
svahpatiryadi vridhe dhritavrato hyojasa samutibhih ||
verses.en: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice. The Lord of light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.

verses.sa:
यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः ।
विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
verses.rom:
yo raja charshaninam yata rathebhiradhriguh |
vishvasam taruta pritananam jyeshtham yo vritraha grine ||
verses.en: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, vanquisher of all fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं तं शुम्भ्य पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्त्तरि ।
हस्तेन वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महां देवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indram tam shumbhya puruhanmannavase yasya dvita vidharttari |
hastena vajrah prati dhayi darshato maham devo na suryah ||
verses.en: Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, him in whose hand of old the fair Sustaining bolt of thunder, mighty like the God, like Surya, was deposited!

verses.sa:
परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः ।
स्वानैर्याति कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari priya divah kavirvayamsi naptyorhitah |
svanairyati kavikratuh ||
verses.en: The Sage of heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands, with roars, Gives us delightful powers of life.

verses.sa:
स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् ।
महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
sa sunurmatara shuchirjato jate arochayat |
mahanmahi ritavridha ||
verses.en: He, the bright son, when born, illumed his parents who had sprung to life, Great Son, great strengtheners of Law.

verses.sa:
प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहः ।
वीत्यर्ष पनिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
prapra kshayaya panyase janaya jushto adruhah |
vityarsha panishtaye ||
verses.en: On, onward to a glorious home, free from all guile and dear to. men, Flow with enjoyment to our praise!

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्या३ङ्ग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः ।
अमृतत्वाय घोषयन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hya3nga daivya pavamana janimani dyumattamah |
amritatvaya ghoshayan ||
verses.en: For, verily, Pavamana, thou, divine! endued with brightest splendour, calling all Creatures to immortality.

verses.sa:
येना नवग्वो दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे ।
देवानां सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवांस्याशत ॥
verses.rom:
yena navagvo dadhyannapornute yena viprasa apire |
devanam sumne amritasya charuno yena shravamsyashata ||
verses.en: With whom Dadhyach Navagva opened fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrita in the felicity of Gods.

verses.sa:
सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यं वारं वि धावति ।
अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
somah punana urminavyam varam vi dhavati |
agre vachah pavamanah kanikradat ||
verses.en: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Roaring, while purified, before the voice of song.

verses.sa:
धीभिर्मृजन्ति वाजिनं वने क्रीडन्तमत्यविं ।
अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
dhibhirmrijanti vajinam vane kridantamatyavim |
abhi triprishtham matayah samasvaran ||
verses.en: With prayers they cleanse the mighty steed, sporting in wood, above the fleece: Our hymns, intoned, have praised him of the triple height.

verses.sa:
असर्जि कलशां अभि मीढ्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।
पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asarji kalasham abhi midhvantsaptirna vajayuh |
punano vacham janayannasishyadat ||
verses.en: He hath been hastened to the jars, bountiful, like an eager horse, And, lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.

verses.sa:
सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः ।
जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः ॥
verses.rom:
somah pavate janita matinam janita divo janita prithivyah |
janitagnerjanita suryasya janitendrasya janitota vishnoh ||
verses.en: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward, the father of the earth, father of heaven. Father of Agni, Surya's generator, the father who begat Indra and Vishnu.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनां ऋषिर्विप्राणां महिषोमृगाणां ।
श्येनो गृध्राणां स्वधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
brahma devanam padavih kavinam rishirvipranam mahishomriganam |
shyeno gridhranam svadhitirvananam somah pavitramatyeti rebhan ||
verses.en: Brahman of Gods, the leader of the poets, Rishi of sages, chief of savage creatures, Falcon amid the vultures, axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.

verses.sa:
प्रावीविपद्वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिर स्तोमान्पवमानो मनीषाः ।
अन्तः पश्यन्वृजनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वृषभो गोषु जानन् ॥
verses.rom:
pravivipadvacha urmim na sindhurgira stomanpavamano manishah |
antah pashyanvrijanemavaranya tishthati vrishabho goshu janan ||
verses.en: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises Beholding these inferior powers, the hero, well knowing, takes his stand among the cattle.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमं ।
अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vo vridhantamadhvaranam purutamam |
achchha naptre sahasvate ||
verses.en: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.

verses.sa:
अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या ।
अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yatha na abhuvattvashta rupeva takshya |
asya kratva yashasvatah ||
verses.en: That through this famed one's power he may stand by us, even as Tvasbtar comes Unto the forms that must be shaped.

verses.sa:
अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते ।
आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vishva abhi shriyo'gnirdeveshu patyate |
a vajairupa no gamat ||
verses.en: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories' mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदं ।
शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने ॥
verses.rom:
imamindra sutam piba jyeshthamamartyam madam |
shukrasya tvabhyaksharandhara ritasya sadane ||
verses.en: This poured libation, Indra drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent! Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.

verses.sa:
न किष्ट्वद्रथीतरो हरी यदिन्द्र यच्छसे ।
न किष्ट्वानु मज्मना न किः स्वश्व आनशे ॥
verses.rom:
na kishtvadrathitaro hari yadindra yachchhase |
na kishtvanu majmana na kih svashva anashe ||
verses.en: When, Indra, thou dost guide thy bays, there is no better charioteer: None hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o'ertaken thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय नूनमर्चतोक्थानि च ब्रवीतन ।
सुता अमत्सुरिन्दवो ज्येष्ठं नमस्यता सहः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya nunamarchatokthani cha bravitana |
suta amatsurindavo jyeshtham namasyata sahah ||
verses.en: Sing glory now to Indra, say to him your solemn eulogies! The drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his noblest might!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जुषस्व प्र वहा याहि शूर हरिह ।
पिबा सुतस्य मतिर्न मधोश्चकानश्चारुर्मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
indra jushasva pra vaha yahi shura hariha |
piba sutasya matirna madhoshchakanashcharurmadaya ||
verses.en: Indra, be pleased: drive forward, hero, striker of thy bays! Fair, like a sage, delighting in the meath, drink of the juice for rapturous joy.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जठरं नव्यं न पृणस्व मधोर्दिवो न ।
अस्य सुतस्य स्वा३र्नोप त्वा मदाः सुवाचो अस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
indra jatharam navyam na prinasva madhordivo na |
asya sutasya sva3rnopa tva madah suvacho asthuh ||
verses.en: O Indra, fill thy belly anew with meath that seems to flow from heaven. The sweet-voiced raptures of this juice have come, as 'twere to heaven. to thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्तुराषाण्मित्रो न जघान वृत्रं यतिर्न ।
बिभेद वलं भृगुर्न ससाहे शत्रून्मदे सोमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
indrasturashanmitro na jaghana vritram yatirna |
bibheda valam bhrigurna sasahe shatrunmade somasya ||
verses.en: Indra, victorious, Mitra-like, smote, like a Yati, Vritra dead. As Bhrigu quelled his foes, he cleft Vala in Soma's rapturous joy.

verses.sa:
गोवित्पवस्व वसुविद्धिरण्यविद्रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
त्वं सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा नर उप गिरेम आसते ॥
verses.rom:
govitpavasva vasuviddhiranyavidretodha indo bhuvaneshvarpitah |
tvam suviro asi soma vishvavittam tva nara upa girema asate ||
verses.en: Winner of gold and gear and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, Indu! 'mid the worlds of life! Rich in brave men art thou, Soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with song.

verses.sa:
त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि ।
स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयं स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nrichaksha asi soma vishvatah pavamana vrishabha ta vi dhavasi |
sa nah pavasva vasumaddhiranyavadvayam syama bhuvaneshu jivase ||
verses.en: O Soma, thou beholdest men from every side: O Pavamana, Steer, thou wanderest through these. Pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be!

verses.sa:
ईशान इमा भुवनानि ईयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः ।
तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
ishana ima bhuvanani iyase yujana indo haritah suparnyah |
taste ksharantu madhumadghritam payastava vrate soma tishthantu krishtayah ||
verses.en: Thou passest to these worlds as sovran Lord thereof, O Indu, harnessing thy tawny well-winged mares. May they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: O Soma, let the folk abide in thy decree!

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत ।
सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya vishvavitpra te sarga asrikshata |
suryasyeva na rashmayah ||
verses.en: The streams of Pavamana, thine, finder of all I have been effused, Even as Surya's rays of light.

verses.sa:
केतुं कृण्वं दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि ।
समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ॥
verses.rom:
ketum krinvam divaspari vishva rupabhyarshasi |
samudrah soma pinvase ||
verses.en: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form, Soma, thou swellest like a sea.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि ।
क्रन्दं देवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
jajnano vachamishyasi pavamana vidharmani |
krandam devo na suryah ||
verses.en: Shown forth thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana, with a roar. Like Surya, God, as Law commands.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः ।
श्रीणाना अप्सु वृञ्जते ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaso adhanvishuh pavamanasa indavah |
shrinana apsu vrinjate ||
verses.en: Hitherward have the Somas streamed, the drops while they are purified: When blent, in waters they are raised.

verses.sa:
अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः ।
पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gavo adhanvishurapo na pravata yatih |
punana indramashata ||
verses.en: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: They come to Indra, being cleansed.

verses.sa:
प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय मादनः ।
नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra pavamana dhanvasi somendraya madanah |
nribhiryato vi niyase ||
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, thou flowest as Indra's gladdener: The men have seized and lead thee forth.

verses.sa:
इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिदीयसे ।
अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
verses.rom:
indo yadadribhih sutah pavitram paridiyase |
aramindrasya dhamne ||
verses.en: Thou, Indu, when, expressed by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art Ready for Indra's high decree.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीधृतिः ।
सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma nrimadanah pavasva charshanidhritih |
sasniryo anumadyah ||
verses.en: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow delighting men, As the supporter of mankind!

verses.sa:
पवस्व वृत्रहन्तम उक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः ।
शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vritrahantama ukthebhiranumadyah |
shuchih pavako adbhutah ||
verses.en: Flow on, best Vritra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds, pure, purifying, wonderful

verses.sa:
शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतः स मधुमान् ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
shuchih pavaka uchyate somah sutah sa madhuman |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en: Pure, purifying, is he called, Soma effused and full of sweets, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sa:
प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत ।
साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
pra kavirdevavitaye'vya varebhiravyata |
sahvanvishva abhi spridhah ||
verses.en: The Sage hath robed him in the sheep's wool for the banquet of the Gods, Subduing all our enemies.

verses.sa:
स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति ।
पवमानः सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shma jaritribhya a vajam gomantaminvati |
pavamanah sahasrinam ||
verses.en: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousandfold riches in the shape Of cattle to the worshippers.

verses.sa:
परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृज्यसे पवसे मती ।
स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥
verses.rom:
pari vishvani chetasa mrijyase pavase mati |
sa nah soma shravo vidah ||
verses.en: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts: As such, O Soma, find us fame!

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिं ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha brihadyasho maghavadbhyo dhruvam rayim |
isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: Pour on us lofty glory, send sure riches to our liberal lords: Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमाविवेशिथ ।
पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥
verses.rom:
tvam rajeva suvrato girah somaviveshitha |
punano vahne adbhuta ||
verses.en: As thou art cleansed, O wondrous steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like A pious king, into the songs,

verses.sa:
स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।
सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
sa vahnirapsu dushtaro mrijyamano gabhastyoh |
somashchamushu sidati ||
verses.en: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made bright With hands, is resting in the press.

verses.sa:
क्रीडुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि ।
दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
kridurmakho na mamhayuh pavitram soma gachchhasi |
dadhatstotre suviryam ||
verses.en: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest. Soma to the sieve, Lending the laud heroic strength.

verses.sa:
यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टंपुष्टं परि स्रव ।
विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ॥
verses.rom:
yavamyavam no andhasa pushtampushtam pari srava |
vishva cha soma saubhaga ||
verses.en: Pour on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment! And, Soma, all felicities!

verses.sa:
इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः ।
नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥
verses.rom:
indo yatha tava stavo yatha te jatamandhasah |
ni barhishi priye sadah ||
verses.en: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from, the juice, Seat thee on the dear sacred grass!

verses.sa:
उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा ।
मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no govidashvavitpavasva somandhasa |
makshutamebhirahabhih ||
verses.en: And, finding for us steeds and kine, O Soma, with thy juice flow on Through days that fly most rapidly!

verses.sa:
यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य ।
स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥
verses.rom:
yo jinati na jiyate hanti shatrumabhitya |
sa pavasva sahasrajit ||
verses.en: As one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and slays the enemy, Thus, vanquisher of thousands! flow!

verses.sa:
यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये ।
ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste dhara madhushchuto'srigraminda utaye |
tabhih pavitramasadah ||
verses.en: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।
सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
so arshendraya pitaye tiro varanyavyaya |
sidannritasya yonima ||
verses.en: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow to be his drink, Seating thee in the shrine of Law!

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः ।
वरिवोविद्धृतं पयः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma pari srava svadishtho angirobhyah |
varivoviddhritam payah ||
verses.en: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, O Soma, for the Angirasas!

verses.sa:
तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतोग्नेश्चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयः ।
यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमासनि ॥
verses.rom:
tava shriyo varshyasyeva vidyutogneshchikitra ushasamivetayah |
yadoshadhirabhisrishto vanani cha pari svayam chinushe annamasani ||
verses.en: Thy glories are, like lightnings from the rainy cloud, visible, Agni, like the comings of the Dawns, When, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.

verses.sa:
वातोपजूत इषितो वशां अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे ।
आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो३ यथा पृथक्शर्धांस्यग्ने अजरस्य धक्षतः ॥
verses.rom:
vatopajuta ishito vasham anu trishu yadanna vevishadvitishthase |
a te yatante rathyo3 yatha prithakshardhamsyagne ajarasya dhakshatah ||
verses.en: When, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, soon piercing through thy food according to thy will, The hosts, who ne'er decayest, eager to consume, like men on chariots, Agni! strive on every side.

verses.sa:
मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निं होतारं परिभूतरं मतिं ।
त्वामर्भस्य हविषः समानमित्तवां महो वृणते नान्यं त्वत् ॥
verses.rom:
medhakaram vidathasya prasadhanamagnim hotaram paribhutaram matim |
tvamarbhasya havishah samanamittavam maho vrinate nanyam tvat ||
verses.en: Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, waker of wisdom, chief controller of the thought- Thee, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect priest of the holy offering, great and small, alike.

verses.sa:
पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण ।
मित्र वंसि वां सुमतिं ॥
verses.rom:
pururuna chiddhyastyavo nunam vam varuna |
mitra vamsi vam sumatim ||
verses.en: Even far and wide, O Varuna and Mitra, doth your help extend: May I obtain your kind good-will!

verses.sa:
ता वां सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धाम च ।
वयं वां मित्रा स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam samyagadruhvaneshamashyama dhama cha |
vayam vam mitra syama ||
verses.en: True Gods, may we completely gain food and a dwelling place from you: Ye Mitras, may we be your own!

verses.sa:
पातं नो मित्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथां सुत्रात्रा ।
साह्याम दस्यूं तनूभिः ॥
verses.rom:
patam no mitra payubhiruta trayetham sutratra |
sahyama dasyum tanubhih ||
verses.en: Guard us, ye Mitras, with your guards, save us, ye skilled to save: may we Subdue the Dasyus by ourselves!

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वा शिप्रे अवेपयः ।
सोममिन्द्र चमूसुतं ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthannojasa saha pitva shipre avepayah |
somamindra chamusutam ||
verses.en: Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest Indra, having drunk The Soma which the press had shed.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे स्पर्धमानमददेतां ।
इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥
verses.rom:
anu tva rodasi ubhe spardhamanamadadetam |
indra yaddasyuhabhavah ||
verses.en: Indra, both world gave place to thee as thou wast fighting, when thou wast The slayer of the Dasyu hosts.

verses.sa:
वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतावृधं ।
इन्द्रात्परितन्वं ममे ॥
verses.rom:
vachamashtapadimaham navasraktimritavridham |
indratparitanvam mame ||
verses.en: From Indra, have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, strengthening the Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी युवामिमे३ऽभि स्तोमा अनूषत ।
पिबतं शम्भुवा सुतं ॥
verses.rom:
indragni yuvamime3'bhi stoma anushata |
pibatam shambhuva sutam ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, these our songs of praise have sounded forth to you: Ye who bring blessings! drink the juice

verses.sa:
या वां सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा ।
इन्द्राग्नी ताभिरा गतं ॥
verses.rom:
ya vam santi puruspriho niyuto dashushe nara |
indragni tabhira gatam ||
verses.en: Come, Indra, Agni, with those teams, desired of many, which ye have, O heroes, for the worshipper

verses.sa:
ताभिरा गच्छतं नरोपेदं सवनं सुतं ।
इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tabhira gachchhatam naropedam savanam sutam |
indragni somapitaye ||
verses.en: With those to his libation poured, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, come: Come ye to drink the Soma-juice!

verses.sa:
अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् ।
सीदन्योनौ वनेष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
arsha soma dyumattamo'bhi dronani roruvat |
sidanyonau vaneshva ||
verses.en: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the reservoirs, Resting in wooden vats thy home!

verses.sa:
अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
apsa indraya vayave varunaya marudbhyah |
soma arshantu vishnave ||
verses.en: Let water winning Somas flow to Indra, Vayu, Varuna, To Vishnu and Marut host!

verses.sa:
इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.rom:
isham tokaya no dadhadasmabhyam soma vishvatah |
a pavasva sahasrinam ||
verses.en: Soma, bestowing food upon our progeny, from every side Pour on us riches thousandfold.

verses.sa:
सोम उ ष्वाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनां ।
अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया ॥
verses.rom:
soma u shvanah sotribhiradhi shnubhiravinam |
ashvayeva harita yati dharaya mandraya yati dharaya ||
verses.en: Pressed out by pressers Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, Goes even as with a mare in tawny-coloured stream, goes in a sweetly-sounding stream.

verses.sa:
अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः ।
समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मन्दी मदाय तोशते ॥
verses.rom:
anupe gomangobhirakshah somo dugdhabhirakshah |
samudram na samvarananyagmanmandi madaya toshate ||
verses.en: Down to the water Soma, rich in kine, bath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. They have approached the mixing-vessels as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.

verses.sa:
(ग्रामगेयः)
यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु ।
तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
(gramageyah)
yatsoma chitramukthyam divyam parthivam vasu |
tannah punana a bhara ||
verses.en: O Purifying Soma, bring to us the wondrous treasure, meet. For lauds, that is in earth and heaven!

verses.sa:
वृषा पुनान आयूंषि स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि ।
हरिः सन्योनिमासदः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha punana ayumshi stanayannadhi barhishi |
harih sanyonimasadah ||
verses.en: Cleansing the lives of men, thou, Steer, bellowing on the sacred grass, Gold-hued, hast settled in thy home.

verses.sa:
युवं हि स्थः स्वःपती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती ।
ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam hi sthah svahpati indrashcha soma gopati |
ishana pipyatam dhiyah ||
verses.en: For ye twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of heaven's light, Lords of the kine: Prosper, as mighty ones, our prayers

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः ।
तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतिमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत् ॥
verses.rom:
indro madaya vavridhe shavase vritraha nribhih |
taminmahatsvajishutimarbhe havamahe sa vajeshu pra no'vishat ||
verses.en: By men hath Indra been advanced, the Vritra-sIayer, to joy and strength. Him only we invoke for help in battles whether great or small be he our aid in deeds or might!

verses.sa:
असि हि वीर सेन्योऽसि भूरि पराददिः ।
असि दभ्रस्य चिद्वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु ॥
verses.rom:
asi hi vira senyo'si bhuri paradadih |
asi dabhrasya chidvridho yajamanaya shikshasi sunvate bhuri te vasu ||
verses.en: For, hero, thou art like a host, art giver of abundant spoil. Strengthening e'en the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest great wealth to him who pours.

verses.sa:
यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धनां ।
युङ्क्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्मां इन्द्र वसौ दधः ॥
verses.rom:
yadudirata ajayo dhrishnave dhiyate dhanam |
yunkshva madachyuta hari kam hanah kam vasau dadho'smam indra vasau dadhah ||
verses.en: When war and battles are on foot, booty is offered to the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing bays! Whom wilt thou slay, and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich!

verses.sa:
स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मध्वः पिबन्ति गौर्यः ।
या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभसे वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
svadorittha vishuvato madhvah pibanti gauryah |
ya indrena sayavarirvrishna madanti shobhase vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en: The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright cows drink, Who travelling in splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः ।
प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रं हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
ta asya prishanayuvah somam shrinanti prishnayah |
priya indrasya dhenavo vajram hinvanti sayakam vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en: Craving his touch the dappled kine mingle the Soma with their milk. The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death dealing thunder-bolt, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः ।
व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यं ॥
verses.rom:
ta asya namasa sahah saparyanti prachetasah |
vratanyasya sashchire puruni purvachittaye vasviranu svarajyam ||
verses.en: With veneration, passing wise, they honour his victorious might. They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
असाव्यंशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः ।
श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asavyamshurmadayapsu daksho girishthah |
shyeno na yonimasadat ||
verses.en: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy. Hawk-like he settles in his home.

verses.sa:
शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धौतं नृभिः सुतं ।
स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shubhramandho devavatamapsu dhautam nribhih sutam |
svadanti gavah payobhih ||
verses.en: Fair is the juice beloved of Gods, washed in the waters, pressed by men: The milch kine sweeten it with milk

verses.sa:
आदीमश्वं न हेतारमशूशुभन्नमृताय ।
मधो रसं सधमादे ॥
verses.rom:
adimashvam na hetaramashushubhannamritaya |
madho rasam sadhamade ||
verses.en: Then, like a steed, have they adorned the inciter for eternal life, The meath's juice at the festival.

verses.sa:
अभि द्युम्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दीदिहि देव देवयुं ।
वि कोशं मध्यमं युव ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dyumnam brihadyasha ishaspate didihi deva devayum |
vi kosham madhyamam yuva ||
verses.en: Make high and splendid glory shine hitherward, Lord of food, God, on the friend of Gods Unclose the cask of middle air

verses.sa:
आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः ।
वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपो जिन्वन्गविष्टये धियः ॥
verses.rom:
a vachyasva sudaksha chamvoh suto visham vahnirna vishpatih |
vrishtim divah pavasva ritimapo jinvangavishtaye dhiyah ||
verses.en: Roll onward from the press, O mighty one, effused, as kings, supporter of the tribes Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the water's flow, urging our thoughts to win the spoil!

verses.sa:
प्राणा शिशुर्महीनां हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिं ।
विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता ॥
verses.rom:
prana shishurmahinam hinvannritasya didhitim |
vishva pari priya bhuvadadha dvita ||
verses.en: Breath of the mighty Dames, the Child, speeding the plan of sacrifice, Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.

verses.sa:
उप त्रितस्य पाष्यो३रभक्त यद्गुहा पदं ।
यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियं ॥
verses.rom:
upa tritasya pashyo3rabhakta yadguha padam |
yajnasya sapta dhamabhiradha priyam ||
verses.en: The place that is concealed hath gained a share of Trita's pressing-stones, By the seven laws of sacrifice, even that dear place.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्टेष्वैरयद्रयिं ।
मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
trini tritasya dharaya prishteshvairayadrayim |
mimite asya yojana vi sukratuh ||
verses.en: He hath sent forth unto the heights the three, in stream, as Trita's wealth: He who is passing wise measures his pathways out.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाजसातये पवित्रे धारया सुतः ।
इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vajasataye pavitre dharaya sutah |
indraya soma vishnave devebhyo madhumattarah ||
verses.en: Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, to win us spoil and wealth, Soma exceeding rich in meath for Indra, Vishnu, and the Gods

verses.sa:
त्वां रिहन्ति धीतयो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः ।
वत्सं जातं न मातरः पवमान विधर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam rihanti dhitayo harim pavitre adruhah |
vatsam jatam na matarah pavamana vidharmani ||
verses.en: The hymns that know not guile, caress thee, golden-coloured, in the sieve. As mothers, Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.

verses.sa:
त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे ।
प्रति द्रापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dyam cha mahivrata prithivim chati jabhrishe |
prati drapimamunchathah pavamana mahitvana ||
verses.en: Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth. Thou, of Pavamana, hast assumed thy coat of mail with majesty.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय ।
हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातिं वरिवस्कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
indurvaji pavate gonyogha indre somah saha invanmadaya |
hanti raksho badhate paryaratim varivaskrinvanvrijanasya raja ||
verses.en: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, for his carousal. He quells malignity and slays the demons, King of the homestead, he who gives us comfort.

verses.sa:
अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः ।
इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
adha dharaya madhva prichanastiro roma pavate adridugdhah |
indurindrasya sakhyam jushano devo devasya matsaro madaya ||
verses.en: Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter-- Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens for the God's enjoyment.

verses.sa:
अभि व्रतानि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्त्स्वेन रसेन पृञ्चन् ।
इन्दुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vratani pavate punano devo devantsvena rasena princhan |
indurdharmanyritutha vasano dasha kshipo avyata sano avye ||
verses.en: He flows, as he is cleansed, to sacred duties, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices. Indu hath, clothed in powers that suit the season, on the raised fleece engaged the ten swift fingers.

verses.sa:
आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरं ।
युद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a te agna idhimahi dyumantam devajaram |
yuddha sya te paniyasi samiddidayati dyavisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: O Agni, God, we kindle thee, refulgent, wasting not away, That this more glorious fuel may send forth for thee its shine to heaven. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविः शुक्रस्य ज्योतिषस्पते ।
सुश्चन्द्र दस्म विश्पते हव्यवाट्तुभ्यं हूयत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a te agna richa havih shukrasya jyotishaspate |
sushchandra dasma vishpate havyavattubhyam huyata isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: To thee the splendid, Lord of light! bright! wondrous! prince of men! is brought. Oblation with the holy verse, O Agni, bearer of our gifts! Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
ओभे सुश्चन्द्र विश्पते दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि ।
उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
obhe sushchandra vishpate darvi shrinisha asani |
uto na utpupurya uktheshu shavasaspata isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: Thou heatest both the ladles in thy mouth, O brilliant prince of men! So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, thou Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् ।
ब्रह्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya sama gayata vipraya brihate brihat |
brahmakrite vipashchite panasyave ||
verses.en: Sing ye a psalm to Indra; sing a great song to the lofty Sage, To him who maketh prayer, inspired, who loveth laud.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः ।
विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महां असि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindrabhibhurasi tvam suryamarochayah |
vishvakarma vishvadevo maham asi ||
verses.en: Thou, Indra, art the conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art mighty and All-God.

verses.sa:
विभ्राजं ज्योतिषा त्व३रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः ।
देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
vibhrajam jyotisha tva3ragachchho rochanam divah |
devasta indra sakhyaya yemire ||
verses.en: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of -heaven. The Gods, O Indra, strove to win thy friendly love.

verses.sa:
असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि ।
आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियं रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
asavi soma indra te shavishtha dhrishnava gahi |
a tva prinaktvindriyam rajah suryo na rashmibhih ||
verses.en: This Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra, bold one, mightiest, come! May Indra vigour fill thee full, as Surya fills mid-air with rays

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी ।
अर्वाचीनं सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना ॥
verses.rom:
a tishtha vritrahanratham yukta te brahmana hari |
arvachinam su te mano grava krinotu vagnuna ||
verses.en: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car! The bay steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतोऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसं ।
ऋषीणां सुष्टुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणां ॥
verses.rom:
indramiddhari vahato'pratidhrishtashavasam |
rishinam sushtutirupa yajnam cha manushanam ||
verses.en: His pair of tawny coursers bring Indra, resistless in his might. Hither to Rishis' songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः ।
दधाति रत्नं स्वधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः ॥
verses.rom:
jyotiryajnasya pavate madhu priyam pita devanam janita vibhuvasuh |
dadhati ratnam svadhayorapichyam madintamo matsara indriyo rasah ||
verses.en: Light of the sacrifice, be pours delicious meathp most wealthy, father and begetter of the Gods. He, gladdening, best of cheerers, juice that Indra loves, enriches with mysterious treasure earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अभिक्रन्दन्कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः ।
हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्मृजानोऽविभिः सिन्धुभिर्वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
abhikrandankalasham vajyarshati patirdivah shatadharo vichakshanah |
harirmitrasya sadaneshu sidati marmrijano'vibhih sindhubhirvrisha ||
verses.en: The Lord of heaven, the vigorous and far-seeing one, flowsshouting to the beaker with his thousand streams. Coloured like gold he rests in seats where Mitra dwells, the Steer made beautiful by rivers and by sheep.

verses.sa:
अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गच्छसि ।
अग्रे वाजस्य भजसे महद्धनं स्वायुधः सोतृभिः सोम सूयसे ॥
verses.rom:
agre sindhunam pavamano arshatyagre vacho agriyo goshu gachchhasi |
agre vajasya bhajase mahaddhanam svayudhah sotribhih soma suyase ||
verses.en: As Pavamana thou flowest before the streams: thou goest on, before the hymn, before the kine. Thou sharest mighty booty in the van of war Soma, well-armed, thou art pressed out by men who press.

verses.sa:
असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया ।
शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥
verses.rom:
asrikshata pra vajino gavya somaso ashvaya |
shukraso virayashavah ||
verses.en: Through our desire of heroes, kine, and horses, vigorous Somadrops, Brilliant and swift, have been effused.

verses.sa:
शुम्भमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः ।
पवन्ते वारे अव्यये ॥
verses.rom:
shumbhamana ritayubhirmrijyamana gabhastyoh |
pavante vare avyaye ||
verses.en: They, beautified by holy men and purified in both the hands, Are flowing through the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa:
ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।
पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
verses.rom:
te vishva dashushe vasu soma divyani parthiva |
pavantamantarikshya ||
verses.en: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper, From heaven and earth and firmament.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या ।
इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva devavirati pavitram soma ramhya |
indramindo vrisha visha ||
verses.en: Flow, Soma, Indu, dear to Gods, swift through the purifying sieve, And enter fndra in thy strength

verses.sa:
आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः ।
आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥
verses.rom:
a vachyasva mahi psaro vrishendo dyumnavattamah |
a yonim dharnasih sadah ||
verses.en: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid steer: Sit in thy place as one with power

verses.sa:
अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः ।
अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
adhukshata priyam madhu dhara sutasya vedhasah |
apo vasishta sukratuh ||
verses.en: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice: The Sage drew waters to himself.

verses.sa:
महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ।
यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
mahantam tva mahiranvapo arshanti sindhavah |
yadgobhirvasayishyase ||
verses.en: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee mighty one, When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.

verses.sa:
समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः ।
सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
samudro apsu mamrije vishtambho dharuno divah |
somah pavitre asmayuh ||
verses.en: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our friend, heaven's prop and stay, Falls on the purifying cloth.

verses.sa:
अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः ।
सं सूर्येण दिद्युते ॥
verses.rom:
achikradadvrisha harirmahanmitro na darshatah |
sam suryena didyute ||
verses.en: The tawny Bull hath bellowed. fair as mighty Mitra to behold He gleams and flashes with the Sun.

verses.sa:
गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः ।
याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ॥
verses.rom:
girasta inda ojasa marmrijyante apasyuvah |
yabhirmadaya shumbhase ||
verses.en: Songs, Indra, active in their might, are beautified for thee, wherewith Thou deckest thee for rapturous joy.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे ।
तव प्रशस्तये महे ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva madaya ghrishvaya u lokakritnumimahe |
tava prashastaye mahe ||
verses.en: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the wild delight, That Thou mayst have exalted praise,

verses.sa:
गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत ।
आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥
verses.rom:
gosha indo nrisha asyashvasa vajasa uta |
atma yajnasya purvyah ||
verses.en: Winner of kine Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and spoil: Primeval soul of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रियं मधोः पवस्व धारया ।
पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमां इव ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyamindavindriyam madhoh pavasva dharaya |
parjanyo vrishtimam iva ||
verses.en: Pour on us, Indu! Indra-strength with a full stream of sweetness, like Parianya, sender of the rain!

verses.sa:
सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sana cha soma jeshi cha pavamana mahi shravah |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, be victorious, win us high renown; And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
सना ज्योतिः सना स्वा३र्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sana jyotih sana sva3rvishva cha soma saubhaga |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities; And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sana dakshamuta kratumapa soma mridho jahi |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Win skilful strength and mental power! O Soma, drive away our foes; And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
pavitarah punitana somamindraya patave |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink; Make thou us better than we are!

verses.sa:
त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam surye na a bhaja tava kratva tavotibhih |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids; And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यं ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tava kratva tavotibhirjyokpashyema suryam |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Through thine own mental power and aids long may we look upon the Sun: Make thou us better than we are!

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिं ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha svayudha soma dvibarhasam rayim |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to us a stream of riches doubly great; And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
अभ्या३र्षानपच्युतो वाजिन्त्समत्सु सासहिः ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
abhya3rshanapachyuto vajintsamatsu sasahih |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: As one victorious unsubdued in battle, pour forth wealth to us: And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yajnairavivridhanpavamana vidharmani |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: With offerings, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee as Law commands: Make thou us better than we are!

verses.sa:
रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
rayim nashchitramashvinamindo vishvayuma bhara |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds brilliant and quickening all life; And make us better than we are!

verses.sa:
तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
taratsa mandi dhavati dhara sutasyandhasah |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en: Swift runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्त्तस्य देव्यवसः ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
usra veda vasunam marttasya devyavasah |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
dhvasrayoh purushantyora sahasrani dadmahe |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Purusbanti's hands: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
a yayostrimshatam tana sahasrani cha dadmahe |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three-times ten besides: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः शवसे महे ।
मदिन्तमस्य धारया ॥
verses.rom:
ete soma asrikshata grinanah shavase mahe |
madintamasya dharaya ||
verses.en: Forth with his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured, Lauded with songs for mighty strength.

verses.sa:
अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि ।
सनद्वाजः परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gavyani vitaye nrimna punano arshasi |
sanadvajah pari srava ||
verses.en: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being, cleansed: Winning the spoil flow hitherward

verses.sa:
उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः ।
गृणानो जमदग्निना ॥
verses.rom:
uta no gomatirisho vishva arsha parishtubhah |
grinano jamadagnina ||
verses.en: And, hymned by Jamadagni, let all nourishment that kine supply, And general praises, flow to us!

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया ।
भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य संसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
imam stomamarhate jatavedase rathamiva sam mahema manishaya |
bhadra hi nah pramatirasya samsadyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car. For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

verses.sa:
भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवींषि ते चितयन्तः पर्वणापर्वणा वयं ।
जीवातवे प्रतरं साधया धियोऽग्ने सख्ये म रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
bharamedhmam krinavama havimshi te chitayantah parvanaparvana vayam |
jivatave prataram sadhaya dhiyo'gne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en: We will bring fuel and prepare our sacred gifts, reminding thee at each successive holy time. Fulfil our thoughts that we may lengthen out our lives Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

verses.sa:
शकेम त्वा समिधं साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतं ।
त्वमादित्यां आ वह तान्ह्यू३श्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
shakema tva samidham sadhaya dhiyastve deva haviradantyahutam |
tvamadityam a vaha tanhyu3shmasyagne sakhye ma rishama vayam tava ||
verses.en: May we have power to kindle thee! Fulfil our prayers in thee the Gods eat the presented sacrifice. Bring hither the Adityas, for we long for them! Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

verses.sa:
प्रति वां सूर उदिते मित्रं गृणीषे वरुणं ।
अर्यमणं रिशादसं ॥
verses.rom:
prati vam sura udite mitram grinishe varunam |
aryamanam rishadasam ||
verses.en: Soon as the Sun hath risen I sing to you, to Mitra, Varuna, And Aryaman who slays the foe.

verses.sa:
राया हिरण्यया मतिरियमवृकाय शवसे ।
इयं विप्रामेधसातये ॥
verses.rom:
raya hiranyaya matiriyamavrikaya shavase |
iyam vipramedhasataye ||
verses.en: With wealth of gold may this my song bring unmolested might; may this, Sages! obtain the sacrifice!

verses.sa:
ते स्याम देव वरुण ते मित्र सूरिभिः सह ।
इषं स्वश्च धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
te syama deva varuna te mitra suribhih saha |
isham svashcha dhimahi ||
verses.en: May we be thine, God Varuna, and with our princes, Mitra, thine: May we gain food and heavenly light!

verses.sa:
भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
bhindhi vishva apa dvishah pari badho jahi mridhah |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long:

verses.sa:
यस्य ते विश्वमानुषग्भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te vishvamanushagbhurerdattasya vedati |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en: Of which the world shall know forthwith as given by thee abundantly: Bring us the wealth for which we long:

verses.sa:
यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतं ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
yadvidavindra yatsthire yatparshane parabhritam |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en: O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipito us: Bring us the wealth for which we long!

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु ।
इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya hi stha ritvija sasni vajeshu karmasu |
indragni tasya bodhatam ||
verses.en: Yea, ye are priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works Indra and Agni, mark this well!

verses.sa:
तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता ।
इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.rom:
toshasa rathayavana vritrahanaparajita |
indragni tasya bodhatam ||
verses.en: Bountiful, riders on the car, slayers of Vritra unsubdued, Indra and Agni, mark this well!

verses.sa:
इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः ।
इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतं ॥
verses.rom:
idam vam madiram madhvadhukshannadribhirnarah |
indragni tasya bodhatam ||
verses.en: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight: Indra and Agni, mark this well!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ।
अर्कस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.rom:
indrayendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamah |
arkasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in meath, To seat thee in the place of song!

verses.sa:
तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिं ।
सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vipra vachovidah parishkrinvanti dharnasim |
sam tva mrijantyayavah ||
verses.en: Sage: who know the lore of speech deck thee, the strong sustainer, well: Men make thee bright and beautiful.

verses.sa:
रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्तु वरुणः कवे ।
पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
verses.rom:
rasam te mitro aryama pibantu varunah kave |
pavamanasya marutah ||
verses.en: Let Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine. Sage! let the Maruts drink thereof.

verses.sa:
मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि ।
रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
mrijyamanah suhastya samudre vachaminvasi |
rayim pishangam bahulam puruspriham pavamanabhyarshasi ||
verses.en: Deft-handed! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea. Thou, Pavamana makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desired.

verses.sa:
पुनानो वारे पवमानो अव्यये वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने ।
देवानां सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
punano vare pavamano avyaye vrisho achikradadvane |
devanam soma pavamana nishkritam gobhiranjano arshasi ||
verses.en: Made pure, as Pavamana, in the sheep's long wool, the Steer bath bellowed in the vat. Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana! balmed with 'milk unto the meeting-place of Gods.

verses.sa:
एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरं ।
समादित्येभिरख्यत ॥
verses.rom:
etamu tyam dasha kshipo mrijanti sindhumataram |
samadityebhirakhyata ||
verses.en: Him here, the offspring of the sea, the ten swift fingers beautify: With the Adityas is he seen.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ ।
सं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
samindrenota vayuna suta eti pavitra a |
sam suryasya rashmibhih ||
verses.en: With Indra and with Vayu he, effused, flows onward with the beams Of Surya to the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् ।
चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bhagaya vayave pushne pavasva madhuman |
charurmitre varune cha ||
verses.en: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vayu, Pushan, fair For Mitra and for Varuna!

verses.sa:
रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः ।
क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
revatirnah sadhamada indre santu tuvivajah |
kshumanto yabhirmadema ||
verses.en: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice!

verses.sa:
आ घ त्वावां त्मना युक्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवीयानः ।
ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः ॥
verses.rom:
a gha tvavam tmana yuktah stotribhyo dhrishnaviyanah |
rinoraksham na chakryoh ||
verses.en: Like thee, thyself, for singers yoked, thou movest, as it were besought, Bold one, the axle of the car,

verses.sa:
आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरित्ऱीणां ।
ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a yadduvah shatakratava kamam jaritrinam |
rinoraksham na shachibhih ||
verses.en: That, Satakratu, thou, to serve and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.

verses.sa:
सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे ।
जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
verses.rom:
surupakritnumutaye sudughamiva goduhe |
juhumasi dyavidyavi ||
verses.en: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds, To our assistance day by day.

verses.sa:
उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब ।
गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
upa nah savana gahi somasya somapah piba |
goda idrevato madah ||
verses.en: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma, Soma-drinker! yea, The rich one's rapture giveth kine.

verses.sa:
अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनां ।
मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
atha te antamanam vidyama sumatinam |
ma no ati khya a gahi ||
verses.en: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not; come hitherward!

verses.sa:
उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव ।
महान्तं त्वा महीनां सम्राजं चर्षणीनां ।
देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe yadindra rodasi apaprathosha iva |
mahantam tva mahinam samrajam charshaninam |
devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en: As, like the Morning, thou has filled, O Indra, both the earth and heaven, So as the mighty one, great King of all the mighty race of men, the Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
दीर्घं ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः ।
पूर्वेण मघवन्पदा वयामजो यथा यमः ।
देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
dirgham hyankusham yatha shaktim bibharshi mantumah |
purvena maghavanpada vayamajo yatha yamah |
devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en: Thou bearest in thine hand a lance like a long hook, great counsellor. As with his foremost foot a goat, draw down the branch O Maghavan. The Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
अव स्म दुर्हृणायतो मर्त्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरं ।
अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्मां अभिदासति ।
देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ava sma durhrinayato marttasya tanuhi sthiram |
adhaspadam tamim kridhi yo asmam abhidasati |
devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en: Relax that mortal's stubborn strength whose heart is bent on wickedness. Trample him down beneath thy feet who watches for and aims at us. The Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
परि स्वानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षरत् ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
pari svano girishthah pavitre somo aksharat |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en: Soma, the dweller on the hills, effused, hath flowed into the sieve. All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam viprastvam kavirmadhu pra jatamandhasah |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en: Thou art a holy bard, a Sage; the meath offspring of thy sap: All bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
त्वे विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
tve vishve sajoshaso devasah pitimashata |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en: All-d6ties of one accorcl have come that they may drink of thee: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इडानां ।
सोमो यः सुक्षितीनां ॥
verses.rom:
sa sunve yo vasunam yo rayamaneta ya idanam |
somo yah sukshitinam ||
verses.en: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us store of wealth, and sweet refreshing food, Soma who brings us quiet homes:

verses.sa:
यस्य त इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः ।
आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya ta indrah pibadyasya maruto yasya varyamana bhagah |
a yena mitravaruna karamaha endramavase mahe ||
verses.en: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryaman, By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuna, and Indra for our great defence.

verses.sa:
तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत ।
शिशुं न हव्यैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vah sakhayo madaya punanamabhi gayata |
shishum na havyaih svadayanta gurtibhih ||
verses.en: Friends, hymn your Lord who makes him pure for rapturous carouse: let them Sweeten him, as a child, with lauds and sacred gifts

verses.sa:
सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते ।
देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
sam vatsa iva matribhirindurhinvano ajyate |
devavirmado matibhih parishkritah ||
verses.en: Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent, Glorified by our hymns;, the god-delighting juice.

verses.sa:
अयं दक्षाय साधनोऽयं शर्धाय वीतये ।
अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तरः सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam dakshaya sadhano'yam shardhaya vitaye |
ayam devebhyo madhumattarah sutah ||
verses.en: Effectual help to power is he. he is a banquet for the troop, He who hath been effused, more rich in meath, for Gods.

verses.sa:
सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः ।
मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
somah pavanta indavo'smabhyam gatuvittamah |
mitrah suvana arepasah svadhyah svarvidah ||
verses.en: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of weal, Effused as friends, without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.

verses.sa:
ते पूतासो विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
सूरासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते ॥
verses.rom:
te putaso vipashchitah somaso dadhyashirah |
suraso na darshataso jigatnavo dhruva ghrite ||
verses.en: These Soma juices, skill.ed in song, purified, blent with milk and curd, Hastening on and firmly set in oil resemble beauteous suns.

verses.sa:
सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि ।
इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः ॥
verses.rom:
sushvanaso vyadribhishchitana goradhi tvachi |
ishamasmabhyamabhitah samasvaranvasuvidah ||
verses.en: Effused by means of pressing- stones, upon the oxhide visible, They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side.

verses.sa:
अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि मांश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व ।
ब्रघ्नश्चिद्यस्य वातो न जूतिं पुरुमेधाश्चित्तकवे नरं धात् ॥
verses.rom:
aya pava pavasvaina vasuni mamshchatva indo sarasi pra dhanva |
braghnashchidyasya vato na jutim purumedhashchittakave naram dhat ||
verses.en: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu! Here, too, the bright one, wind-swift, full of wisdom, shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.

verses.sa:
उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय ॥
verses.rom:
uta na ena pavaya pavasvadhi shrute shravayyasya tirthe |
shashtim sahasra naiguto vasuni vriksham na pakvam dhunavadranaya ||
verses.en: Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory! May the foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree's ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures!

verses.sa:
महीमे अस्य वृष नाम शूषे मांश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे ।
अस्वापयन्निगुतः स्नेहयच्चापामित्रां अपाचितो अचेतः ॥
verses.rom:
mahime asya vrisha nama shushe mamshchatve va prishane va vadhatre |
asvapayannigutah snehayachchapamitram apachito achetah ||
verses.en: Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prisana, wrought in battle. He sent our enemies to sleep and slew them, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः ॥
verses.rom: agne tvam no antama uta trata shivo bhuvo varuthyah ||

verses.sa: वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमो रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom: vasuragnirvasushrava achchha nakshi dyumattamo rayim dah ||

verses.sa: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom: tam tva shochishtha didivah sumnaya nunamimahe sakhibhyah ||

verses.sa: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.rom: ima nu kam bhuvana sishadhemendrashcha vishve cha devah ||

verses.sa: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह सीषधातु ॥
verses.rom: yajnam cha nastanvam cha prajam chadityairindrah saha sishadhatu ||

verses.sa: आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मभ्यं भेषजा करत् ॥
verses.rom: adityairindrah sagano marudbhirasmabhyam bheshaja karat ||

verses.sa: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते ॥
verses.rom: pra va indraya vritrahantamaya vipraya gatham gayata yam jujoshate ||

verses.sa: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom: archantyarkam marutah svarka a stobhati shruto yuva sa indrah ||

verses.sa: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र ॥
verses.rom: upa prakshe madhumati kshiyantah pushyema rayim dhimahe ta indra ||

prose.en:
O Agni, be our nearest friend, yea, our protector and our kind deliverer!

As gracious Agni, famed for treasures, come, and, most resplendent, give us store of wealth!

To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.

verses.sa:
प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ।
महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
pra kavyamushaneva bruvano devo devanam janima vivakti |
mahivratah shuchibandhuh pavakah pada varaho abhyeti rebhan ||
verses.en: The God declares the deities' generations, like Usana, proclaiming lofty wisdom. With brilliant kin far-ruling, sanctifying, the wild boar, singing with his foot, advances.

verses.sa:
प्र हंसासस्तृपला वग्नुमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः ।
आङ्गोषिणं पवमानं सखायो दुर्मर्षं वाणं प्र वदन्ति साकं ॥
verses.rom:
pra hamsasastripala vagnumachchhamadastam vrishagana ayasuh |
angoshinam pavamanam sakhayo durmarsham vanam pra vadanti sakam ||
verses.en: The swans, the Vrishagnas from anear us, restless, have brought their clamour to our dwelling-- Friends come to Pavamana, meet for praises-and sound in concert their resistless music.

verses.sa:
स योजत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीडन्तं मिमते न गावः ।
परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृङ्गो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः ॥
verses.rom:
sa yojata urugayasya jutim vritha kridantam mimate na gavah |
parinasam krinute tigmashringo diva harirdadrishe naktamrijrah ||
verses.en: He takes the swiftness of the great Far strider: cows low as, 'twere to him who sports at pleasure. He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the silvery shines by night, by day the golden.

verses.sa:
प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न अवस्यवः ।
सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra svanaso ratha ivarvanto na avasyavah |
somaso raye akramuh ||
verses.en: Like cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown, Have Soma drops flowed forth for wealth.

verses.sa:
हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ।
भरासः कारिणामिव ॥
verses.rom:
hinvanaso ratha iva dadhanvire gabhastyoh |
bharasah karinamiva ||
verses.en: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed, Like joyful songs of singing-men.

verses.sa:
राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते ।
यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
rajano na prashastibhih somaso gobhiranjate |
yajno na sapta dhatribhih ||
verses.en: The Somas deck themselves with milk as kings are graced with eulogies, And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परि स्वानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा ।
मधो अर्षन्ति धारया ॥
verses.rom:
pari svanasa indavo madaya barhana gira |
madho arshanti dharaya ||
verses.en: Pressed for the gladdening draught the drops flow forth abundantly with song, Flow with the stream of savoury juice.

verses.sa:
आपानासो विवस्वतो जिन्वन्त उषसो भगं ।
सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
apanaso vivasvato jinvanta ushaso bhagam |
sura anvam vi tanvate ||
verses.en: Winning Vivasvan's glory and speeding the light of Dawn, the suns, Pass through the openings of the cloth.

verses.sa:
अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः ।
वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥
verses.rom:
apa dvara matinam pratna rinvanti karavah |
vrishno harasa ayavah ||
verses.en: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs-- The men who bring the mighty One.

verses.sa:
समीचीनास आशत होतारः सप्तजानयः ।
पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥
verses.rom:
samichinasa ashata hotarah saptajanayah |
padamekasya pipratah ||
verses.en: In close society have come the priests, the sevenfold brotherhood, Filling the station of the One.

verses.sa:
नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुषा सूर्य दृशे ।
कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
nabha nabhim na a dade chakshusha surya drishe |
kaverapatyama duhe ||
verses.en: He makes us kin with Gods, he joins the Sun, for seeing, with mine eye; I milk the Sage's offspring forth.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियं दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितं ।
सूरः पस्यति चक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priyam divaspadamadhvaryubhirguha hitam |
surah pasyati chakshasa ||
verses.en: The Sun beholdeth with his eye the heaven's dear quarter which the priests Have set within the sacred cell.

verses.sa:
असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः ।
विदाना अस्य योजना ॥
verses.rom:
asrigramindavah patha dharmannritasya sushriyah |
vidana asya yojana ||
verses.en: Forth on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law, Knowing what suits this worshipper.

verses.sa:
प्र धारा मधो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते ।
हविर्हविःषु वन्द्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pra dhara madho agriyo mahirapo vi gahate |
havirhavihshu vandyah ||
verses.en: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of Meath, most excellent, Oblation best of all in worth.

verses.sa:
प्र युजा वाचो अग्रियो वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने ।
सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yuja vacho agriyo vrisho achikradadvane |
sadmabhi satyo adhvarah ||
verses.en: About the holy place the Steer, true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth, Continuous voices in the wood.

verses.sa:
परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षति ।
स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
pari yatkavya kavirnrimna punano arshati |
svarvaji sishasati ||
verses.en: When the Sage, purging manly deeds and lofty wisdom flows, around,

verses.sa:
पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति ।
यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano abhi spridho visho rajeva sidati |
yadimrinvanti vedhasah ||
verses.en: When purified, he sits enthroned as King over the warring clans. What time the sages speed him on.

verses.sa:
अव्या वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति ।
रेभो वनुष्यते मति ॥
verses.rom:
avya vare pari priyo harirvaneshu sidati |
rebho vanushyate mati ||
verses.en: Most dear, gold-coloured, in the fleece he sinks, and settles in the wood: The singer is besieged with song.

verses.sa:
स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति ।
रणा यो अस्य धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
sa vayumindramashvina sakam madena gachchhati |
rana yo asya dharmana ||
verses.en: He goes to Indra, Vayu, and the Asvins with the rapturous joy, To whomsoe'er his power delights.

verses.sa:
आ मित्रे वरुणे भगे मधोः पवन्त ऊर्मयः ।
विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a mitre varune bhage madhoh pavanta urmayah |
vidana asya shakmabhih ||
verses.en: The waves of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra, Varuna, Well knowing, through his mighty powers.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये ।
श्रवो वसूनि सञ्जितं ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam rodasi rayim madhvo vajasya sataye |
shravo vasuni sanjitam ||
verses.en: Gain for us, O ye Heaven and Earth, riches of Meath to win us strength: Gain for us treasures and renown.

verses.sa:
आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे ।
पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.rom:
a te daksham mayobhuvam vahnimadya vrinimahe |
pantama puruspriham ||
verses.en: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the strong, that brings us bliss, The guardian, the desire of all;

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणं ।
पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.rom:
a mandrama varenyama viprama manishinam |
pantama puruspriham ||
verses.en: The excellent, the gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands. The guardian, the desire of all;

verses.sa:
आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा ।
पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहं ॥
verses.rom:
a rayima suchetunama sukrato tanushva |
pantama puruspriham ||
verses.en: Who for ourselves, O thou most wise, is wealth and fair intelligence, The guardian, the desire of all.

verses.sa:
मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निं ।
कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
murdhanam divo aratim prithivya vaishvanaramrita a jatamagnim |
kavim samrajamatithim jananamasannah patram janayanta devah ||
verses.en: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the Sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.

verses.sa:
त्वां विश्वे अमृत जायमानं शिशुं न देवा अभि सं नवन्ते ।
तव क्रतुभिरमृतत्वमायन्वैश्वानर यत्पित्रोरदीदेः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishve amrita jayamanam shishum na deva abhi sam navante |
tava kratubhiramritatvamayanvaishvanara yatpitroradideh ||
verses.en: To thee, immortal! when to life thou springest all the Gods sing for joy as to their infant. They by thy mental powers were made immortal, Vaisvdnara when thou shonest from thy parents.

verses.sa:
नाभिं यज्ञानां सदनं रयीणां महामाहावमभि सं नवन्त ।
वैश्वानरं रथ्यमध्वराणां यज्ञस्य केतुं जनयन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
nabhim yajnanam sadanam rayinam mahamahavamabhi sam navanta |
vaishvanaram rathyamadhvaranam yajnasya ketum janayanta devah ||
verses.en: Him have they praised, mid-point of sacrifices, great cistern of libations, seat of riches. Vaisvanara, conveyer of oblations, ensign of worship, have the Gods engendered.

verses.sa:
प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा ।
महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mitraya gayata varunaya vipa gira |
mahikshatravritam brihat ||
verses.en: Sing forth unto your Varuna and Mitra with a song inspired: They, mighty Lords, are lofty law.

verses.sa:
सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च ।
देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता ॥
verses.rom:
samraja ya ghritayoni mitrashchobha varunashcha |
deva deveshu prashasta ||
verses.en: Full springs of fatness, sovran Kings, Mitra and Varuna, the twain, Gods glorified among the Gods,

verses.sa:
ता नः शक्तं पर्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य ।
महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
ta nah shaktam parthivasya maho rayo divyasya |
mahi vam kshatram deveshu ||
verses.en: So help ye us to riches, great celestial and terrestrial wealth! Vast is your sway among the Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः ।
अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi chitrabhano suta ime tvayavah |
anvibhistana putasah ||
verses.en: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by firie fingers purified!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः ।
उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi dhiyeshito viprajutah sutavatah |
upa brahmani vaghatah ||
verses.en: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come nigb, O Indra, to The sacrificing suppliant's pravers!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः ।
सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi tutujana upa brahmani harivah |
sute dadhishva nashchanah ||
verses.en: Approach, O Indra, basting thee, Lord of bay horses, to our prayers: In our libation t ake delight!

verses.sa:
तमीडिष्व यो अर्चिषा वना विश्वा परिष्वजत् ।
कृष्णा कृणोति जिह्वया ॥
verses.rom:
tamidishva yo archisha vana vishva parishvajat |
krishna krinoti jihvaya ||
verses.en: Glorify him who compasses all forests with his glowing Dame, And leaves them blackened by his tongue.

verses.sa:
य इद्ध आविवासति सुम्नमिन्द्रस्य मर्त्यः ।
द्युम्नाय सुतरा अपः ॥
verses.rom:
ya iddha avivasati sumnamindrasya martyah |
dyumnaya sutara apah ||
verses.en: He who gains Indra's grace by fire enkindled, finds as easy way Over the floods to splendid wealth.

verses.sa:
ता नो वाजवतीरिष आशून्पिपृतमर्वतः ।
एन्द्रमग्निं च वोढवे ॥
verses.rom:
ta no vajavatirisha ashunpipritamarvatah |
endramagnim cha vodhave ||
verses.en: Give us, ye twain, swift steeds to bring Indra and Agni, and bestow Abundant food with wealth on us.

verses.sa:
प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति सङ्गिरं ।
मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा ॥
verses.rom:
pro ayasidindurindrasya nishkritam sakha sakhyurna pra minati sangiram |
marya iva yuvatibhih samarshati somah kalashe shatayamna patha ||
verses.en: Indu hath started forth for Indra's settled place, and slights not,. as a friend, the promise of his friend. Soma comes onward like a youth with youthful maids, and gains the beaker by a course of hundred paths.

verses.sa:
प्र वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवरणेष्वक्रमुः ।
हरिं क्रीडन्तमभ्यनूषत स्तुभोऽभि धेनवः पयसेदशिश्रयुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo dhiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvah panasyuvah samvaraneshvakramuh |
harim kridantamabhyanushata stubho'bhi dhenavah payasedashishrayuh ||
verses.en: Your hymns of pleasant sound, praiseworthy, fond of lauds, have come into the hall enclosed for sacrifice. Singers have hymned the golden-coloured as he sports, and milchkine have come near to meet him with their milk,

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युषीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमान ऊर्मिणा ।
या नो दोहते त्रिरहन्नसश्चुषी क्षुमद्वाजवन्मधुमत्सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
a nah soma samyatam pipyushimishamindo pavasva pavamana urmina |
ya no dohate trirahannasashchushi kshumadvajavanmadhumatsuviryam ||
verses.en: O Soma, Indu, while they cleanse thee, with thy wave pour orb us plentiful accumulated food, Which, ceaseless, thrice a day shall yield us hero power enriched. with store of nourishment, and strength, and meath.

verses.sa:
न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधं ।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्त्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
na kishtam karmana nashadyashchakara sadavridham |
indram na yajnairvishvagurttamribhvasamadhrishtam dhrishnumojasa ||
verses.en: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might;

verses.sa:
अषाढमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः ।
सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामीरनोनवुः ॥
verses.rom:
ashadhamugram pritanasu sasahim yasminmahirurujrayah |
sam dhenavo jayamane anonavurdyavah kshamiranonavuh ||
verses.en: The powerful conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the mighty ones, The kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths sent their loud voices out.

verses.sa:
सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत ।
शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
sakhaya a ni shidata punanaya pra gayata |
shishum na yajnaih pari bhushata shriye ||
verses.en: Sit down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself: Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites

verses.sa:
समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनं ।
देवाव्या३ं मदमभि द्विशवसं ॥
verses.rom:
sami vatsam na matribhih srijata gayasadhanam |
devavya3m madamabhi dvishavasam ||
verses.en: Loose him who bringeth household wealth, even as a calf with. mother kine, Him who bath double strength, strong, god-delighting juice!

verses.sa:
पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये ।
यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शन्तमं ॥
verses.rom:
punata dakshasadhanam yatha shardhaya vitaye |
yatha mitraya varunaya shantamam ||
verses.en: Purify him who gives us power, most blissful one, that he may be A banquet for the troop, Mitra, and Varuna!

verses.sa: प्र वाज्यक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यं ॥
verses.rom: pra vajyakshah sahasradharastirah pavitram vi varamavyam ||
verses.en: The Strong hath flowed forth in a thousand streams, flowed through the filter and the sheep's long wool.

verses.sa: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः ॥
verses.rom: sa vajyakshah sahasrareta adbhirmrijano gobhih shrinanah ||
