verses.en: With ceaseless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.

verses.sa: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ॥
verses.rom: pra soma yahindrasya kuksha nribhiryemano adribhih sutah ||
verses.en: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go forth, O Soma, into Indra's throat!

verses.sa:
ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे ।
ये वादः शर्यणावति ॥
verses.rom:
ye somasah paravati ye arvavati sunvire |
ye vadah sharyanavati ||
verses.en: The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand, Or there on Saryanavan's bank,

verses.sa:
य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानां ।
ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु ॥
verses.rom:
ya arjikeshu kritvasu ye madhye pastyanam |
ye va janeshu panchasu ||
verses.en: Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in, men's homes, Or pressed among the Fivefold Tribes--

verses.sa:
ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यं ।
स्वाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
te no vrishtim divaspari pavantama suviryam |
svana devasa indavah ||
verses.en: May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow, Rain from the heavens and hero strength!

verses.sa:
आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् ।
अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
a te vatso mano yamatparamachchitsadhasthat |
agne tvam kamaye gira ||
verses.en: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.

verses.sa:
पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि दिशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः ।
समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
purutra hi sadrinnasi disho vishva anu prabhuh |
samatsu tva havamahe ||
verses.en: Thou art alike in many a place: through all the regions thou art Lord. In fray and fight we call on thee.

verses.sa:
समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे ।
वाजेषु चित्रराधसं ॥
verses.rom:
samatsvagnimavase vajayanto havamahe |
vajeshu chitraradhasam ||
verses.en: When we are seeking spoil we call Agni to help us in the strife, Giver of wordrous gifts in war.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे ।
आ वीरं पृतनासहं ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra bhara ojo nrimnam shatakrato vicharshane |
a viram pritanasaham ||
verses.en: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, 5atakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war!

verses.sa:
त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ ।
अथा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi nah pita vaso tvam mata shatakrato babhuvitha |
atha te sumnamimahe ||
verses.en: For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a mother and a sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.

verses.sa:
त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे सहस्कृत ।
स नो रास्व सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
tvam shushminpuruhuta vajayantamupa bruve sahaskrita |
sa no rasva suviryam ||
verses.en: To thee, strong! much-invoked! who showest forth thy strength, made very mighty! do I speak: So grant thou us heroic power!

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः ।
राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra chitra ma iha nasti tvadatamadrivah |
radhastanno vidadvasa ubhayahastya bhara ||
verses.en: Stone-Darting Indra, wonderous God, what wealth thou hast not given me here, That bounty, treasure-finder! bring, filling full both thy hands, to us!

verses.sa:
यन्मन्यसे वरेण्यमिन्द्र द्युक्षं तदा भर ।
विद्याम तस्य ते वयमकूपारस्य दावनः ॥
verses.rom:
yanmanyase varenyamindra dyuksham tada bhara |
vidyama tasya te vayamakuparasya davanah ||
verses.en: Bring what thou deemest worth the wish, O Indra that which is in heavem! So may we know thee as thou art a giver boundless in thy gifts!

verses.sa:
यत्ते दिक्षु प्रराध्यं मनो अस्ति श्रुतं बृहत् ।
तेन दृढा चिदद्रिव आ वाजं दर्षि सातये ॥
verses.rom:
yatte dikshu praradhyam mano asti shrutam brihat |
tena dridha chidadriva a vajam darshi sataye ||
verses.en: Thy lofty spirit famed in all the regions as appeasable,-- With this thou rendest even things firm, Stone-darter! so to win thee strength.

verses.sa:
शिशुं जज्ञानं हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति विप्रं मरुतो गणेन ।
कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्त्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
shishum jajnanam haryatam mrijanti shumbhanti vipram maruto ganena |
kavirgirbhih kavyena kavih santsomah pavitramatyeti rebhan ||
verses.en: The Maruts with their troop adorn and brighten, even at his birth, the Sage, the lovely infant. By songs a poet, and a Sage by wisdom, Soma goes singing through the cleansing filter.

verses.sa:
ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रनीथः पदवीः कवीनां ।
तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्त्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप् ॥
verses.rom:
rishimana ya rishikritsvarshah sahasranithah padavih kavinam |
tritiyam dhama mahishah sishasantsomo virajamanu rajati shtup ||
verses.en: Light-winner, Rishi-minded, Rishi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, leader of sages, Eager to gain his third form, mighty, Soma is, like Viraj, resplendent as a singer.

verses.sa:
चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् ।
अपामूर्मिं सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति ॥
verses.rom:
chamushachchhyenah shakuno vibhritva govindurdrapsa ayudhani bibhrat |
apamurmim sachamanah samudram turiyam dhama mahisho vivakti ||
verses.en: Hawk seated in the press, bird wide-extended, the banner seeking kine and wielding weapons, Uniting with the sea, the wave of waters, the mighty tells his fourth form and declares it.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् ।
वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
ete soma abhi priyamindrasya kamamaksharan |
vardhanto asya viryam ||
verses.en: Obeying Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth Increasing his heroic might.

verses.sa:
पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना ।
ते नो धत्त सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
punanasashchamushado gachchhanto vayumashvina |
te no dhatta suviryam ||
verses.en: Laid in the press and flowing pure to Vayu and the Asvins, may These give us great heroic strength.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय ।
देवानां योनिमासदं ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya soma radhase punano hardi chodaya |
devanam yonimasadam ||
verses.en: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart, To seat him in the shrine of Gods!

verses.sa:
मृजन्ति त्वा देश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः ।
अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
mrijanti tva desha kshipo hinvanti sapta dhitayah |
anu vipra amadishuh ||
verses.en: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth seven ministers impel thee on, The sages have rejoiced in thee.

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः ।
स गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
devebhyastva madaya kam srijanamati meshyah |
sa gobhirvasayamasi ||
verses.en: When through the filter thou art poured we clothe thee with a robe of milk, To be a rapturous feast for Gods.

verses.sa:
पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः ।
परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥
verses.rom:
punanah kalasheshva vastranyarusho harih |
pari gavyanyavyata ||
verses.en: When purified within the jars, Soma bright-red and golden-hued, Hath veiled him in a milky dress.

verses.sa:
मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः ।
इन्दो सखायमा विश ॥
verses.rom:
maghona a pavasva no jahi vishva apa dvishah |
indo sakhayama visha ||
verses.en: Flow onward to our wealthy lords. Drive all our enemies away: O lndu, pass into thy friend!

verses.sa:
नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतं स्वर्विदं ।
भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषं ॥
verses.rom:
nrichakshasam tva vayamindrapitam svarvidam |
bhakshimahi prajamisham ||
verses.en: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light, Gain thee and progeny and food!

verses.sa:
वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि ।
सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishtim divah pari srava dyumnam prithivya adhi |
saho nah soma pritsu dhah ||
verses.en: Send down the rain from heaven and make splendour upon the earth! Give us, O Soma, victory in war!

verses.sa:
सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः ।
वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं ॥
verses.rom:
somah punano arshati sahasradharo atyavih |
vayorindrasya nishkritam ||
verses.en: Poured through the fleece in thousand streams purified Soma floweth to, Indra's and Vayu's meeting-place.

verses.sa:
पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत ।
सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanamavasyavo vipramabhi pra gayata |
sushvanam devavitaye ||
verses.en: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage, Effused to entertain the Gods!

verses.sa:
पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ।
गृणाना देववीतये ॥
verses.rom:
pavante vajasataye somah sahasrapajasah |
grinana devavitaye ||
verses.en: The Soma drops with thousand powers are purified to win us strength, Hymned to become the feast of Gods.

verses.sa:
उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ।
द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
uta no vajasataye pavasva brihatirishah |
dyumadindo suviryam ||
verses.en: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win us strength: Indu, bring splendid manly might

verses.sa:
अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये ।
वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥
verses.rom:
atya hiyana na hetribhirasrigram vajasataye |
vi varamavyamashavah ||
verses.en: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, to win us strength, Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यं ।
सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
te nah sahasrinam rayim pavantama suviryam |
suvana devasa indavah ||
verses.en: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,-- These godlike Soma drops effused!

verses.sa:
वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न मातरः ।
दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
vashra arshantindavo'bhi vatsam na matarah |
dadhanvire gabhastyoh ||
verses.en: The roaring Soma drops flow on, like milch-kine lowing to, their calves: They have run forth from both the hands.

verses.sa:
जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् ।
विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
jushta indraya matsarah pavamana kanikradat |
vishva apa dvisho jahi ||
verses.en: Beloved by Indra, bringing joy, roaring as thou art purified, Drive all our enemies away.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः ।
योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanto aravnah pavamanah svardrishah |
yonavritasya sidata ||
verses.en: As Pavamanas, driving off the godless, looking on the light, Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य धारया ।
इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥
verses.rom:
soma asrigramindavah suta ritasya dharaya |
indraya madhumattamah ||
verses.en: The Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, to Indra have been poured, Shed with the stream of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ।
इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vipra anushata gavo vatsam na dhenavah |
indram somasya pitaye ||
verses.en: Sages have called to Indra, like cows, milch-kine, lowing to their calves, Called him to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् ।
सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
madachyutksheti sadane sindhorurma vipashchit |
somo gauri adhi shritah ||
verses.en: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his. seat, Resting upon a wild cow's hide.

verses.sa:
दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते ।
सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥
verses.rom:
divo nabha vichakshano'vyo vare mahiyate |
somo yah sukratuh kavih ||
verses.en: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and bard, is worshipped in the central point, Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.

verses.sa:
यः सोमः कलशेष्वा अन्तः पवित्र आहितः ।
तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ॥
verses.rom:
yah somah kalasheshva antah pavitra ahitah |
taminduh pari shasvaje ||
verses.en: In close embracement Indu holds Soma when poured within the: jars. And on the purifying sieve.

verses.sa:
प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि ।
जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.rom:
pra vachamindurishyati samudrasyadhi vishtapi |
jinvankosham madhushchutam ||
verses.en: Indu sends forth a voice on high, up in the region of the sea. Stirring the cask that drops with meath.

verses.sa:
नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धेनामन्तः सबर्दुघां ।
हिन्वानो मानुषा युजा ॥
verses.rom:
nityastotro vanaspatirdhenamantah sabardugham |
hinvano manusha yuja ||
verses.en: The tree whose praises never fail dwells in the stream of holy milk, Urged onward by its human friend.

verses.sa:
आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसं ।
अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवं ॥
verses.rom:
a pavamana dharaya rayim sahasravarchasam |
asme indo svabhuvam ||
verses.en: O Pavamana bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours; yea, O Indu, give us ready help!

verses.sa:
अभि प्रिया दिवः कविर्विप्रः स धारया सुतः ।
सोमो हिन्वे परावति ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priya divah kavirviprah sa dharaya sutah |
somo hinve paravati ||
verses.en: Sage, poet, poured with all his stream, Soma is driven, far away, To the dear places of the sky.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः ।
वाणस्य चोदया पविं ॥
verses.rom:
utte shushmasa irate sindhorurmeriva svanah |
vanasya chodaya pavim ||
verses.en: Loud as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves: Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point!

verses.sa:
प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः ।
यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
prasave ta udirate tisro vacho makhasyuvah |
yadavya eshi sanavi ||
verses.en: At thine effusion upward rise three voices fresh and strong, when thou. Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.

verses.sa:
अव्या वारैः परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
पवमानं मधुश्चुतं ॥
verses.rom:
avya varaih pari priyam harim hinvantyadribhih |
pavamanam madhushchutam ||
verses.en: On to the fleece they urge with stones the dear, the goldencoloured one, Even Pavamana dropping meath.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे ।
अर्कस्य योनिमासदं ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva madintama pavitram dharaya kave |
arkasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage, best giver of delight, To seat these in the shrine of song!

verses.sa:
स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः ।
एन्द्रस्य जठरं विश ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva madintama gobhiranjano aktubhih |
endrasya jatharam visha ||
verses.en: Best giver of delight, flow on anointed with the milk for balm, And enter into Indra's throat!

verses.sa:
अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा ।
अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥
verses.rom:
aya viti pari srava yasta indo madeshva |
avahannavatirnava ||
verses.en: Flow onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delights, Battered the nine-and-ninety down.

verses.sa:
पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शंबरं ।
अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुं ॥
verses.rom:
purah sadya itthadhiye divodasaya shambaram |
adha tyam turvasham yadum ||
verses.en: Smote swiftly forts, and Sambara, then Yadu and that Turvasa, For pious Divodasa's sake!

verses.sa:
परि नो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् ।
क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
pari no ashvamashvavidgomadindo hiranyavat |
kshara sahasrinirishah ||
verses.en: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold, And Indu, food in boundless store!

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः ।
गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanpavate mridho'pa somo aravnah |
gachchhannindrasya nishkritam ||
verses.en: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on, Going to Indra's settled place.

verses.sa:
महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः ।
रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
maho no raya a bhara pavamana jahi mridhah |
rasvendo viravadyashah ||
verses.en: O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes: O Indu, grant heroic fame!

verses.sa:
न त्वा शतं च न ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् ।
यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
na tva shatam cha na hruto radho ditsantama minan |
yatpunano makhasyase ||
verses.en: A hundred obstacles have ne'er checked thee when rain to give thy boons, When, being cleansed, thou combatest.

verses.sa:
अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः ।
हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥
verses.rom:
aya pavasva dharaya yaya suryamarochayah |
hinvano manushirapah ||
verses.en: Flow onward with that stream wherewith thou gavest splendour to the sun, Speeding the waters kind to man!

verses.sa:
अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि ।
अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
ayukta sura etasham pavamano manavadhi |
antarikshena yatave ||
verses.en: He, Pavamana, high o'er man, yoked the Sun's courser Etasa, To travel through the realm of air.

verses.sa:
उत त्या हरितो रथे सूरो अयुक्त यातवे ।
इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya harito rathe suro ayukta yatave |
indurindra iti bruvan ||
verses.en: Yea, those bay steeds he harnessed to the chariot that the Sun might come: Indu, he said, is Indra's self.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वो देवमग्निभिः सजोषा यजिष्ठं दूतमध्वरे कृणुध्वं ।
यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविरृतावा तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vo devamagnibhih sajosha yajishtham dutamadhvare krinudhvam |
yo martyeshu nidhruvirritava tapurmurdha ghritannah pavakah ||
verses.en: Associate with fires, make your God Agni envoy at sacrifice, best skilled in worship, Established firm among mankind, the holy flame-crowned and fed with oil, the purifier!

verses.sa:
प्रोथदश्वो न यवसेऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्व्यस्थात् ।
आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
prothadashvo na yavase'vishyanyada mahah samvaranadvyasthat |
adasya vato anu vati shochiradha sma te vrajanam krishnamasti ||
verses.en: Like a steed neighing eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.

verses.sa:
उद्यस्य ते नवजातस्य वृष्णोऽग्ने चरन्त्यजरा इधानाः ।
अच्छा द्यामरुषो धूम एषि सं दूतो अग्न ईयसे हि देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
udyasya te navajatasya vrishno'gne charantyajara idhanah |
achchha dyamarusho dhuma eshi sam duto agna iyase hi devan ||
verses.en: From thee, a bull but newly born, O Agni, the kindled everlasting flames rise upward. Aloft to heaven as ruddy smoke thou mountest: Agni, thou speedest to the Gods as envoy.

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे ।
स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tamindram vajayamasi mahe vritraya hantave |
sa vrisha vrishabho bhuvat ||
verses.en: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स बले हितः ।
द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sa damane krita ojishthah sa bale hitah |
dyumni shloki sa somyah ||
verses.en: This Indra, made for giving gifts, is stablished, mightiest, in strength, Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

verses.sa:
गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः ।
ववक्ष उग्रो अस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
gira vajro na sambhritah sabalo anapachyutah |
vavaksha ugro astritah ||
verses.en: By song, as 'twere' the powerful bolt which none may parry, was prepared: Strong and invincible he grew.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ नय ।
पुनाहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryo adribhih sutam somam pavitra a naya |
punahindraya patave ||
verses.en: Adhvaryu, to the filter lead the Soma juice expressed with stones: Make thou it pure for Indra's drink!

verses.sa:
तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्याशत ।
पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tya indo andhaso deva madhorvyashata |
pavamanasya marutah ||
verses.en: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu! enjoy this juice of thine, This Pavamana's flowing meath.

verses.sa:
दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
सुनोता मधुमत्तमं ॥
verses.rom:
divah piyushamuttamam somamindraya vajrine |
sunota madhumattamam ||
verses.en: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven, the Soma's juice, Most excellent, most rich in sweets!

verses.sa:
वैरूपम्
धर्त्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः ।
हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजांसि कृणुषे नदीष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
vairupam
dhartta divah pavate kritvyo raso daksho devanamanumadyo nribhih |
harih srijano atyo na satvabhirvritha pajamsi krinushe nadishva ||
verses.en: On flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens, the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy, Thou, gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, art lightly showing forth thy splendour in the streams.

verses.sa:
शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्वा३ः सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु ।
इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shuro na dhatta ayudha gabhastyoh sva3h sishasanrathiro gavishtishu |
indrasya shushmamirayannapasyubhirindurhinvano ajyate manishibhih ||
verses.en: He takes his weapons, like a hero, in his hands, fain to win light, car-borne, in forays for the kine. Indu, while stimulating Indra's might, is urged forward and balmed by sages skilful in their task.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश ।
प्र नः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया नो वाजां उप माहि शश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya soma pavamana urmina tavishyamano jathareshva visha |
pra nah pinva vidyudabhreva rodasi dhiya no vajam upa mahi shashvatah ||
verses.en: Soma, as thou art purified with flowing wave, exhibiting thy strength enter thou Indra's throat. Make both worlds stream for us, as lightning doth the clouds: mete out exhaustless powers for us through this our prayer!

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः ।
सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra pragapagudannyagva huyase nribhih |
sima puru nrishuto asyanave'si prashardha turvashe ||
verses.en: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion! urged by men to come.

verses.sa:
यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा ।
कण्वासस्त्वा स्तोमेभिर्ब्रह्मवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadva rume rushame shyavake kripa indra madayase sacha |
kanvasastva stomebhirbrahmavahasa indra yachchhantya gahi ||
verses.en: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Rusama, Syavaka, and Kripa thou rejoicest thee, Still do the Kanvas, bringing prayer, with hymns of praise O Indra, draw thee hither: come!

verses.sa:
उभयं शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः ।
सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayam shrinavachcha na indro arvagidam vachah |
satrachya maghavantsomapitaye dhiya shavishtha a gamat ||
verses.en: Both boons,-may, Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours. And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink to Soma juice!

verses.sa:
तं हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसा धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः ।
उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tam hi svarajam vrishabham tamojasa dhishane nishtatakshatuh |
utopamanam prathamo ni shidasi somakamam hi te manah ||
verses.en: For him, strong, independent ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth with power and might. Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देव आयुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः ।
वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva deva ayushagindram gachchhatu te madah |
vayuma roha dharmana ||
verses.en: God, working with mankind flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: To Vayu mount as Law commands!

verses.sa:
पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम श्रवाय्यं ।
इन्दो समुद्रमा विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana ni toshase rayim soma shravayyam |
indo samudrama visha ||
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that may be famed: O Indu, pass into the lake!

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः ।
नुदस्वादेवयुं जनं ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanpavase mridhah kratuvitsoma matsarah |
nudasvadevayum janam ||
verses.en: Soma, thou flowest chasing foes, finder of wisdom and delight: Drive thou the godless folk afar!

verses.sa:
अभी नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष शतस्पृहं ।
इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभासहं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi no vajasatamam rayimarsha shataspriham |
indo sahasrabharnasam tuvidyumnam vibhasaham ||
verses.en: Stream on us riches that are craved by hundreds, best at winning spoil, Riches, O Indu, thousandfold, most splendid, that surpass the light!

verses.sa:
वयं ते अस्य राधसो वसोर्वसो पुरुस्पृहः ।
नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्ने ते आध्रिगो ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te asya radhaso vasorvaso purusprihah |
ni nedishthatama ishah syama sumne te adhrigo ||
verses.en: May we, O Vasu, be most near to this thy bounty, food, and wealth! Desired by many men, and in thy favour, O resistless one!

verses.sa:
परि स्य स्वानो अक्षरदिन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः ।
धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा न याति गव्ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari sya svano aksharadinduravye madachyutah |
dhara ya urdhvo adhvare bhraja na yati gavyayuh ||
verses.en: Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece. He streams erect to sacrifice, as 'twere with splendour, seeking kine.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mahantsamudrah pita devanam vishvabhi dhama ||
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods, to every form!

verses.sa: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom: shukrah pavasva devebhyah soma dive prithivyai sham cha prajabhyah ||
verses.en: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods, blissful to heaven and earth and living things!

verses.sa: दिवो धर्त्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व ॥
verses.rom: divo dharttasi shukrah piyushah satye vidharmanvaji pavasva ||
verses.en: Thou art, bright juice, sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true law!

verses.sa:
प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियं ।
अग्ने रथं न वेद्यं ॥
verses.rom:
preshtham vo atithim stushe mitramiva priyam |
agne ratham na vedyam ||
verses.en: I laud your most beloved guest, like a dear friend, O Agni, him! Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.

verses.sa:
कविमिव प्रशंस्यं यं देवास इति द्विता ।
नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥
verses.rom:
kavimiva prashamsyam yam devasa iti dvita |
ni martyeshvadadhuh ||
verses.en: Whom as a Sage who merits praise the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.

verses.sa:
त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँ: पाहि शृणुही गिरः ।
रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yavishtha dashusho nrin: pahi shrinuhi girah |
raksha tokamuta tmana ||
verses.en: Do thou, most youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed!

verses.sa:
एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य ।
गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
endra no gadhi priya satrajidagohya |
girirna vishvatah prithuh patirdivah ||
verses.en: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable Wide as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven.

verses.sa:
अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी ।
इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi hi satya somapa ubhe babhutha rodasi |
indrasi sunvato vridhah patirdivah ||
verses.en: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours'libation, Lord of heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र धर्त्ता पुरामसि ।
हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi shashvatinamindra dhartta puramasi |
hanta dasyormanorvridhah patirdivah ||
verses.en: For thou art he, O Indra, who upholdeth all our fortresses, The Dasyu's slayer, man's sustainer, Lord of heaven.

verses.sa:
पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत ।
इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
puram bhinduryuva kaviramitauja ajayata |
indro vishvasya karmano dhartta vajri purushtutah ||
verses.en: Render of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born, Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much extolled,

verses.sa:
त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलं ।
त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam valasya gomato'pavaradrivo bilam |
tvam deva abibhyushastujyamanasa avishuh ||
verses.en: Thou wielder of the stone, didst burst the cave of Vala rich in kine. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमैरनूषत ।
सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः ॥
verses.rom:
indramishanamojasabhi stomairanushata |
sahasram yasya rataya uta va santi bhuyasih ||
verses.en: They glorified with hymns of praise Indra who reigneth by his might, Whose bounteous gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.

verses.sa:
अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मं जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे स्वानो अद्रिः ॥
verses.rom:
akrantsamudrah prathame vidharmam janayanpraja bhuvanasya gopah |
vrisha pavitre adhi sano avye brihatsomo vavridhe svano adrih ||
verses.en: Guard of all being, generating creatures, loud roared the sea as highest law commanded. Strong in the filter, on the fleecy summit, pressed from the stone, Soma hath waxen mighty.

verses.sa:
मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।
मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम ॥
verses.rom:
matsi vayumishtaye radhase cha matsi mitravaruna puyamanah |
matsi shardho marutam matsi devanmatsi dyavaprithivi deva soma ||
verses.en: Make Vayu glad, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuna and Mitra, as they cleanse thee! Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma!

verses.sa:
महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् ।
अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः ॥
verses.rom:
mahattatsomo mahishashchakarapam yadgarbho'vrinita devan |
adadhadindre pavamana ojo'janayatsurye jyotirinduh ||
verses.en: Soma, the mighty, when, the water's offspring, he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement. He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra: he, Indu, generated strength in Surya.

verses.sa:
एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयते ।
अभि द्रोणान्यासदं ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo amartyah parnaviriva diyate |
abhi dronanyasadam ||
verses.en: Here present this immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings, To settle in the vats of wood.

verses.sa:
एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते ।
दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
esha viprairabhishtuto'po devo vi gahate |
dadhadratnani dashushe ||
verses.en: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows Rich gifts upon the worshipper.

verses.sa:
एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः ।
पवमानः सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vishvani varya shuro yanniva satvabhih |
pavamanah sishasati ||
verses.en: He. like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along. Is fain to win all precious boons.

verses.sa:
एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दिशस्यति ।
आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुं ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo ratharyati pavamano dishasyati |
avishkrinoti vagvanum ||
verses.en: This God as he is flowirig on speeds like a car and gives his aid: He lets his voice be heard of all.

verses.sa:
एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः ।
हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo vipanyubhih pavamana ritayubhih |
harirvajaya mrijyate ||
verses.en: This God, while flowing, is adorned, gold-coloured, for the spoil, by men Devout and skilled in holy songs.

verses.sa:
एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति ।
पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo vipa krito'ti hvaramsi dhavati |
pavamano adabhyah ||
verses.en: This God, made ready with the hymn runs swiftly through the winding ways, Inviolable as he flows.

verses.sa:
एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया ।
पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
esha divam vi dhavati tiro rajamsi dharaya |
pavamanah kanikradat ||
verses.en: A way he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven, And roars as he is flowing on.

verses.sa:
एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः ।
पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
esha divam vyasarattiro rajamsyaspritah |
pavamanah svadhvarah ||
verses.en: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven, across The regions, never overthrown.

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratnena janmana devo devebhyah sutah |
harih pavitre arshati ||
verses.en: By generation long ago, this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः ।
धारया पवते सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
esha u sya puruvrato jajnano janayannishah |
dharaya pavate sutah ||
verses.en: This Lord of many holy laws, even at his birth engendering strength, Effused, flows onward in a stream.

verses.sa:
एष धिया यात्यण्व्य शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः ।
गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं ॥
verses.rom:
esha dhiya yatyanvya shuro rathebhirashubhih |
gachchhannindrasya nishkritam ||
verses.en: Through the fine fingers, with the song, this hero comes with rapid cars, Going to Indra's settled place.

verses.sa:
एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये ।
यत्रामृतास आशत ॥
verses.rom:
esha puru dhiyayate brihate devatataye |
yatramritasa ashata ||
verses.en: In holy thought he ponders much for the great service of theGods, Where the immortals have their seat.

verses.sa:
एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः ।
प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
etam mrijanti marjyamupa droneshvayavah |
prachakranam mahirishah ||
verses.en: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified, Him who brings forth abundant food.

verses.sa:
एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुन्ध्यावता पथा ।
यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
verses.rom:
esha hito vi niyate'ntah shundhyavata patha |
yadi tunjanti bhurnayah ||
verses.en: He is deposited and led along the consecrated path When zealous men are urging him,

verses.sa:
एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजि शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः ।
पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन् ॥
verses.rom:
esha rukmibhiriyate vaji shubhrebhiramshubhih |
patih sindhunam bhavan ||
verses.en: He moves, a vigorous steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold, He who is Sovran of the streams.

verses.sa:
एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३ वृषा ।
नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
esha shringani dodhuvachchhishite yuthyo3 vrisha |
nrimna dadhana ojasa ||
verses.en: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them, bull who leads the herd, Doing with might heroic deeds.

verses.sa:
एष वसूनि पिब्दनः परुषा ययिवां अति ।
अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vasuni pibdanah parusha yayivam ati |
ava shadeshu gachchhati ||
verses.en: He, over places rough to pass bringing rich treasures, closely pressed. Descends into the reservoirs.

verses.sa:
एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो हरिं हिवन्ति यातवे ।
स्वायुधं मदिन्तमं ॥
verses.rom:
etamu tyam dasha kshipo harim hivanti yatave |
svayudham madintamam ||
verses.en: Him, even him the golden-hued, well armed, best giver of delight, Ten fingers urge to run his course.

verses.sa:
एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत ।
गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.rom:
esha u sya vrisha ratho'vya varebhiravyata |
gachchhanvajam sahasrinam ||
verses.en: This Bull, this chariot robes him in the sheep's long wool as heproceeds. To war that wins a thousand spoils.

verses.sa:
एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
etam tritasya yoshano harim hinvantyadribhih |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en: The dames of Trita with the stones urge forth this goldencoloured one, Indu to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa:
एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति ।
गच्छं जारो न योषितं ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya manushishva shyeno na vikshu sidati |
gachchham jaro na yoshitam ||
verses.en: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men, Like lover speeding to his love.

verses.sa:
एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः ।
य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत् ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya madyo raso'va chashte divah shishuh |
ya indurvaramavishat ||
verses.en: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven, This Soma drop that pierced the sieve.

verses.sa:
एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः ।
क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियं ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya pitaye suto harirarshati dharnasih |
krandanyonimabhi priyam ||
verses.en: Pressed for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth intelligent, calling out, Unto the well-beloved place.

verses.sa:
एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः ।
याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ॥
verses.rom:
etam tyam harito dasha marmrijyante apasyuvah |
yabhirmadaya shumbhate ||
verses.en: Him, here, the gold-decked skilful ten cleanse carefully, who make him bright. And beauteous for the gladdening draught.

verses.sa:
एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः ।
अव्यो वारं वि धावति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vaji hito nribhirvishvavinmanasaspatih |
avyo varam vi dhavati ||
verses.en: Urged by the men, this vigorous steed, Lord of the mind omniscient, Flies to the long wool of the sheep.

verses.sa:
एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
esha pavitre aksharatsomo devebhyah sutah |
vishva dhamanyavishan ||
verses.en: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused. Entering all their essences.

verses.sa:
एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः ।
वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
verses.rom:
esha devah shubhayate'dhi yonavamartyah |
vritraha devavitamah ||
verses.en: He shines in beauty there, this God, immortal, in his dwellingplace, Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.

verses.sa:
एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः ।
अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vrisha kanikradaddashabhirjamibhiryatah |
abhi dronani dhavati ||
verses.en: Directed by the sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer Runs onward to the wooden vats.

verses.sa:
एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो अधि द्यवि ।
पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
esha suryamarochayatpavamano adhi dyavi |
pavitre matsaro madah ||
verses.en: This Pavamana, gladdening drink within the purifying sieve, Gave splendour to the Sun in heaven.

verses.sa:
एष सूर्येण हासते संवसानो विवस्वता ।
पतिर्वाचो अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
esha suryena hasate samvasano vivasvata |
patirvacho adabhyah ||
verses.en: Unconquerable Lord of speech, dwelling beside Viavasvan, he Mounts up together with the Sun.

verses.sa:
एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते ।
पुनानो घ्नन्नप द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
esha kavirabhishtutah pavitre adhi toshate |
punano ghnannapa dvishah ||
verses.en: This Sage, exalted by our lands, flows to the purifying sieve, Scattering foes as he is cleansed.

verses.sa:
एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते ।
पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥
verses.rom:
esha indraya vayave svarjitpari shichyate |
pavitre dakshasadhanah ||
verses.en: Giver of strength, winner of light, for Indra and for Vayu he Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.

verses.sa:
एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः ।
सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥
verses.rom:
esha nribhirvi niyate divo murdha vrisha sutah |
somo vaneshu vishvavit ||
verses.en: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, omniscient the head of heaven. Effused into the vats of wood.

verses.sa:
एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः ।
इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
esha gavyurachikradatpavamano hiranyayuh |
induh satrajidastritah ||
verses.en: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana roared, Still conqueror, never overcome.

verses.sa:
एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः ।
पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
verses.rom:
esha shushmyasishyadadantarikshe vrisha harih |
punana indurindrama ||
verses.en: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed This Indu, being purified.

verses.sa:
एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
esha shushmyadabhyah somah punano arshati |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en: This Soma being purified flows mighty and invincible, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sa:
स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।
विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa sutah pitaye vrisha somah pavitre arshati |
vighnanrakshamsi devayuh ||
verses.en: This Soma, strong effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

verses.sa:
स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः ।
अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavitre vichakshano harirarshati dharnasih |
abhi yonim kanikradat ||
verses.en: Far sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve intelligent, Bellowing to his place of rest.

verses.sa:
स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति ।
रक्षोहा वारमव्ययं ॥
verses.rom:
sa vaji rochana divah pavamano vi dhavati |
rakshoha varamavyayam ||
verses.en: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven, Fiend-slayer, through the sheep's long wool.

verses.sa:
स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् ।
जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ॥
verses.rom:
sa tritasyadhi sanavi pavamano arochayat |
jamibhih suryam saha ||
verses.en: This Pavamana, up above on Trita's ridge, hath made the Sun, Together with the Sisters, shine.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः ।
सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vritraha vrisha suto varivovidadabhyah |
somo vajamivasarat ||
verses.en: Effused, this Soma, Steer, who slays Vritra, room-giver, unbeguiled, Hath gone as 'twere to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
स देवः कविनेषितो३ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति ।
इन्दुरिन्द्राय मंहयन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa devah kavineshito3'bhi dronani dhavati |
indurindraya mamhayan ||
verses.en: Urged by the sage upon his way, this God speeds forward to the: vats, Indu to Indra, giving boons.

verses.sa:
यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसं ।
सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना ॥
verses.rom:
yah pavamaniradhyetyrishibhih sambhritam rasam |
sarvam sa putamashnati svaditam matarishvana ||
verses.en: The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamana hymns, Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Matarisvan's touch.

verses.sa:
पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसं ।
तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकं ॥
verses.rom:
pavamaniryo adhyetyrishibhih sambhritam rasam |
tasmai sarasvati duhe kshiram sarpirmadhudakam ||
verses.en: Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamana hymns, For him Sarasvat! pours forth water and butter, milk and meath.

verses.sa:
पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीः सुदुघा हि घृतश्चुतः ।
ऋषिभिः संभृतो रसो ब्राह्मणेष्वमृतं हितं ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanih svastyayanih sudugha hi ghritashchutah |
rishibhih sambhrito raso brahmaneshvamritam hitam ||
verses.en: Yea, for the Pavamanas flow richly, drop fatness, bring us weal,-- Amrit deposited among the Brahmans, essence stored by saints.

verses.sa:
पावमानीर्दधन्तु न इमं लोकमथो अमुं ।
कामान्त्समर्धयन्तु नो देवीर्देवैः समाहृताः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanirdadhantu na imam lokamatho amum |
kamantsamardhayantu no devirdevaih samahritah ||
verses.en: So may the Pavamana hymns bestow on us this world and that, And gratify our hearts' desires'-the Goddesses combined with Gods!

verses.sa:
येन देवाः पवित्रेणात्मानं पुनते सदा ।
तेन सहस्रधारेण पावमानीः पुनन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
yena devah pavitrenatmanam punate sada |
tena sahasradharena pavamanih punantu nah ||
verses.en: The purifying flood wherewith Gods ever purify themselves,-- With that, in thousand currents, may the Pavamanas make us clean!

verses.sa:
पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीस्ताभिर्गच्छति नान्दनं ।
पुण्यांश्च भक्षान्भक्षयत्यमृतत्वं च गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanih svastyayanistabhirgachchhati nandanam |
punyamshcha bhakshanbhakshayatyamritatvam cha gachchhati ||
verses.en: The Pavamana hymns bring weal: by these man goes to Paradise, And, eating pure and holy food, attains to immortality.

verses.sa:
अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे ।
चित्रभानुं रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चं ॥
verses.rom:
aganma maha namasa yavishtham yo didaya samiddhah sve durone |
chitrabhanum rodasi antarurvi svahutam vishvatah pratyancham ||
verses.en: We with great reverence have approached the Youngest, who hath shone forth well kindled in his dwelling, Wondrously bright between wide earth and heaven, well worshipped, looking forth in all directions.

verses.sa:
स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्नि ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः ।
स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः ॥
verses.rom:
sa mahna vishva duritani sahvanagni shtave dama a jatavedah |
sa no rakshishadduritadavadyadasmangrinata uta no maghonah ||
verses.en: Through his great might o'ercoming all misfortunes, praised in the house is Agni Jatavedas. May he preserve us from disgrace and trouble, both us who laud him and our wealthy princes!

verses.sa:
त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धन्ति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः ।
त्वे वसु सुषणनानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam varuna uta mitro agne tvam vardhanti matibhirvasishthah |
tve vasu sushananani santu yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en: O Agni, thou art Varuna and Mitra: Vasishthas! with their holy hymns exalt thee. With thee be most abundant gain of treasure! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessing!

verses.sa:
महां इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमां इव ।
स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
maham indro ya ojasa parjanyo vrishtimam iva |
stomairvatsasya vavridhe ||
verses.en: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain. Hath been increased by Vatsa's lauds.

verses.sa:
कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनं ।
जामि ब्रुवत आयुधा ॥
verses.rom:
kanva indram yadakrata stomairyajnasya sadhanam |
jami bruvata ayudha ||
verses.en: Since Kanvas have with lauds made him completer of the sacrifice, Words are their own appropriate arms.

verses.sa:
प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः ।
विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा ॥
verses.rom:
prajamritasya pipratah pra yadbharanta vahnayah |
vipra ritasya vahasa ||
verses.en: When priests who magnify the Son of holy law present their gifts, Sages with Order's hymn of praise.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य जिघ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत ।
जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya jighnato hareshchandra asrikshata |
jira ajirashochishah ||
verses.en: Of gold-hued Pavamana, great destroyer, radiant streams have flowed, Swift streams of him whose gleams are swift.

verses.sa:
पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः ।
हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano rathitamah shubhrebhih shubhrashastamah |
harishchandro marudganah ||
verses.en: Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise 'mid beauteous ones, Gold gleaming with the Marut host,

verses.sa:
पवमान्व्यश्नुहि रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः ।
दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanvyashnuhi rashmibhirvajasatamah |
dadhatstotre suviryam ||
verses.en: Penetrate, Pavamana, best at winning booty, with thy rays, Giving the Singer hero strength!

verses.sa:
परीतो षिञ्चता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः ।
दधन्वां यो नर्यो अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
parito shinchata sutam somo ya uttamam havih |
dadhanvam yo naryo apsva3ntara sushava somamadribhih ||

verses.sa:
नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः ।
सुते चित्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरं ॥
verses.rom:
nunam punano'vibhih pari sravadabdhah surabhintarah |
sute chitvapsu madamo andhasa shrinanto gobhiruttaram ||

prose.en:
Hence sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts, Who, friend of man, hath run among the water-streams He hath pressed Soma out with stones.

Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece, invincible and more odorous! We joy in thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.

Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, far-seeing one, is mental power.

verses.sa:
असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् ।
पुनानो वारमत्येष्यव्ययं श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asavi somo arusho vrisha hari rajeva dasmo abhi ga achikradat |
punano varamatyeshyavyayam shyeno na yonim ghritavantamasadat ||
verses.en: Even as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed the wondrous one hath bellowed to the kine. While purified thou passest through the filtering fleece to seat thee hawk-like in the place that drops with oil.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे ।
स्वसार आपो अभि गा उदासरन्त्सं ग्रावभिर्वसते वीते अध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
parjanyah pita mahishasya parnino nabha prithivya girishu kshayam dadhe |
svasara apo abhi ga udasarantsam gravabhirvasate vite adhvare ||
verses.en: Parjanya is the sire of the leaf-bearing Bull: on mountains, in earth's centre hath he made his home. The waters have flowed forth, the Sisters, to the kine: he meets the pressing-stones at the beloved rite.

verses.sa:
कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि ।
अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम नो मृड घृता वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजं ॥
verses.rom:
kavirvedhasya paryeshi mahinamatyo na mrishto abhi vajamarshasi |
apasedhandurita soma no mrida ghrita vasanah pari yasi nirnijam ||
verses.en: To glory goest thou, a Sage with ordering skill, like a groomed steed thou rushest forward to the prize. Be gracious to us, Soma, driving off distress! Thou goest, clothed in butter, to a robe of state.

verses.sa:
श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत ।
वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः ॥
verses.rom:
shrayanta iva suryam vishvedindrasya bhakshata |
vasuni jato janimanyojasa prati bhagam na didhimah ||
verses.en: Turning as 'twere to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sa:
अलर्षिरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ।
यो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥
verses.rom:
alarshiratim vasudamupa stuhi bhadra indrasya ratayah |
yo asya kamam vidhato na roshati mano danaya chodayan ||
verses.en: Praise him who sends us wealth, prompt with his liberal boons Good 4re the gifts that Indra gives. He is not wroth with one who satisfies his wish: he instigates, his mind to give.

verses.sa:
यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि ।
मघवन्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yata indra bhayamahe tato no abhayam kridhi |
maghavanchhagdhi tava tanna utaye vi dvisho vi mridho jahi ||
verses.en: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus drive away foes and enemies!

verses.sa:
त्वं हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विधर्त्ता ।
तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi radhaspate radhaso mahah kshayasyasi vidhartta |
tam tva vayam maghavannindra girvanah sutavanto havamahe ||
verses.en: For thou, O liberal Lord of ample bounty, art the ruler of our house and home. So, Indra Maghavan, thou lover of the song, we with pressed Soma call on thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे ।
पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam somasi dharayurmandra ojishtho adhvare |
pavasva mamhayadrayih ||
verses.en: Thou, Soma, hast a running stream, sweet-toned most strong at sacrifice: Flow bounteously bestowing wealth

verses.sa:
त्वं सुतो मदिन्तमो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः ।
इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam suto madintamo dadhanvanmatsarintamah |
induh satrajidastritah ||
verses.en: Thou most delightful, when effused, running, the best of gladdeners, art Indu, still conquering, ne'er subdued.

verses.sa:
त्वं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् ।
द्युमन्तं शुष्मा भर ॥
verses.rom:
tvam sushvano adribhirabhyarsha kanikradat |
dyumantam shushma bhara ||
verses.en: Do thou, poured forth by pressing- stones, flow hither uttering a roar, And bring us brightly-glorious strength!

verses.sa:
पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा ।
आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva devavitaya indo dharabhirojasa |
a kalasham madhumantsoma nah sadah ||
verses.en: In might, O Indu, with thy streams flow for the banquet of the Gods: Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy seat!

verses.sa:
तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः ।
त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः ॥
verses.rom:
tava drapsa udapruta indram madaya vavridhuh |
tvam devaso amritaya kam papuh ||
verses.en: Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.

verses.sa:
आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिं ।
वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
a nah sutasa indavah punana dhavata rayim |
vrishtidyavo rityapah svarvidah ||
verses.en: Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified Pouring down rain from heaven in floods, and finding light!

verses.sa:
परि त्यं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण ।
यो देवान्विश्वां इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
pari tyam haryatam harim babhrum punanti varena |
yo devanvishvam itpari madena saha gachchhati ||
verses.en: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued beloved of all, Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the deities

verses.sa:
द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसं सखायो अद्रिसंहतं ।
प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त ऊर्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
dviryam pancha svayashasam sakhayo adrisamhatam |
priyamindrasya kamyam prasnapayanta urmayah ||
verses.en: Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the preesing-stones, a friend. Whom Indra dearly loves, the waves and ten companions dip and bathe

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे ।
नरे च दक्षिणावते वीराय सदनासदे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma patave vritraghne pari shichyase |
nare cha dakshinavate viraya sadanasade ||
verses.en: For Vritra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, And for the guerdon-giving man, the hero sitting in his seat.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mahe dakshayashvo na nikto vaji dhanaya ||
verses.en: Flow onward Soma, flow for mighty strength, as a strong courser, bathed, to win the prize.

verses.sa: प्र ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय ॥
verses.rom: pra te sotaro rasam madaya punanti somam mahe dyumnaya ||
verses.en: The pressers clarify this juice of thine, the Soma for delight and lofty fame.

verses.sa: शिशुं जज्ञानं हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुं ॥
verses.rom: shishum jajnanam harim mrijanti pavitre somam devebhya indum ||
verses.en: They deck the gold-hued infant, newly-born, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve, for Gods.

verses.sa:
उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतं ।
इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
upo shu jatamapturam gobhirbhangam parishkritam |
indum deva ayasishuh ||
verses.en: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, The active crusher of the foe.

verses.sa:
तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव ।
य इन्द्रस्य हृदंसनिः ॥
verses.rom:
tamidvardhantu no giro vatsam samshishvaririva |
ya indrasya hridamsanih ||
verses.en: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him, Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart!

verses.sa:
अर्षा नः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषं ।
वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.rom:
arsha nah soma sham gave dhukshasva pipyushimisham |
vardha samudramukthyam ||
verses.en: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk: Increase the sea, praiseworthy one!

verses.sa:
आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् ।
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
a gha ye agnimindhate strinanti barhiranushak |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्त्रं पृथुः स्वरुः ।
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
brihannididhma esham bhuri shastram prithuh svaruh |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en: Large is their fuel, much their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतं शूर आजति सत्वभिः ।
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
ayuddha idyudha vritam shura ajati satvabhih |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en: Unquelled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्त्ताय दाशुषे ।
ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
ya eka idvidayate vasu marttaya dashushe |
ishano apratishkuta indro anga ||
verses.en: He who alone bestoweth wealth on mortal man who offereth gifts, Is Indra only, potent Lord whom none resist.

verses.sa:
यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावां आविवासति ।
उग्रं तत्पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
yashchiddhi tva bahubhya a sutavam avivasati |
ugram tatpatyate shava indro anga ||
verses.en: Whoever with the Soma pressed draws thee away from many men,- Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous power.

verses.sa:
कदा मर्त्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् ।
कदा नः शुश्रवद्गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
verses.rom:
kada marttamaradhasam pada kshumpamiva sphurat |
kada nah shushravadgira indro anga ||
verses.en: When willhe trample, like a weed, the man who hath no gift for him? When, verily, will Indra hear our songs of praise?

verses.sa:
गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः ।
ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वंशमिव येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
gayanti tva gayatrino'rchantyarkamarkinah |
brahmanastva shatakrata udvamshamiva yemire ||
verses.en: The singers hymn thee, they who chant the psalm of praise are lauding thee. The Brahmans have exalted thee, O Satakratu, like a pole.

verses.sa:
यत्सानोः सान्वारुहो भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्त्वं ।
तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति ॥
verses.rom:
yatsanoh sanvaruho bhuryaspashta karttvam |
tadindro artham chetati yuthena vrishnirejati ||
verses.en: When thou wast climbing ridge from ridge, he looked upon the toilsome task: Indra takes notice of that wish, and the Ram hastens with his troop.

verses.sa:
युङ्क्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा ।
अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ॥
verses.rom:
yunkshva hi keshina hari vrishana kakshyapra |
atha na indra somapa giramupashrutim chara ||
verses.en: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths. And, Indra, Soma drinker, come to listen to our songs Of praise!

verses.sa:
सुषमिद्धो न आ वह देवां अग्ने हविष्मते ।
होतः पावक यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
sushamiddho na a vaha devam agne havishmate |
hotah pavaka yakshi cha ||
verses.en: Agni,well kindled bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts; And worship them, pure Hotar-priest!

verses.sa:
मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे ।
अद्या कृणुय्हूतये ॥
verses.rom:
madhumantam tanunapadyajnam deveshu nah kave |
adya krinuyhutaye ||
verses.en: O Sage, Tanunapat, present our sacrifice to Gods to-day, Sweet to the taste, that they may help!

verses.sa:
नराशंसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये ।
मधुजिह्वं हविष्कृतं ॥
verses.rom:
narashamsamiha priyamasminyajna upa hvaye |
madhujihvam havishkritam ||
verses.en: Dear Narasansa, sweet of tongue, presenter of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवां ईडित आ वह ।
असि होता मनुर्हितः ॥
verses.rom:
agne sukhatame rathe devam idita a vaha |
asi hota manurhitah ||
verses.en: Agni, on thy most easy car, entreated, hither bring the Gods! Manus-appointed Priest art thou.

verses.sa:
यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा ।
सुवाति सविता भगः ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya sura udite'naga mitro aryama |
suvati savita bhagah ||
verses.en: So when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar send us forth!

verses.sa:
सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः ।
ये नो अंहोऽतिपिप्रति ॥
verses.rom:
supravirastu sa kshayah pra nu yamantsudanavah |
ye no amho'tipiprati ||
verses.en: May this our home be guarded well: forward, ye bounteous, on the way, Who bear us safely o'er distress!

verses.sa:
उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये ।
महो राजान ईशते ॥
verses.rom:
uta svarajo aditiradabdhasya vratasya ye |
maho rajana ishate ||
verses.en: Yea, Aditi, and those great Kings whose statute is inviolate, Are sovrans of a vast domain.

verses.sa:
उ त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ।
अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
u tva mandantu somah krinushva radho adrivah |
ava brahmadvisho jahi ||
verses.en: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!

verses.sa:
पदा पणीनराधसो नि बाधस्व महां असि ।
न हि त्वा कश्च न प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
pada paninaradhaso ni badhasva maham asi |
na hi tva kashcha na prati ||
verses.en: Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts! mighty art thou: There is not one to equal thee.

verses.sa:
त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानां ।
त्वं राजा जनानां ॥
verses.rom:
tvamishishe sutanamindra tvamasutanam |
tvam raja jananam ||
verses.en: Thou art the Lord of Somas pressed, Somas unpressed are also thine: Thou art the Sovran of the folk.

verses.sa:
आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋतां मतीनां सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु ।
सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
a jagrivirvipra ritam matinam somah punano asadachchamushu |
sapanti yam mithunaso nikama adhvaryavo rathirasah suhastah ||
verses.en: True object of our hymns, Sage, watchful Soma hath settled in the press as they refine him. Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.

verses.sa:
स पुनान उप सूरे दधान ओबे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः ।
प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती सतो धनं कारिणे न प्र यंसत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa punana upa sure dadhana obe apra rodasi vi sha avah |
priya chidyasya priyasasa uti sato dhanam karine na pra yamsat ||
verses.en: He, purified and bringing gifts to Surya, hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them. He by whose dear help heroes gain their wishes will yield the precious meed as to a victor.

verses.sa:
स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वां अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् ।
यत्र नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमिष्णन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vardhita vardhanah puyamanah somo midhvam abhi no jyotishavit |
yatra nah purve pitarah padajnah svarvido abhi ga adrimishnan ||
verses.en: He, being cleansed, the strengthener and increaser, bountiful Soma helped us his lustre, Wherein our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and sought the kine within the mountain.

verses.sa:
मा चिदन्यद्वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत ।
इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत ॥
verses.rom:
ma chidanyadvi shamsata sakhayo ma rishanyata |
indramitstota vrishanam sacha sute muhuruktha cha shamsata ||
verses.en: Glorify naught besides, O friends, so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra, when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!

verses.sa:
अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथा जुवं गां न चर्षणीसहं ।
विद्वेषणं संवननमुभयङ्करं मंहिष्ठमुभयाविनं ॥
verses.rom:
avakrakshinam vrishabham yatha juvam gam na charshanisaham |
vidveshanam samvananamubhayankaram mamhishthamubhayavinam ||
verses.en: Even him, the swift one, like a bull who rushes down men's conqueror, bounteous like a cow; Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent.

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते ।
सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजन्तो रथा इव ॥
verses.rom:
udu tye madhumattama gira stomasa irate |
satrajito dhanasa akshitotayo vajanto ratha iva ||
verses.en: These songs of our exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing help.

verses.sa:
कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमाशत ।
इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
kanva iva bhrigavah surya iva vishvamiddhitamashata |
indram stomebhirmahayanta ayavah priyamedhaso asvaran ||
verses.en: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained each thing whereon their thought was bent. The living men of Priyamedha's race have sun g exalting Indra with their lauds.

verses.sa:
पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः ।
द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे ॥
verses.rom:
paryu shu pra dhanva vajasataye pari vritrani sakshanih |
dvishastaradhya rinaya na irase ||
verses.en: Run forth to battle conquering the Vritras! thou Speedest to quell the foe like one exacting debts.

verses.sa:
अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः ।
गोजीरया रंहमाणः पुरन्ध्या ॥
verses.rom:
ajijano hi pavamana suryam vidhare shakmana payah |
gojiraya ramhamanah purandhya ||
verses.en: Thou Pavamana, didst beget the Sun with might, and rain in the supporting sky, Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

verses.sa:
अनु हि त्वा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये ।
वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥
verses.rom:
anu hi tva sutam soma madamasi mahe samaryarajye |
vajan abhi pavamana pra gahase ||
verses.en: For, Soma, we rejoice ourselves in thee effused for great supremacy in fight; Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds.

verses.sa: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥
verses.rom: pari pra dhanvendraya soma svadurmitraya pushne bhagaya ||
verses.en: Flow forth, O Soma, flow thou onward, sweet to Indra's, Mitra's, Pushan's, Bhaga's taste!

verses.sa: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः ॥
verses.rom: evamritaya mahe kshayaya sa shukro arsha divyah piyushah ||
verses.en: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast immortal dwelling-place!

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयात्क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.rom: indraste soma sutasya peyatkratve dakshaya vishve cha devah ||
verses.en: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all deities for strength!

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुतः साकमीरते ।
तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन ॥
verses.rom:
suryasyeva rashmayo dravayitnavo matsarasah prasutah sakamirate |
tantum tatam pari sargasa ashavo nendradrite pavate dhama kim chana ||
verses.en: Even as the beams of Surya, urging men to speed, they issue forth together, gladdening as they flow, These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.

verses.sa:
उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि ।
पवमानः सन्तनिः सुन्वतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
upo matih prichyate sichyate madhu mandrajani chodate antarasani |
pavamanah santanih sunvatamiva madhumandrapsah pari varamarshati ||
verses.en: The thought is deeply fixed, the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth: And Pavamana, like the shout of those who press, the drop, rich in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.

verses.sa:
उक्षा मिमेति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतं ।
अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत ॥
verses.rom:
uksha mimeti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devirupa yanti nishkritam |
atyakramidarjunam varamavyayamatkam na niktam pari somo avyata ||
verses.en: The bull is bellowing; the cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own resting-place. Onward hath Soma pressed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as 'twere, endued a garment newly washed.

verses.sa:
अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तं ।
दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युं ॥
verses.rom:
agnim naro didhitibhiraranyorhastachyutam janayata prashastam |
duredrisham grihapatimathavyum ||
verses.en: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered, with thought, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.

verses.sa:
तमग्निमस्ते वसवो न्यृण्वन्त्सुप्रतिचक्षमवसे कुतश्चित् ।
दक्षाय्यो यो दम आस नित्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tamagnimaste vasavo nyrinvantsupratichakshamavase kutashchit |
dakshayyo yo dama asa nityah ||
verses.en: The Vasus set that Agni in the dwelling, fair to behold, for help, from every quarter: Who, in the house for ever, must be honoured.

verses.sa:
प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नोऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ ।
त्वां शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः ॥
verses.rom:
preddho agne didihi puro no'jasraya surmya yavishtha |
tvam shashvanta upa yanti vajah ||
verses.en: Shine thou before us, Agni, well-enkindled, with flame, most youthful God, that never fadeth! To thee come goods and treasures all together.

verses.sa:
आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः ।
पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam gauh prishnirakramidasadanmataram purah |
pitaram cha prayantsvah ||
verses.en: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before the mother in the east, Advancing to his father heaven.

verses.sa:
अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती ।
व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवं ॥
verses.rom:
antashcharati rochanasya pranadapanati |
vyakhyanmahisho divam ||
verses.en: As expiration from his breath, his radiance penetrates within The Bull shines out through all the sky.

verses.sa:
त्रिंशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतङ्गाय धीयते ।
प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः ॥
verses.rom:
trimshaddhama vi rajati vakpatangaya dhiyate |
prati vastoraha dyubhih ||
verses.en: Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it reigns supreme through thirty realms. Throughout the days at break of morn.

verses.sa:
उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये ।
आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते ॥
verses.rom:
upaprayanto adhvaram mantram vochemagnaye |
are asme cha shrinvate ||
verses.en: Chant we a hymn to Agni while we go to sacrifice, to him Who hears us even from afar!

verses.sa:
यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः संजग्मानासु कृष्टिषु ।
अरक्षद्दाशुषे गयं ॥
verses.rom:
yah snihitishu purvyah samjagmanasu krishtishu |
arakshaddashushe gayam ||
verses.en: Who from of old, in carnage, when the folk were gathered, hath preserved. His household for the worshipper.

verses.sa:
स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु शन्तमः ।
उतास्मान्पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vedo amatyamagni rakshatu shantamah |
utasmanpatvamhasah ||
verses.en: May that most blissful Agni guard our wealth and all ourfamily. And keep us safe from pain and grief

verses.sa:
उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि ।
धनञ्जयो रणेरणे ॥
verses.rom:
uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvritrahajani |
dhananjayo ranerane ||
verses.en: Yea, let men say, Agni is born, even he who slayeth Vritra, he, Who winneth wealth in every fight!

verses.sa:
अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः ।
अरं वहन्त्याशवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne yunkshva hi ye tavashvaso deva sadhavah |
aram vahantyashavah ||
verses.en: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring the rapidly.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नो याह्या वहाभि प्रयांसि वीतये ।
आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
achchha no yahya vahabhi prayamsi vitaye |
a devantsomapitaye ||
verses.en: Come hither, bring the Gods to us to taste the sacrificial feast, To drink the draught of Soma juice!

verses.sa:
उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् ।
शोचा वि भाह्यजर ॥
verses.rom:
udagne bharata dyumadajasrena davidyutat |
shocha vi bhahyajara ||
verses.en: O Agni of the Bharatas, flame splendid with unfading might Shine forth and gleam, eternal one!

verses.sa:
प्र सुन्वानायान्धसो मर्त्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः ।
अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sunvanayandhaso martto na vashta tadvachah |
apa shvanamaradhasam hata makham na bhrigavah ||
verses.en: Let him, as mortal, crave this speech for him who presses of the juice! As Bhrigu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the niggard hound away.

verses.sa:
आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः ।
सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदं ॥
verses.rom:
a jamiratke avyata bhuje na putra onyoh |
sarajjaro na yoshanam varo na yonimasadam ||
verses.en: The kinsman hath endued his robe even as a son is clasped in arms. He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.

verses.sa:
स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी ।
हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदं ॥
verses.rom:
sa viro dakshasadhano vi yastastambha rodasi |
harih pavitre avyata vedha na yonimasadam ||
verses.en: That hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart, Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve to settle, priest-like, in his place.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि ।
युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
verses.rom:
abhratrivyo ana tvamanapirindra janusha sanadasi |
yudhedapitvamichchhase ||
verses.en: Still, Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest friendship but in war.

verses.sa:
न की रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः ।
यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥
verses.rom:
na ki revantam sakhyaya vindase piyanti te surashvah |
yada krinoshi nadanum samuhasyaditpiteva huyase ||
verses.en: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine. What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a father, art invoked.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये ।
ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a tva sahasrama shatam yukta rathe hiranyaye |
brahmayujo haraya indra keshino vahantu somapitaye ||
verses.en: A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या ।
शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a tva rathe hiranyaye hari mayurashepya |
shitiprishtha vahatam madhvo andhaso vivakshanasya pitaye ||
verses.en: Yoked to thy chariot wrought of gold, may thy two bays with, peacock tails. Convey thee hither, steeds with their white backs, to quaff sweet juice that makes us eloquent!

verses.sa:
पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव ।
परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते ॥
verses.rom:
piba tva3sya girvanah sutasya purvapa iva |
parishkritasya rasina iyamasutishcharurmadaya patyate ||
verses.en: So drink, thou lover of the song, as the first drinker, of this juice. This the outpouring of the savoury sap prepared is good and meet to gladden thee.

verses.sa:
आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरं रजस्तुरं ।
वनप्रक्षमुदप्रुतं ॥
verses.rom:
a sota pari shinchatashvam na stomamapturam rajasturam |
vanaprakshamudaprutam ||
verses.en: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laud-worthy, speeding through the region and the flood, Who swims in water, dwells in wood

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोदुहं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने ।
ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradharam vrishabham payoduham priyam devaya janmane |
ritena ya ritajato vivavridhe raja deva ritam brihat ||
verses.en: The Steer with thousand streams who poureth out the rain, dear to the race of deities; Who, born in Law, hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty ordinance.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया ।
समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirvritrani janghanaddravinasyurvipanyaya |
samiddhah shukra ahutah ||
verses.en: Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song, may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead

verses.sa:
गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे ।
सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
garbhe matuh pitushpita vididyutano akshare |
sidannritasya yonima ||
verses.en: His father's father, shining in his mother's ever-lasting side, Set on the seat of sacrifice!

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे ।
अग्ने यद्दीदयद्दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
brahma prajavada bhara jatavedo vicharshane |
agne yaddidayaddivi ||
verses.en: O active Jatavedas, bring devotion that wins progeny, Agni, that it may shine to heaven!

verses.sa:
अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसं ।
सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमन्ति होता ॥
verses.rom:
asya presha hemana puyamano devo devebhih samaprikta rasam |
sutah pavitram paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma pashumanti hota ||
verses.en: Made pure by this man's urgent zeal and impulse, the God hath with his juice the Gods pervaded. Pressed, singing, to the sieve he goes, as passes the Hotar to enclosures hoiding cattle.

verses.sa:
भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्याऽऽ३ वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शंसन् ।
आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhadra vastra samanya''3 vasano mahankavirnivachanani shamsan |
a vachyasva chamvoh puyamano vichakshano jagrivirdevavitau ||
verses.en: Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in combat, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations, Roll onward to the press-boards as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods and watchful!

verses.sa:
समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे ।
अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
samu priyo mrijyate sano avye yashastaro yashasam kshaito asme |
abhi svara dhanva puyamano yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en: Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a prince among us, nobler than the noble. Roar out as thou art purified, run forward! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings!

verses.sa:
एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना ।
शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
eto nvindram stavama shuddham shuddhena samna |
shuddhairukthairvavridhvamsam shuddhairashirvanmamattu ||
verses.en: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymn! Let milk-blent juice delight him made stronger with pure, pure songs of praise!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः ।
शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्य ॥
verses.rom:
indra shuddho na a gahi shuddhah shuddhabhirutibhih |
shuddho rayim ni dharaya shuddho mamaddhi somya ||
verses.en: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance pure thyself! Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma! pure, rejoice!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे ।
शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
verses.rom:
indra shuddho hi no rayim shuddho ratnani dashushe |
shuddho vritrani jighnase shuddho vajam sishasasi ||
verses.en: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure enrich the worshipper! Pure, thou dost strike the Vritras dead, and strivest pure, to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
अग्ने स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः ।
देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne stomam manamahe sidhramadya divisprishah |
devasya dravinasyavah ||
verses.en: Eager for wealth we meditate Agni's effectual laud to-day, Laud of the God who touches heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा ।
स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनं ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjushata no giro hota yo manusheshva |
sa yakshaddaivyam janam ||
verses.en: May Agni who is Hotar-priest among mankind accept our songs, And worship the celestial folk!

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः ।
त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne sapratha asi jushto hota varenyah |
tvaya yajnam vi tanvate ||
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art spread widely forth, Priest dear and excellent through thee Men make the sacrifice complete.

verses.sa:
अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामाङ्गोषिणमवावशंत वाणीः ।
वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धूर्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi triprishtham vrishanam vayodhamangoshinamavavashamta vanih |
vana vasano varuno na sindhurvi ratnadha dayate varyani ||
verses.en: To him, praiseworthy, sacred tones have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the life- bestower. Dwelling in wood, like Varuna, a river, lavishing treasure, he distributes blessings.

verses.sa:
शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावान्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि ।
तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाढः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
shuragramah sarvavirah sahavanjeta pavasva sanita dhanani |
tigmayudhah kshipradhanva samatsvashadhah sahvanpritanasu shatrun ||
verses.en: Great conqueror, warrior girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches: With sharpened arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen!

verses.sa:
उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्त्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरन्धी ।
अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्वा३र्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
urugavyutirabhayani krinvantsamichine a pavasva purandhi |
apah sishasannushasah sva3rgah sam chikrado maho asmabhyam vajan ||
verses.en: Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both heaven and earth with all their fulness! Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant booty!

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः ।
त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra yasha asyrijishi shavasaspatih |
tvam vritrani hamsyapratinyeka itpurvanuttashcharshanidhritih ||
verses.en: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे ।
महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva nunamasura prachetasam radho bhagamivemahe |
mahiva krittih sharana ta indra pra te sumna no ashnavan ||
verses.en: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, the most wise, craving thy bounty as our share Thy sheltering defence is like an ample cloak. So may thy favours reach to us.

verses.sa:
यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यं ।
अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुं ॥
verses.rom:
yajishtham tva vavrimahe devam devatra hotaramamartyam |
asya yajnasya sukratum ||
verses.en: Thee have we chosen, skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal, Priest, among the Gods, Best finisher of this holy rite:

verses.sa:
अपां नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निमु श्रेष्ठशोचिषं ।
स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
apam napatam subhagam sudiditimagnimu shreshthashochisham |
sa no mitrasya varunasya so apama sumnam yakshate divi ||
verses.en: The Waters' Child, the blessed brightly-shining one, Agni whose, light is excellent. May he by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuna, and the Floods!

verses.sa:
यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः ।
स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
yamagne pritsu martyamava vajeshu yam junah |
sa yanta shashvatirishah ||
verses.en: Lord of all food is he, the man whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, and urgest to the fray.

verses.sa:
न किरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् ।
वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
na kirasya sahantya paryeta kayasya chit |
vajo asti shravayyah ||
verses.en: Him, whosoever he may be, no one may vanquish, mighty one! Nay, very glorious wealth is his.

verses.sa:
स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता ।
