विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
verses.rom:
sa vajam vishvacharshanirarvadbhirastu taruta |
viprebhirastu sanita ||
verses.en: May he who dwells with all mankind conquer in fight with steeds of war, With sages may he win the spoil.

verses.sa:
साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः ।
हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी ॥
verses.rom:
sakamuksho marjayanta svasaro dasha dhirasya dhitayo dhanutrih |
harih paryadravajjah suryasya dronam nanakshe atyo na vaji ||
verses.en: Ten sisters, pouring out the rain together, the sage's quickly moving thoughts, adorn him. Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Surya, and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.

verses.sa:
सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः ।
मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्त्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sam matribhirna shishurvavashano vrisha dadhanve puruvaro adbhih |
maryo na yoshamabhi nishkritam yantsam gachchhate kalasha usriyabhih ||
verses.en: Even as a youngling shouting with his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along with waters. As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the settled meeting-place, the beaker.

verses.sa:
उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः ।
मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः ॥
verses.rom:
uta pra pipya udharaghnyaya indurdharabhih sachate sumedhah |
murdhanam gavah payasa chamushvabhi shrinanti vasubhirna niktaih ||
verses.en: Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow; thither in streams. comes very sapient Indu. The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the head and chief with milk within the vessels.

verses.sa:
पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः ।
आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ऽस्मां अवन्तु ते धियः ॥
verses.rom:
piba sutasya rasino matsva na indra gomatah |
apirno bodhi sadhamadye vridhe3'smam avantu te dhiyah ||
verses.en: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee, with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!

verses.sa:
भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा न स्तरभिमातये ।
अस्मां चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ॥
verses.rom:
bhuyama te sumatau vajino vayam ma na starabhimataye |
asmam chitrabhiravatadabhishtibhira nah sumneshu yamaya ||
verses.en: In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: cast us not down before the foe! With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and stablish us in thy good-will!

verses.sa:
त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रिरे सत्यामाशिरं परमे व्योमनि ।
चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत ॥
verses.rom:
trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhrire satyamashiram parame vyomani |
chatvaryanya bhuvanani nirnije charuni chakre yadritairavardhata ||
verses.en: The three-times seven milch-kine in the loftiest heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught. Four other beauteous creatures hath he made for his adornment when he waxed in strength through holy rites.

verses.sa:
स भक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे ।
तेजिष्ठा अपो मंहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa bhakshamano amritasya charuna ubhe dyava kavyena vi shashrathe |
tejishtha apo mamhana pari vyata yadi devasya shravasa sado viduh ||
verses.en: Enjoying lovely Amrit by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven. He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they-found the God's resting-place.

verses.sa:
ते अस्य सन्तु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु ।
येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत ॥
verses.rom:
te asya santu ketavo'mrityavo'dabhyaso janushi ubhe anu |
yebhirnrimna cha devya cha punata adidrajanam manana agribhnata ||
verses.en: May those his brilliant rays be ever free from death, inviolate for both classes of created things-- Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified! Yea, even for this have sages welcomed him as King.

verses.sa:
अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानो३ऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।
अभी नरं धीजवनं रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vayum vityarsha grinano3'bhi mitravaruna puyamanah |
abhi naram dhijavanam ratheshthamabhindram vrishanam vajrabahum ||
verses.en: Lauded with song, to feast him, flow to Vayu, flow purified to Varuna and Mitra! Flow to the song inspiring car-borne hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder!

verses.sa:
अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः ।
अभि चन्द्रा भर्त्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vastra suvasananyarshabhi dhenuh sudughah puyamanah |
abhi chandra bharttave no hiranyabhyashvanrathino deva soma ||
verses.en: Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, milch-kine, abundant yielders! God Soma, send us cbariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden!

verses.sa:
अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः ।
अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi no arsha divya vasunyabhi vishva parthiva puyamanah |
abhi yena dravinamashnavamabhyarsheyam jamadagnivannah ||
verses.en: Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth, So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rishihood in Jamadagni's manner!

verses.sa:
यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय ।
तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उतो दिवं ॥
verses.rom:
yajjayatha apurvya maghavanvritrahatyaya |
tatprithivimaprathayastadastabhna uto divam ||
verses.en: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vritras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.

verses.sa:
तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः ।
तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वं ॥
verses.rom:
tatte yajno ajayata tadarka uta haskritih |
tadvishvamabhibhurasi yajjatam yachcha jantvam ||
verses.en: Then was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy. In might thou art above this All, all that now is and yet shall be.

verses.sa:
आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ।
घर्मं न सामं तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
amasu pakvamairaya a suryam rohayo divi |
gharmam na samam tapata suvriktibhirjushtam girvanase brihat ||
verses.en: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Surya rise to heaven. Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sdma hymns, great joy to him who loves the song!

verses.sa:
मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः ।
वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः ॥
verses.rom:
matsyapayi te mahah patrasyeva harivo matsaro madah |
vrisha te vrishna indurvaji sahasrasatamah ||
verses.en: Rejoice: thy glory hath been quaffed, Lord of bay steeds! as 'twere the bowl's enlivening mead. Thine, Steer, is Indu, Steer, the Strong, best winner of a thousand spoils.

verses.sa:
आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः ।
सहावां इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनषाडमर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
a naste gantu matsaro vrisha mado varenyah |
sahavam indra sanasih pritanashadamartyah ||
verses.en: Let our strong drink, most excellent, exhilarating, come to thee, Victorious, Indra! bringing gain, immortal conquering in fight!

verses.sa:
त्वं हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथं ।
सहावान्दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi shurah sanita chodayo manusho ratham |
sahavandasyumavratamoshah patram na shochisha ||
verses.en: Thou, hero, winner of the spoil, urgest to speed the car of man. Burn, like a vessel with the flame, the riteless Dasyu, conqueror!

verses.sa:
पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि ।
अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vrishtima su no'pamurmim divaspari |
ayakshma brihatirishah ||
verses.en: Pour down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky. And plenteous store of wholesome foood!

verses.sa:
तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् ।
जन्यास उप नो गृहं ॥
verses.rom:
taya pavasva dharaya yaya gava ihagaman |
janyasa upa no griham ||
verses.en: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us. The kine of strangers to our home.

verses.sa:
घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः ।
अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव ॥
verses.rom:
ghritam pavasva dharaya yajneshu devavitamah |
asmabhyam vrishtima pava ||
verses.en: Dearest to Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream, Pour down on us a flood of rain!

verses.sa:
स न ऊर्जे व्या३व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया ।
देवासः शृणवन्हि कं ॥
verses.rom:
sa na urje vya3vyayam pavitram dhava dharaya |
devasah shrinavanhi kam ||
verses.en: To give as vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth! For verily the Gods will hear.

verses.sa:
पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षांस्यपजङ्घनत् ।
प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano asishyadadrakshamsyapajanghanat |
pratnavadrochayanruchah ||
verses.en: Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Rakshasas. Flashing out splendour as of old.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर ।
अरङ्गमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चादध्वने नरः ॥
verses.rom:
pratyasmai pipishate vishvani vidushe bhara |
arangamaya jagmaye'pashchadadhvane narah ||
verses.en: Bring forth oblations to the God who knoweth all, who fain would drink. The wanderer, lagging not behind the hero, coming nigh with, speed!

verses.sa:
एमेनं प्रत्येतन सोमेभिः सोमपातमं ।
अमत्रेभिरृजीषिणमिन्द्रं सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
emenam pratyetana somebhih somapatamam |
amatrebhirrijishinamindram sutebhirindubhih ||
verses.en: With Somas go ye nigh to him chief drinker of the Soma's. juice: With beakers to the impetuous God, to Indra with the flowing, drops!

verses.sa:
यदी सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः सोमेभिः प्रतिभूषथ ।
वेदा विश्वस्य मेधिरो धृषत्तन्तमिदेषते ॥
verses.rom:
yadi sutebhirindubhih somebhih pratibhushatha |
veda vishvasya medhiro dhrishattantamideshate ||
verses.en: What time with Somas, with the drops effused,, ye come beforethe God, Full wise, he knows the hope of each, and, bold one strikes this. foe and that.

verses.sa:
अस्माअस्मा इदन्धसोऽध्वर्यो प्र भरा सुतं ।
कुवित्समस्य जेन्यस्य शर्धतोऽभिशस्तेरवस्वरत् ॥
verses.rom:
asmaasma idandhaso'dhvaryo pra bhara sutam |
kuvitsamasya jenyasya shardhato'bhishasteravasvarat ||
verses.en: To him, Adhvaryu! yea, to him give offerings of the juiceexpressed! Will he not keep us safely from the spiteful curse of each, presumptuous high-born foe?

verses.sa:
बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे ।
सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
babhrave nu svatavase'runaya divisprishe |
somaya gathamarchata ||
verses.en: Sing ye a song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might, The Red, who reaches up to heaven!

verses.sa:
हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन ।
मधावा धावता मधु ॥
verses.rom:
hastachyutebhiradribhih sutam somam punitana |
madhava dhavata madhu ||
verses.en: Purify Soma when effused with stones which hands move rapidly, And pour the sweet milk in the meath.

verses.sa:
नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन ।
इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन ॥
verses.rom:
namasedupa sidata dadhnedabhi shrinitana |
indumindre dadhatana ||
verses.en: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds: To Indra offer Indu up

verses.sa:
अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे ।
देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
amitraha vicharshanih pavasva soma sham gave |
devebhyo anukamakrit ||
verses.en: Soma, foe-queller, strong and swift, doing the will of Gods, pour forth, Prosperity upon our kine

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे ।
मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma patave madaya pari shichyase |
manashchinmanasaspatih ||
verses.en: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, Tthat, Indra. may drink thee and rejoice.

verses.sa:
पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः ।
इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana suviryam rayim soma ririhi nah |
indavindrena no yuja ||
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength, Indu, with Indra. our ally!

verses.sa:
उद्धेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषमं नर्यापसं ।
अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
uddhedabhi shrutamagham vrishamam naryapasam |
astarameshi surya ||
verses.en: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for men;

verses.sa:
नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा ।
अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
nava yo navatim puro bibheda bahvojasa |
ahim cha vritrahavadhit ||
verses.en: Him who with might of both his arms broke nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vritra and smote Ahi dead.

verses.sa:
स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् ।
उरुधारेव दोहते ॥
verses.rom:
sa na indrah shivah sakhashvavadgomadyavamat |
urudhareva dohate ||
verses.en: This Indra is our gracious friend. He sends, like a full-streaming cow, Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

verses.sa:
विभ्राड्बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतं ।
वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पिपर्ति बहुधा वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
vibhradbrihatpibatu somyam madhvayurdadhadyajnapatavavihrutam |
vatajuto yo abhirakshati tmana prajah piparti bahudha vi rajati ||
verses.en: May the bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifices lord unbroken life He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, nourishes them with food and shines o'er many a land.

verses.sa:
विभ्राड्बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मं दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितं ।
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा ॥
verses.rom:
vibhradbrihatsubhritam vajasatamam dharmam divo dharune satyamarpitam |
amitraha vritraha dasyuhantamam jyotirjajne asuraha sapatnaha ||
verses.en: Radiant, as high Truth, cherished, best at winning strength, Truth based upon the statute that supports the heavens, He rose, a light that kills Vritras and enemies, best slayer of the Dasyus, Asuras, and foes.

verses.sa:
इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् ।
विश्वभ्राड्भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतं ॥
verses.rom:
idam shreshtham jyotisham jyotiruttamam vishvajiddhanajiduchyate brihat |
vishvabhradbhrajo mahi suryo drisha uru paprathe saha ojo achyutam ||
verses.en: This light, the best of lights, supreme, all conquering, winner of riches, is exalted with high laud. All-lighting, radiant, mighty as the Sun to see, he spreadeth wide unshaken victory and strength.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।
शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीव ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra kratum na a bhara pita putrebhyo yatha |
shiksha no asminpuruhuta yamani jiva jyotirashimahi ||
verses.en: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons, Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still livc and look upon the light!

verses.sa:
मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो३ माशिवासोऽव क्रमुः ।
त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no ajnata vrijana duradhyo3 mashivaso'va kramuh |
tvaya vayam pravatah shashvatirapo'ti shura taramasi ||
verses.en: Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent unhallowed, tread us to the ground! With thine assistance, hero, may we pass through all the waters that are rushing down!

verses.sa:
अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः ।
विश्वा च नो जरित्ऱीन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः ॥
verses.rom:
adyadya shvahshva indra trasva pare cha nah |
vishva cha no jaritrintsatpate aha diva naktam cha rakshishah ||
verses.en: Protect us, Indra, each to-day, each to morrow, and each following day! Through all the days shalt thou, Lord of the brave, preserve our singers both by day and night!

verses.sa:
प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो विर्याय कं ।
उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः ॥
verses.rom:
prabhangi shuro maghava tuvimaghah sammishlo viryaya kam |
ubha te bahu vrishana shatakrato ni ya vajram mimikshatuh ||
verses.en: A crushing warrior, passing rich, is Maghavan, endowed with all heroic strength. Thine arms, O Satakratu, are exceeding strong, those arms, which grasp the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः ।
सरस्वन्तं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
janiyanto nvagravah putriyantah sudanavah |
sarasvantam havamahe ||
verses.en: We call upon Sarasvan as unmarried men who long for wives, As bounteous men who yearn for sons.

verses.sa:
उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु सप्तस्वसा सुजुष्टा ।
सरस्वती स्तोम्या भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta nah priya priyasu saptasvasa sujushta |
sarasvati stomya bhut ||
verses.en: Yea, she most dear amid dear streams-seven-sistered, loved with foundest love. Sarasvati, hath earned our praise.

verses.sa:
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि ।
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
verses.rom:
tatsaviturvarenyam bhargo devasya dhimahi |
dhiyo yo nah prachodayat ||
verses.en: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers!

verses.sa:
सोमानां स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते ।
कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥
verses.rom:
somanam svaranam krinuhi brahmanaspate |
kakshivantam ya aushijah ||
verses.en: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!

verses.sa:
अग्न आयूंषि पवसे आ सुवोर्जं इषं च नः ।
आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनां ॥
verses.rom:
agna ayumshi pavase a suvorjam isham cha nah |
are badhasva duchchhunam ||
verses.en: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength; Drive thou misfortune far away!

verses.sa:
ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य ।
महि वा क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
ta nah shaktam parthivasya maho rayo divyasya |
mahi va kshatram deveshu ||
verses.en: So help ye us to riches, great celestial and terrestrial wealth Vast is your sway among the Gods!

verses.sa:
ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते ।
अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते ॥
verses.rom:
ritamritena sapanteshiram dakshamashate |
adruha devau vardhete ||
verses.en: Carefully tending Law with law they have attained their vigorous might: Both Gods, devoid of guile, wax strong.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः ।
बृहन्तं गर्त्तमाशाते ॥
verses.rom:
vrishtidyava rityapeshaspati danumatyah |
brihantam garttamashate ||
verses.en: With rainy skies and streaming floods, Lords of the food that falls in dew, A lofty seat have they attained.

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः ।
रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
yunjanti bradhnamarusham charantam pari tasthushah |
rochante rochana divi ||
verses.en: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy steed: The lights shining in the sky.

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे ।
शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा ॥
verses.rom:
yunjantyasya kamya hari vipakshasa rathe |
shona dhrishnu nrivahasa ||
verses.en: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Brown, bold, who bear the hero on.

verses.sa:
केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे ।
समुषद्भिरजायथाः ॥
verses.rom:
ketum krinvannaketave pesho marya apeshase |
samushadbhirajayathah ||
verses.en: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sa:
अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि ।
त्वं ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमं ॥
verses.rom:
ayam soma indra tubhyam sunve tubhyam pavate tvamasya pahi |
tvam ha yam chakrishe tvam vavrisha indum madaya yujyaya somam ||
verses.en: For thee this Soma is effused. O Indra: drink of this j uice; for thee the stream is flowing-- Soma, which thou thyself hast made and chosen, even Indu for thy special drink to cheer thee!

verses.sa:
स ईं रथो न भुरिषाडयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि ।
आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त ॥
verses.rom:
sa im ratho na bhurishadayoji mahah puruni sataye vasuni |
adim vishva nahushyani jata svarshata vana urdhva navanta ||
verses.en: Like a capacious car hath it been harnessed, the mighty, to acquire abundant treasures. Then in the sacrifice they shouted lauding all triumphs won by Nahus in the battle.

verses.sa:
शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् ।
आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण्न यज्ञः ॥
verses.rom:
shushmi shardho na marutam pavasvanabhishasta divya yatha vit |
apo na makshu sumatirbhava nah sahasrapsah pritanashanna yajnah ||
verses.en: Flow onward like the potent band of Maruts, like that celestial host which none revileth! Quickly be gracious unto us like waters, like sacrifice victorious, thousand-fashioned!

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषां हितः ।
देवेभिर्मानुषे जने ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne yajnanam hota vishvesham hitah |
devebhirmanushe jane ||

verses.sa:
स नो मन्द्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः ।
आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
sa no mandrabhiradhvare jihvabhiryaja mahah |
a devanvakshi yakshi cha ||

verses.sa:
वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवाञ्जसा ।
अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो ॥
verses.rom:
vettha hi vedho adhvanah pathashcha devanjasa |
agne yajneshu sukrato ||

prose.en:
O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men. So with sweet-sounding tongues for us sacrifice nobly in this rite: Bring thou the Gods and worship them

For, as disposer, Agni, God, most wise in sacrifices, thou Knowest straightway the roads and paths.

verses.sa:
होता देवो अमर्त्यः पुरस्तादेति मायया ।
विदथानि प्रचोदयन् ॥
verses.rom:
hota devo amartyah purastadeti mayaya |
vidathani prachodayan ||
verses.en: Immortal, Hotar-priest, and God, with wondrous power heleads the way, Urging the congregations on.

verses.sa:
वाजी वाजेषु धीयतेऽध्वरेषु प्र णीयते ।
विप्रो यज्ञस्य साधनः ॥
verses.rom:
vaji vajeshu dhiyate'dhvareshu pra niyate |
vipro yajnasya sadhanah ||
verses.en: Strong, he is set on deeds of strength. He is led forth in holy rites, Sage who completes the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
धिया चक्रे वरेण्यो भूतानां गर्भमा दधे ।
दक्षस्य पितरं तना ॥
verses.rom:
dhiya chakre varenyo bhutanam garbhama dadhe |
dakshasya pitaram tana ||
verses.en: Excellent, he was made by thought. The germ of beings have gained. Yea, and the Sire of active power.

verses.sa:
आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियं ।
रसा दधीत वृषभं ॥
verses.rom:
a sute sinchata shriyam rodasyorabhishriyam |
rasa dadhita vrishabham ||
verses.en: Pour on the juice the heated milk which hasteneth to heaven and. earth; Bestow the liquid on the Bull!

verses.sa:
ते जानत स्वमोक्या३ं सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः ।
मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
te janata svamokya3m sam vatsaso na matribhih |
mitho nasanta jamibhih ||
verses.en: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside themother cows, They come together with their kin.

verses.sa:
उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि ।
इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
upa srakveshu bapsatah krinvate dharunam divi |
indre agna namah svah ||
verses.en: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food irb heaven, For Indra, Agni, homage, light.

verses.sa:
तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः ॥
verses.rom:
tadidasa bhuvaneshu jyeshtham yato jajna ugrastveshanrimnah |
sadyo jajnano ni rinati shatrunanu yam vishve madantyumah ||
verses.en: In all the worlds That was the best and highest whence sprang the mighty one, of splendid valour, As soon as he is born he smites his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful foe

verses.sa:
वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति ।
अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhanah shavasa bhuryojah shatrurdasaya bhiyasam dadhati |
avyanachcha vyanachcha sasni sam te navanta prabhrita madeshu ||
verses.en: Grown mighty in his strength, of ample vigour, he as a strikes fear into the Dasa, Eager to win the breathing and the breathless. All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः ।
स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः ॥
verses.rom:
tve kratumapi vrinjanti vishve dviryadete trirbhavantyumah |
svadoh svadiyah svaduna srija samadah su madhu madhunabhi yodhih ||
verses.en: All concentrate on thee their mental vigour, what time these, once or twice, are thine assistants. Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win quickly with our meath that meath in battle.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशं ।
स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुं सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukeshu mahisho yavashiram tuvishushmastrimpatsomamapibadvishnuna sutam yathavasham |
sa im mamada mahi karma kartave mahamurum sainam sashchaddevo devam satya induh satyamindram ||
verses.en: At the Trikadrukas the great and strong enjoyed the barley-brew. With Vishnu did he drink the pressed-out Soma juice, even as he would. That hath so heightened him the great, the wide, to do his mighty work. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!

verses.sa:
साकं जातः क्रतुना साकमोजसा ववक्षिथ साकं वृद्धो वीर्यैः सासहिर्मृधो विचर्षणिः ।
दाता राध स्तुवते काम्यं वसु प्रचेतन सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
sakam jatah kratuna sakamojasa vavakshitha sakam vriddho viryaih sasahirmridho vicharshanih |
data radha stuvate kamyam vasu prachetana sainam sashchaddevo devam satya induh satyamindram ||
verses.en: Brought forth together with wisdom and potent strength thou grewest great: with hero deeds subduing the malevolent, most swift in act; Giving prosperity and lovely wealth to him who praiseth thee. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!

verses.sa:
अध त्विषीमां अभ्योजसा कृविं युधाभवदा रोदसी अपृणदस्य मज्मना प्र वावृधे ।
अधत्तान्यं जठरे प्रेमरिच्यत प्र चेतय सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
adha tvishimam abhyojasa krivim yudhabhavada rodasi aprinadasya majmana pra vavridhe |
adhattanyam jathare premarichyata pra chetaya sainam sashchaddevo devam satya induh satyamindram ||
verses.en: So he resplendent in the battle overcame Krivi by might. He with his majesty bath filled the earth and heaven, and waxen strong. One share of the libation bath he swallowed down: one share he left. Enlighten us! So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!

verses.sa:
अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे ।
मूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra gopatim girendramarcha yatha vide |
munum satyasya satpatim ||
verses.en: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave,

verses.sa:
आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि ।
यत्राभि संनवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
a harayah sasrijrire'rushiradhi barhishi |
yatrabhi samnavamahe ||
verses.en: Hither have his bay steeds been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass Where we in concert sing our songs.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु ।
यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत् ॥
verses.rom:
indraya gava ashiram duduhre vajrine madhu |
yatsimupahvare vidat ||
verses.en: For Indra, thunder-armed, the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रं समत्सु भूषत ।
उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvasu havyamindram samatsu bhushata |
upa brahmani savanani vritrahanparamajya richishama ||
verses.en: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise come to libations and to hymns.

verses.sa:
त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् ।
तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam data prathamo radhasamasyasi satya ishanakrit |
tuvidyumnasya yujya vrinimahe putrasya shavaso mahah ||
verses.en: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gyifts, true art thou,, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very glorious one, yea, with the mighty Son of Strength.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नं पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत ।
इन्द्रमभि जायमानं समस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
pratnam piyusham purvyam yadukthyam maho gahaddiva a niradhukshata |
indramabhi jayamanam samasvaran ||
verses.en: They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old divine primeval milk that claims the laud: They lifted up their voice to Indra at his birth.

verses.sa:
आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत ।
दिवो न वारं सविता व्यूर्णुते ॥
verses.rom:
adim ke chitpashyamanasa apyam vasurucho divya abhyanushata |
divo na varam savita vyurnute ||
verses.en: Then, beautifully radiant, certain heavenly ones proclaimed their kinship with him as they looked thereon: Savitar opens, as it were, the fold of heaven.

verses.sa:
अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना ।
यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
adha yadime pavamana rodasi ima cha vishva bhuvanabhi majmana |
yuthe na nishtha vrishabho vi rajasi ||
verses.en: And now that thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might, Thou shinest like a bull supreme among the herd.

verses.sa:
यौधाजयम्
इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसं ।
अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥
verses.rom:
yaudhajayam
imamu shu tvamasmakam sanim gayatram navyamsam |
agne deveshu pra vochah ||
verses.en: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune to the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!

verses.sa:
विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ ।
सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि ॥
verses.rom:
vibhaktasi chitrabhano sindhorurma upaka a |
sadyo dashushe ksharasi ||
verses.en: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent one! nigh, as with wave of Sindhu, thou Swift strearnest to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु ।
शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhaja parameshva vajeshu madhyameshu |
shiksha vasvo antamasya ||
verses.en: Give us a share of wealth most high, a share of wealth most near to us, A share of wealth that is between.

verses.sa:
अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह ।
अहं सूर्य इवाजनि ॥
verses.rom:
ahamiddhi pitushpari medhamritasya jagraha |
aham surya ivajani ||
verses.en: I from my Father have obtained deep knowledge of eternal Law; I was born like unto the Sun.

verses.sa:
अहं प्रत्नेन जन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् ।
येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे ॥
verses.rom:
aham pratnena janmana girah shumbhami kanvavat |
yenendrah shushmamiddadhe ||
verses.en: After the ancient manner I, like Kanva, beautify my songs, And Indra's self gains power thereby.

verses.sa:
ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुरृषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः ।
ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
ye tvamindra na tushtuvurrishayo ye cha tushtuvuh |
mamedvardhasva sushtutah ||
verses.en: Whatever gishis have not praised thee, Indra, or have praised thee, wax Mighty indeed when praised by me!

verses.sa:
अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्जोषि ब्रह्म सहस्कृत ।
ये देवत्रा य आयुषु तेभिर्नो महया गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vishvebhiragnibhirjoshi brahma sahaskrita |
ye devatra ya ayushu tebhirno mahaya girah ||
verses.en: Agni, produced by strength, do thou with all thy fires accept our prayer: With those that are with Gods, with those that are with men exalt our songs!

verses.sa:
प्र स विश्वेभिरग्निभिरग्निः स यस्य वाजिनः ।
तनये तोके अस्मदा सम्यङ्वाजैः परीवृतः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sa vishvebhiragnibhiragnih sa yasya vajinah |
tanaye toke asmada samyanvajaih parivritah ||
verses.en: Forth come to us with all his fires that Agni, whose the mighty are, Come, fully girt about with wealth for us and for our kith and kin!

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय ।
त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne agnibhirbrahma yajnam cha vardhaya |
tvam no devatataye rayo danaya chodaya ||
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifices: Incite them to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods!

verses.sa:
त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियन्दधुः ।
स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tve soma prathama vriktabarhisho mahe vajaya shravase dhiyandadhuh |
sa tvam no vira viryaya chodaya ||
verses.en: Some, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown: So, hero, urge us onward to heroic power'

verses.sa:
अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितं ।
शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
abhyabhi hi shravasa tatardithotsam na kam chijjanapanamakshitam |
sharyabhirna bharamano gabhastyoh ||
verses.en: All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as 'twere a never-failing well for men to drink, Borne on thy way as 'twere in fragments from both arms.

verses.sa:
अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्याय अमृतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः ।
सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत् ॥
verses.rom:
ajijano amrita martyaya amritasya dharmannamritasya charunah |
sadasaro vajamachchha sanishyadat ||
verses.en: Thou didst produce him, deathless one! for mortal man, for maintenance of Law and lovely Amrita: Thou evermore hast moved making wealth flow to us.

verses.sa:
एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु ।
प्र राधांसि चोदयते महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
endumindraya sinchata pibati somyam madhu |
pra radhamsi chodayate mahitvana ||
verses.en: Pour out the drops f or Indra; let him drink the meath of Soma Juice! He through his majesty sends forth his bounteous gifts.

verses.sa:
उपो हरीणां पतिं राधः पृञ्चन्तमब्रवं ।
नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
upo harinam patim radhah princhantamabravam |
nunam shrudhi stuvato ashvyasya ||
verses.en: I spake to the bay coursers' Lord, to him who grants the boon. of wealth: Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee?

verses.sa:
न ह्याङ्३ग पुरा च न जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् ।
न की राया नैवथा न भन्दना ॥
verses.rom:
na hyan3ga pura cha na jajne viratarastvat |
na ki raya naivatha na bhandana ||
verses.en: Never was any hero born before thee mightier than thou: None certainly like thee in riches and in praise.

verses.sa:
नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनां ।
पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
nadam va odatinam nadam yoyuvatinam |
patim vo aghnyanam dhenunamishudhyasi ||
verses.en: Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, lord of thy cows whom none may kill, For those who long for his approach, for those who turn away from him.

verses.sa:
देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचं ।
उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते ॥
verses.rom:
devo vo dravinodah purnam vivashtvasicham |
udva sinchadhvamupa va prinadhvamadidvo deva ohate ||
verses.en: The God who giveth wealth accept the full libation poured to him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you!

verses.sa:
तं होतारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत ।
दधाति रत्नं विधते सुवीर्यमग्निर्जनाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
tam hotaramadhvarasya prachetasam vahnim deva akrinvata |
dadhati ratnam vidhate suviryamagnirjanaya dashushe ||
verses.en: The Gods made him the Hotar-priest of sacrifice, oblationbearer, passing wise. Agni gives wealth and valour to the worshipper, to man who offers up his gifts.

verses.sa:
अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः ।
उपोषु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
adarshi gatuvittamo yasminvratanyadadhuh |
uposhu jatamaryasya vardhanamagnim nakshantu no girah ||
verses.en: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength.

verses.sa:
यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः ।
सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिर्नमस्यत ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadrejanta krishtayashcharkrityani krinvatah |
sahasrasam medhasataviva tmanagnim dhibhirnamasyata ||
verses.en: Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the sacrifice, himself, that Agni, reverence with songs!

verses.sa:
प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना ।
अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
pra daivodaso agnirdeva indro na majmana |
anu mataram prithivim vi vavrite tasthau nakasya sharmani ||
verses.en: Agni of Divoddsa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth; he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place.

verses.sa:
अग्न आयूंषि पवसे आसुवोर्जमिषं च नः ।
आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनां ॥
verses.rom:
agna ayumshi pavase asuvorjamisham cha nah |
are badhasva duchchhunam ||
verses.en: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength: Drive thou misfortune far away!

verses.sa:
अग्निरृषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः ।
तमीमहे महागयं ॥
verses.rom:
agnirrishih pavamanah panchajanyah purohitah |
tamimahe mahagayam ||
verses.en: Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the fivefold tribes; To him whose wealth is great we pray.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यं ।
दधद्रयिं मयि योषं ॥
verses.rom:
agne pavasva svapa asme varchah suviryam |
dadhadrayim mayi yosham ||
verses.en: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us, Granting me wealth that nourishes!

verses.sa:
अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया ।
आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
agne pavaka rochisha mandraya deva jihvaya |
a devanvakshi yakshi cha ||
verses.en: O Agni, holy and divine with splendour and thy pleasant tongue. Bring thou the Gods and worship them!

verses.sa:
तं त्वा घृतस्नवीमहे चित्रभानो स्वर्दृशं ।
देवां आ वीतये वह ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva ghritasnavimahe chitrabhano svardrisham |
devam a vitaye vaha ||
verses.en: We pray thee bathed in butter, O bright-rayed! who lookest on the sun, Bring the Gods hither to the feast!

verses.sa:
वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तं समिधीमहि ।
अग्ने बृहन्तमध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
vitihotram tva kave dyumantam samidhimahi |
agne brihantamadhvare ||
verses.en: Sage, we have kindled thee, the bright, the feaster on oblation, thee, O Agni, great in sacrifice!

verses.sa:
अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि ।
विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य ॥
verses.rom:
ava no agna utibhirgayatrasya prabharmani |
vishvasu dhishu vandya ||
verses.en: Adorable in all our prayers, favour us, Agni, with thine aid. What time the psalm is chanted forth!

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यं ।
विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरं ॥
verses.rom:
a no agne rayim bhara satrasaham varenyam |
vishvasu pritsu dushtaram ||
verses.en: Bring to us ever-conquering wealth, wealth, Agni, worthy of our choice, Invincible in all our frays!

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसं ।
मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
a no agne suchetuna rayim vishvayuposhasam |
mardikam dhehi jivase ||
verses.en: Grant us, O Agni, through thy grace wealth to support us evermore, Thy favour so that we may live!

verses.sa:
अग्निं हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु ।
तेन जेष्म धनंधनं ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hinvantu no dhiyah saptimashumivajishu |
tena jeshma dhanamdhanam ||
verses.en: Let songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race, And we will win each prize through him

verses.sa:
यया गा आकरामहै सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या ।
तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yaya ga akaramahai senayagne tavotya |
tam no hinva maghattaye ||
verses.en: Agni! the host whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,- That send us for the gain of wealth!

verses.sa:
आग्ने स्थूरं रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनं ।
अङ्धि खं वर्त्तया पविं ॥
verses.rom:
agne sthuram rayim bhara prithum gomantamashvinam |
andhi kham varttaya pavim ||
verses.en: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine: Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel!

verses.sa:
अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ।
दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agne nakshatramajarama suryam rohayo divi |
dadhajjyotirjanebhyah ||
verses.en: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, the eternal star, to mount the sky, Giving the boon of light to men.

verses.sa:
अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् ।
बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
agne keturvishamasi preshthah shreshtha upasthasat |
bodha stotre vayo dadhat ||
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine Watch for the singer, give him life!

verses.sa:
अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयं ।
अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
agnirmurdha divah kakutpatih prithivya ayam |
apam retamsi jinvati ||
verses.en: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters' seed.

verses.sa:
ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वःपतिः ।
स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
ishishe varyasya hi datrasyagne svahpatih |
stota syam tava sharmani ||
verses.en: Yea, Agni, thou as Lord of light rulest o'er choicest gifts may I, Thy singer, find defence in thee

verses.sa:
उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते ।
तव ज्योतींष्यर्चयः ॥
verses.rom:
udagne shuchayastava shukra bhrajanta irate |
tava jyotimshyarchayah ||
verses.en: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high, Thy lustres, fair effulgences.

verses.sa:
कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः ।
को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
kaste jamirjananamagne ko dashvadhvarah |
ko ha kasminnasi shritah ||
verses.en: Who, Agni, is thy kin, of men? who honours thee with sacrifice? On whom dependent? who art thou?

verses.sa:
त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः ।
सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam jamirjananamagne mitro asi priyah |
sakha sakhibhya idyah ||
verses.en: The kinsman, Agni! of mankind, their well-beiaved friend art thou, A friend whom friends may supplicate.

verses.sa:
यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवां ऋतं बृहत् ।
अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमं ॥
verses.rom:
yaja no mitravaruna yaja devam ritam brihat |
agne yakshi svam damam ||
verses.en: Bring Mitra, Varukia, bring the Gods hither to. our great sacrifice: Bring them, O Agni, to thine home

verses.sa:
ईडेन्यो नमस्यस्तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतः ।
समग्निरिध्यते वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
idenyo namasyastirastamamsi darshatah |
samagniridhyate vrisha ||
verses.en: Meet to be worshipped and implored, showing in beauty through the gloom, Agni, the strong, is kindled well.

verses.sa:
वृषो अग्निः समिध्यतेऽश्वो न देववाहनः ।
तं हविष्मन्त ईडते ॥
verses.rom:
vrisho agnih samidhyate'shvo na devavahanah |
tam havishmanta idate ||
verses.en: Strong Agni is enkindled well, even as the horse that brings the Gods: Men with oblations pray to him.

verses.sa:
वृषणं त्वा वयं वृषन्वृषणः समिधीमहि ।
अग्ने दीद्यतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishanam tva vayam vrishanvrishanah samidhimahi |
agne didyatam brihat ||
verses.en: We will enkindle thee, the strong, we, hero! who axe strong ourselves,

verses.sa:
उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः ।
अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते ॥
verses.rom:
utte brihanto archayah samidhanasya didivah |
agne shukrasa irate ||
verses.en: Thy mighty flames, O Agni, when thou art enkindled, rise on high, Thy bright flames, thou refulgent one

verses.sa:
उप त्वा जुह्वो३ मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत ।
अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva juhvo3 mama ghritachiryantu haryata |
agne havya jushasva nah ||
verses.en: Beloved! let my ladies full of sacred oil come nigh to thee. Agni, accept our offerings!

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुं ।
अग्निमीडे स उ श्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
mandram hotaramritvijam chitrabhanum vibhavasum |
agnimide sa u shravat ||
verses.en: I pray to Agni--may he hear!--the Hotar with sweet tones, the Priest, Wondrously splendid, rich in light,

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया ।
पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥
verses.rom:
pahi no agna ekaya pahyu3ta dvitiyaya |
pahi girbhistisribhirurjam pate pahi chatasribhirvaso ||

verses.sa:
पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव ।
त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
pahi vishvasmadrakshaso aravnah pra sma vajeshu no'va |
tvamiddhi nedishtham devatataya apim nakshamahe vridhe ||

verses.sa:
इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमां अदर्शि ।
चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन् ॥
verses.rom:
ino rajannaratih samiddho raudro dakshaya sushumam adarshi |
chikidvi bhati bhasa brihatasiknimeti rushatimapajan ||
verses.en: O King, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty. He shines, observant, with his lofty splendour; chasing black night he comes with white- rayed morning.

verses.sa:
कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसाभूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जां ।
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति ॥
verses.rom:
krishnam yadenimabhi varpasabhujjanayanyosham brihatah piturjam |
urdhvam bhanum suryasya stabhayandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhati ||
verses.en: Having o'ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the Dame, the great Sire's daughter, Holding aloft the radiant lights of Surya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.

verses.sa:
भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् ।
सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
bhadro bhadraya sachamana agatsvasaram jaro abhyeti pashchat |
supraketairdyubhiragnirvitishthanrushadbhirvarnairabhi ramamasthat ||
verses.en: Attendant on the blessed Dame the blessed hath come: the lover followeth his sister. Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath covered night with whitely-shining garments.

verses.sa:
कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिं ।
वराय देव मन्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
kaya te agne angira urjo napadupastutim |
varaya deva manyave ||

verses.sa:
दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो ।
कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
dashema kasya manasa yajnasya sahaso yaho |
kadu vocha idam namah ||

verses.sa:
अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः ।
वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
adha tvam hi naskaro vishva asmabhyam sukshitih |
vajadravinaso girah ||

prose.en:
What is the praise wherewith, O God, Angiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,

May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan? What reverent word shall I speak here?

verses.sa:
अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ।
आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.rom:
agna a yahyagnibhirhotaram tva vrinimahe |
a tvamanaktu prayata havishmati yajishtham barhirasade ||
verses.en: Agni, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as our Hotar; let The proffered ladle filled with offerings balm thee, best of priests, to sit on sacred grass!

verses.sa:
अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे ।
ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.rom:
achchha hi tva sahasah suno angirah sruchashcharantyadhvare |
urjo napatam ghritakeshamimahe'gnim yajneshu purvyam ||
verses.en: For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice. We pray to Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, foremost in sacrificial rites.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतं ।
अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
achchha nah shirashochisham giro yantu darshatam |
achchha yajnaso namasa puruvasum puruprashastamutaye ||

verses.sa:
अग्निं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणां ।
द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥
verses.rom:
agnim sunum sahaso jatavedasam danaya varyanam |
dvita yo bhudamrito martyeshva hota mandratamo vishi ||

prose.en:
Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame, Our sacrifices with our homage unto him much-lauded, very rich, for help:

To Agni Jatavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts,

Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, whose tones are sweetest in the house!

verses.sa:
अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणां ।
तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः ॥
verses.rom:
adabhyah puraeta vishamagnirmanushinam |
turni rathah sada navah ||

verses.sa:
अभि प्रयांसि वाहसा दाश्वां अश्नोति मर्त्यः ।
क्षयं पावकशोचिषः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi prayamsi vahasa dashvam ashnoti martyah |
kshayam pavakashochishah ||

verses.sa:
साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः ।
अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
sahvanvishva abhiyujah kraturdevanamamriktah |
agnistuvishravastamah ||

verses.sa:
भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः ।
भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadro no agnirahuto bhadra ratih subhaga bhadro adhvarah |
bhadra uta prashastayah ||

verses.sa:
भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहिः ।
अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram manah krinushva vritraturye yena samatsu sasahih |
ava sthira tanuhi bhuri shardhatam vanema te abhishtaye ||

prose.en:
Invincible is Agni, he who goes before the tribes of men, A chariot swift and ever new.

By bringing offerings unto him the mortal worshipper obtains A home from him whose light is pure.

Inviolable power of Gods, subduing all his enemies, Agni is mightiest in fame.

verses.sa:
अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो ।
अस्मे देहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vajasya gomata ishanah sahaso yaho |
asme dehi jatavedo mahi shravah ||

verses.sa:
स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीडेन्यो गिरा ।
रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa idhano vasushkaviragniridenyo gira |
revadasmabhyam purvanika didihi ||

verses.sa:
क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः ।
स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
kshapo rajannuta tmanagne vastorutoshasah |
sa tigmajambha rakshaso daha prati ||

prose.en:
May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss, Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss

Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight! Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and for thy victory let us win!

verses.sa:
विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियं ।
अग्निं वो दुर्यं वच स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishovisho vo atithim vajayantah purupriyam |
agnim vo duryam vacha stushe shushasya manmabhih ||
verses.en: O Agni thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown

verses.sa:
यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिं ।
प्रशंसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yam janaso havishmanto mitram na sarpirasutim |
prashamsanti prashastibhih ||
verses.en: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be entreated with a. song; Shine, thou of many forms, shine thou with wealth on us

verses.sa:
पन्यांसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता ।
हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
panyamsam jatavedasam yo devatatyudyata |
havyanyairayaddivi ||
verses.en: And, Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Rakshasas

verses.sa:
समिद्धमग्निं समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवं ।
विप्रं होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविं सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसं ॥
verses.rom:
samiddhamagnim samidha gira grine shuchim pavakam puro adhvare dhruvam |
vipram hotaram puruvaramadruham kavim sumnairimahe jatavedasam ||
verses.en: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech, Agni, your dear familiar friend, the darling guest of every house:

verses.sa:
त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यम् ।
देवासश्च मर्त्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dutamagne amritam yugeyuge havyavaham dadhire payumidyam |
devasashcha marttasashcha jagrivim vibhum vishpatim namasa ni shedire ||
verses.en: Whom, served with sacrificial oil, like Mitra, men presenting gifts, Glorify with their songs of praise

verses.sa:
विभूषन्नग्न उभयां अनु व्रता दूतो देवानां रजसी समीयसे ।
यत्ते धीतिं सुमतिमावृणीमहेऽध स्मा नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव ॥
verses.rom:
vibhushannagna ubhayam anu vrata duto devanam rajasi samiyase |
yatte dhitim sumatimavrinimahe'dha sma nastrivaruthah shivo bhava ||
verses.en: Much-lauded Jatavedas, him who sends oblations up to heaven, Prepared in service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः ।
वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva jamayo giro dedishatirhavishkritah |
vayoranike asthiran ||
verses.en: Agni, inflamed with fuel, in my song I sing, pure bright, and stedfast set in front at sacrifice. Wise Jatavedas we implore with prayers for grace, the Sage, the Hotar-priest, bounteous, and void of guile.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसन्दिनं ।
आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदं ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tridhatvavritam barhistasthavasandinam |
apashchinni dadha padam ||
verses.en: Men, Agni, in each age, have made thee, deathless one, their envoy, offering-bearer, guard adorable. With reverence Gods and mortals have established thee as everwatchful and almighty household Lord.

verses.sa:
पदं देवस्य मीढुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः ।
भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥
verses.rom:
padam devasya midhusho'nadhrishtabhirutibhih |
bhadra surya ivopadrik ||
verses.en: Though, Agni ordering the works and ways of both, as envoy of the Gods traversest both the realms. When we lay claim to thy regard and gracious care, be thou to us a th rice- protecting friendly guard?

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः ।
समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva purvapitaya indra stomebhirayavah |
samichinasa ribhavah samasvaranrudra grinanta purvyam ||
verses.en: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

verses.sa:
अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि ।
अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ॥
verses.rom:
asyedindro vavridhe vrishnyam shavo made sutasya vishnavi |
adya tamasya mahimanamayavo'nu shtuvanti purvatha ||
verses.en: Indra, at sacrifice, increased his manly strength, in the wild rapture of this juice: And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty.

verses.sa:
प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः ।
इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥
verses.rom:
pra vamarchantyukthino nithavido jaritarah |
indragni isha a vrine ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni! singers skilled in melody, with lauds, hymn you: I choose you both to bring me food.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतं ।
साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
indragni navatim puro dasapatniradhunutam |
sakamekena karmana ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni! ye shook down, together, with one mightyr deed, The ninety forts which Dasas held.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः ।
ऋतस्य पथ्याऽऽ३ अनु ॥
verses.rom:
indragni apasasparyupa pra yanti dhitayah |
ritasya pathya''3 anu ||
verses.en: To Indra and to Agni prayers go forward from the holy task, Along the path of sacred Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणी वां सधस्थानि प्रयांसि च ।
युवोरप्तूर्यं हितं ॥
verses.rom:
indragni tavishani vam sadhasthani prayamsi cha |
yuvorapturyam hitam ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, powers are yours, yours are oblations ano abodes: Good is your zealous energy.

verses.sa:
शग्ध्यू३ षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhyu3 shu shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
bhagam na hi tva yashasam vasuvidamanu shura charamasi ||
verses.en: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finder-out of wealth!

verses.sa:
पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ।
न किर्हि दानं परि मर्धिषत्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
pauro ashvasya purukridgavamasyutso deva hiranyayah |
na kirhi danam pari mardhishatve yadyadyami tada bhara ||
verses.en: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, G God, art thou, For no one may impair the gift laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask!

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये ।
उद्वावृषस्व मधवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyehi cherave vida bhagam vasuttaye |
udvavrishasva madhavangavishtaya udindrashvamishtaye ||
verses.en: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, forthe gain of steeds!

verses.sa:
त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मंहसे ।
आ पुरन्दरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तोऽवसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam puru sahasrani shatani cha yutha danaya mamhase |
a purandaram chakrima vipravachasa indram gayanto'vase ||
verses.en: Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thou-sands dost thou give. With singers' hymns have we brought the fortrender near, singing to Indra for his grace.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानां ।
मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishva dayate vasu hota mandro jananam |
madhorna patra prathamanyasmai pra stoma yantvagnaye ||
verses.en: To him who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth!

verses.sa:
अश्व न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः ।
उभे तोके तनये दस्म विस्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनां ॥
verses.rom:
ashva na girbhi rathyam sudanavo marmrijyante devayavah |
ubhe toke tanaye dasma vispate parshi radho maghonam ||
verses.en: Votaries, bounteous givers, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. To both, strong Lord of men! to kith and kin convey the bounties of our wealthy lords!

verses.sa:
इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृडय ।
त्वामवस्युरा चके ॥
verses.rom:
imam me varuna shrudhi havamadya cha mridaya |
tvamavasyura chake ||
verses.en: Hear this my call, O Varuna, and show thy gracious love today: Desiring help I long for thee!

verses.sa:
कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् ।
कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
kaya tvam na utyabhi pra mandase vrishan |
kaya stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring, Riches to those who worship thee?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥
verses.rom:
indramiddevatataya indram prayatyadhvare |
indram samike vanino havamaha indram dhanasya sataye ||
verses.en: Indra, for service of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as worshippers, in battle-shock we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् ।
इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
indro mahna rodasi paprathachchhava indrah suryamarochayat |
indre ha vishva bhuvanani yemira indre suvanasa indavah ||
verses.en: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath indra lighten up the Sun. In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वा३ं स्वा हि ते ।
मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
vishvakarmanhavisha vavridhanah svayam yajasva tanva3m sva hi te |
muhyantvanye abhito janasa ihasmakam maghava surirastu ||
verses.en: Bring, Visvakarman strengthened by oblation, thyself, thy body-'tis thine own-for worship Let other men around us live in folly here let us have', a rich and liberal patron!

verses.sa:
अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः ।
धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः ।
विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
aya rucha harinya punano vishva dveshamsi tarati sayugvabhih suro na sayugvabhih |
dhara prishthasya rochate punano arusho harih |
vishva yadrupa pariyasyrikvabhih saptasyebhirrikvabhih ||
verses.en: With this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies. as Sura with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with his praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.

verses.sa:
प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं पाति चेकितत्सं रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः ।
अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौंस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन् ।
वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता ॥
verses.rom:
prachimanu pradisham pati chekitatsam rashmibhiryatate darshato ratho daivyo darshato rathah |
agmannukthani paumsyendram jaitraya harshayan |
vajrashcha yadbhavatho anapachyuta samatsvanapachyuta ||
verses.en: He moves intelligent directed to the east. The every beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car. Hymns, lauding manly valour, came inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे ।
परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः ।
त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyatpaninam vido vasu sam matribhirmarjayasi sva a dama ritasya dhitibhirdame |
paravato na sama tadyatra rananti dhitayah |
tridhatubhirarushibhirvayo dadhe rochamano vayo dadhe ||
verses.en: That treasure of the Panis thou discoveredst. Thou with the Mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with, songs of worship in thine home. As 'twere from far away is heard the psalm where hymns resound in joy. He, with the triple Dames red-hued, hath won life-power, he, gleaming, hath won vital strength.

verses.sa:
उत नो गोषणिं धियमश्वसां वाजसामुत ।
नृवत्कृणुह्यूतये ॥
verses.rom:
uta no goshanim dhiyamashvasam vajasamuta |
nrivatkrinuhyutaye ||
verses.en: Yea, cause our hymn to gain for us cattle and steeds and store of wealth, That it may help us manfully!

verses.sa:
शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः ।
विदा कामस्य वेनतः ॥
verses.rom:
shashamanasya va narah svedasya satyashavasah |
vida kamasya venatah ||
verses.en: Heroes of real strength, ye mark either the sweat of him who toils, Or his desire who supplicates.

verses.sa:
उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये ।
सुमृडीका भवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
upa nah sunavo girah shrinvantvamritasya ye |
sumridika bhavantu nah ||
verses.en: The Sons of immortality shall listen to our songs of praise, And be exceeding kind to us.

verses.sa:
प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे ।
शुची उप प्रशस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
pra vam mahi dyavi abhyupastutim bharamahe |
shuchi upa prashastaye ||
verses.en: To both of you, O Heaven and Earth, we bring our lofty song of praise, Pure pair! to glorify you both.

verses.sa:
पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः ।
ऊह्याथे सनादृतं ॥
verses.rom:
punane tanva mithah svena dakshena rajathah |
uhyathe sanadritam ||
verses.en: Ye sanctify each other's form by your own proper strength ye rule: Further the sacrifice evermore!

verses.sa:
मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतं ।
परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi mitrasya sadhathastaranti piprati ritam |
pari yajnam ni shedathuh ||
verses.en: Promoting and fulfilling, ye, mighty ones, perfect Mitra's law: Ye sit around our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिं ।
वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim |
vachastachchinna ohase ||
verses.en: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.

verses.sa:
स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते ।
विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता ॥
verses.rom:
stotram radhanam pate girvaho vira yasya te |
vibhutirastu sunrita ||
verses.en: O hero, Lord of bounties, praised in hymns, may glorious fame and might Be his who sings the laud to thee

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो ।
समन्येषु ब्रवावहै ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvastishtha na utaye'sminvaje shatakrato |
samanyeshu bravavahai ||
verses.en: Lord of a Hundred Powers, rise up to be our succour in this fight: In other fights let us agree

verses.sa:
गाव उप वदावटे मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा ।
उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
verses.rom:
gava upa vadavate mahi yajnasya rapsuda |
ubha karna hiranyaya ||
verses.en: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sa:
अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु ।
अवटस्य विसर्जने ॥
verses.rom:
abhyaramidadrayo nishiktam pushkare madhu |
avatasya visarjane ||
verses.en: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank At the out-shedding of the fount.

verses.sa:
सिञ्चन्ति नमसावटमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानं ।
नीचीनबारमक्षितं ॥
verses.rom:
sinchanti namasavatamuchchachakram parijmanam |
nichinabaramakshitam ||
verses.en: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above. Exhaustless, with the mouth below.

verses.sa:
मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव ।
महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुं ॥
verses.rom:
ma bhema ma shramishmograsya sakhye tava |
mahatte vrishno abhichakshyam kritam pashyema turvasham yadum ||
verses.en: Let us not tire or be afraid with thee, the mighty, for our friend! May we see Turvasa and Yadu! thy great deed, O hero, must be glorified.

verses.sa:
सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृष्ना न दानो अस्य रोषति ।
मध्वा संपृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
savyamanu sphigyam vavase vrishna na dano asya roshati |
madhva sampriktah saraghena dhenavastuyamehi drava piba ||
verses.en: On his left hip the hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not. The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, haste, and drink!

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम ।
पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva puruvaso giro vardhantu ya mama |
pavakavarnah shuchayo vipashchito'bhi stomairanushata ||
verses.en: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

verses.sa:
अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे ।
सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sahasramrishibhih sahaskritah samudra iva paprathe |
satyah so asya mahima grine shavo yajneshu viprarajye ||
verses.en: He, when a thousand Rishis have enhanced his might, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.

verses.sa:
यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः ।
तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyayam vishva aryo dasah shevadhipa arih |
tirashchidarye rushame paviravi tubhyetso ajyate rayih ||
verses.en: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, Dasas here belong. Directly unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.

verses.sa:
तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः ।
अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवोऽस्मे स्वानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
turanyavo madhumantam ghritashchatam vipraso arkamanrichuh |
asme rayih paprathe vrishnyam shavo'sme svanasa indavah ||
verses.en: In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling fatness, rich in sweets. Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops.

verses.sa:
गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धनिव ।
शुचिं च वर्णमधि गोषु धार्य ॥
verses.rom:
gomanna indo ashvavatsutah sudaksha dhaniva |
shuchim cha varnamadhi goshu dharya ||
verses.en: Flow to us, Indu, very strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds, And do thou lay above the milk thy radiant hue

verses.sa:
स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः ।
सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव ॥
verses.rom:
sa no harinam pata indo devapsarastamah |
sakheva sakhye naryo ruche bhava ||
verses.en: Lord of the tawny, Indu, thou who art the Gods' most special food, As friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men!

verses.sa:
सनेमि त्वमस्मदा अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणं ।
साह्वां इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुं ॥
verses.rom:
sanemi tvamasmada adevam kam chidatrinam |
sahvam indo pari badho apa dvayum ||
verses.en: Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious; foe; O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar!

verses.sa:
अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुं रिहन्ति मध्वाभ्यञ्जते ।
सिन्धोरुऽच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमप्सु गृभ्णते ॥
verses.rom:
anjate vyanjate samanjate kratum rihanti madhvabhyanjate |
sindhoru'chchhvase patayantamukshanam hiranyapavah pashumapsu gribhnate ||
verses.en: They balm him, balm him over, balm him thoroughly, caress. the mighty strength and balm it with the meath. They seize the flying Steer at the stream's breathing place cleansing with gold they grasp the animal herein.

verses.sa:
विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति ।
अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीडन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
vipashchite pavamanaya gayata mahi na dharatyandho arshati |
ahirna jurnamati sarpati tvachamatyo na kridannasaradvrisha harih ||
verses.en: Sing forth to Pavamana skilled in holy song! the juice is flowing onward like a mighty stream. He glideth like a serpent from his ancient skin, and like a. playful horse the tawny Steer hath run.

verses.sa:
अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agrego rajapyastavishyate vimano ahnam bhuvaneshvarpitah |
harirghritasnuh sudrishiko arnavo jyotirathah pavate raya okyah ||
verses.en: Dweller in floods, King, foremost, he displays his might, set among living things as measure of days. Distilling oil he flows, fair, billowy, golden-hued, borne on car of light, sharing on home with wealth.

verses.sa:
विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः ।
चनो घाः सहसा यहो ॥
verses.rom:
vishvebhiragne agnibhirimam yajnamidam vachah |
chano ghah sahasa yaho ||
verses.en: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O son of Strength!

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि शश्वा तना देवंदेवं यजामहे ।
त्वे इद्धूयते हविः ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi shashva tana devamdevam yajamahe |
tve iddhuyate havih ||
verses.en: Whate'er, in this perpetual course, we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered but in thee.

verses.sa:
प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः ।
प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयं ॥
verses.rom:
priyo no astu vishpatirhota mandro varenyah |
priyah svagnayo vayam ||
verses.en: May he be our beloved King and excellent sweet-toned Hotar may We with bright fires be dear to him

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः ।
अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
verses.rom:
indram vo vishvataspari havamahe janebhyah |
asmakamastu kevalah ||
verses.en: For you from every side we call Indra away from other men Ours, and none others, may he be!

verses.sa:
स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि ।
अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vrishannamum charum satradavannapa vridhi |
asmabhyamapratishkutah ||
verses.en: Unclose, our manly hero! thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud For us, thou irresistible

verses.sa:
बृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा ।
ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
brisha yutheva vamsagah krishtiriyartyojasa |
ishano apratishkutah ||
verses.en: As the strong bull leads on the herds, he stirs the people with his might, The ruler irresistible.

verses.sa:
त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधांसि चोदय ।
अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nashchitra utya vaso radhamsi chodaya |
asya rayastvamagne rathirasi vida gadham tuche tu nah ||
verses.en: Wonderful, with thy saving help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord! Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!

verses.sa:
पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः ।
अग्ने हेडांसि दैव्या युयोधि नोऽदेवानि हरांसि च ॥
verses.rom:
parshi tokam tanayam partribhishtvamadabdhairaprayutvabhih |
agne hedamsi daivya yuyodhi no'devani haramsi cha ||
verses.en: Prosper our kith and kin with thy protecting powers inviolate, never negligent! Keep far from us, O Agni, all celestial wrath. and wickedness of godless men!

verses.sa:
किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्षि नाम प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि ।
मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
kimitte vishno parichakshi nama pra yadvavakshe shipivishto asmi |
ma varpo asmadapa guha etadyadanyarupah samithe babhutha ||
verses.en: What, Vishnu, is the name that thou proclaimest when thou declaredst, I am Sipivishta? Hide not this form from us, nor keep it secret, since thou didst wear another shape in battle.

verses.sa:
प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट हव्यमर्यः शंसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके ॥
verses.rom:
pra tatte adya shipivishta havyamaryah shamsami vayunani vidvan |
tam tva grinami tavasamatavyankshayantamasya rajasah parake ||
verses.en: This offering to-day, O Sipivishta, I, skilled in rules, extol, to thee the noble. Yea, I, the poor and weak, praise thee, the mighty, who dwellest in the realm beyond this region.

verses.sa:
वषट्ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यं ।
वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
vashatte vishnavasa a krinomi tanme jushasva shipivishta havyam |
vardhantu tva sushtutayo giro me yuyam pata svastabhih sada nah ||
verses.en: O Vishnu, unto thee my lips cry Vashat! Let this mine offering, Sipivishta, please thee! May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings!

verses.sa:
वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु ।
आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता ॥
verses.rom:
vayo shukro ayami te madhvo agram divishtishu |
a yahi somapitaye sparho deva niyutvata ||
verses.en: Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath, at morning rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God, longed for on thy team-drawn car!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः ।
युवां हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
verses.rom:
indrashcha vayavesham somanam pitimarhathah |
yuvam hi yantindavo nimnamapo na sadhryak ||
verses.en: O Vayu, thou and Indra are meet drinkers of these Soma draughts, For unto you the drops proceed like waters gathering to the vale.

verses.sa:
वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथं शवसस्पती ।
नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vayavindrashcha shushmina saratham shavasaspati |
niyutvanta na utaya a yatam somapitaye ||
verses.en: Vayu and Indra, mighty twain, borne on one chariot, Lords of strength, Come to ouf succour with your steeds, that ye may drink the Soma juice!

verses.sa:
अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजां अभि प्र गाहते ।
यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिं हिन्वन्ति यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
adha kshapa parishkrito vajam abhi pra gahate |
yadi vivasvato dhiyo harim hinvanti yatave ||
verses.en: Then thou, made beautiful by night, enterest into mighty deeds, When prayers impel the golden-hued to hasten from Vivasvan's place.

verses.sa:
तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः ।
यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya marjayamasi mado ya indrapatamah |
yam gava asabhirdadhuh pura nunam cha surayah ||
verses.en: We cleanse this gladdening drink of his, the juice which Indra chiefly drinks, That which kine took into their mouths, oF old, and princes take it now.

verses.sa:
तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत ।
उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः ॥
verses.rom:
tam gathaya puranya punanamabhyanushata |
uto kripanta dhitayo devanam nama bibhratih ||
verses.en: Thy with the ancient psalm have sung to him as he is purified, And sacred songs which bear the Dames of Gods have supplicated him.

verses.sa:
अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः ।
सम्राजन्तमध्वराणां ॥
verses.rom:
ashvam na tva varavantam vandadhya agnim namobhih |
samrajantamadhvaranam ||
verses.en: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of holy rites.

verses.sa:
स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः ।
मीढ्वां अस्माकं बभूयात् ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha nah sunuh shavasa prithupragama sushevah |
midhvam asmakam babhuyat ||
verses.en: May the far-striding Son of Strength, our friend who brings felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours

verses.sa:
स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः ।
पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no durachchasachcha ni martyadaghayoh |
pahi sadamidvishvayuh ||
verses.en: From near and far away do thou, the everlasting, evermore Protect us from the sinful man!

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः ।
अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra praturtishvabhi vishva asi spridhah |
ashastiha janita vritraturasi tvam turya tarushyatah ||
verses.en: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher!

verses.sa:
अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा ।
विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥
verses.rom:
anu te shushmam turayantamiyatuh kshoni shishum na matara |
vishvaste spridhah shnathayanta manyave vritram yadindra turvasi ||
verses.en: The earth and heaven cling close to thy victorious might, as sire and mother to their child. When thou attackest Vritra, all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.

verses.sa:
यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् ।
चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
yajna indramavardhayadyadbhumim vyavartayat |
chakrana opasham divi ||
verses.en: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.

verses.sa:
व्या३न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना ।
इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलं ॥
verses.rom:
vya3ntarikshamatiranmade somasya rochana |
indro yadabhinadvalam ||
verses.en: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

verses.sa:
उदगा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः ।
अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलं ॥
verses.rom:
udaga ajadangirobhya avishkrinvanguha satih |
arvancham nunude valam ||
verses.en: Showing the hidden, he drave forth the cows for the Angirasas, And Vala he cast headlong down.

verses.sa:
त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतं ।
आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
verses.rom:
tyamu vah satrasaham vishvasu girshvayatam |
a chyavayasyutaye ||
verses.en: Thou speedest down to succour us this-ever-conquering God of yours, Him who is drawn to all our songs;

verses.sa:
युध्मं सन्तमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतं ।
नरमवार्यक्रतुं ॥
verses.rom:
yudhmam santamanarvanam somapamanapachyutam |
naramavaryakratum ||
verses.en: The warrior whom none may wound, the Soma-drinker ne'er o'erthrown, The chieftain of resistless might.

verses.sa:
शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वां ऋचीषम ।
अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥
verses.rom:
shiksha na indra raya a puru vidvam richishama |
ava nah parye dhane ||
verses.en: O Indra, send us riches, thou omniscient, worthy of our hymns: Help us in the decisive fray!

verses.sa:
तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव दक्ष्ममुत क्रतुं ।
वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यं ॥
verses.rom:
tava tyadindriyam brihattava dakshmamuta kratum |
vajram shishati dhishana varenyam ||
verses.en: That lofty power and might of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, And thy surpassing thunderbolt, the wish makes keen.

verses.sa:
तव द्यौरिन्द्र प्ॐस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः ।
त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
tava dyaurindra pomsyam prithivi vardhati shravah |
tvamapah parvatasashcha hinvire ||
verses.en: O Indra, heaven and earth augment thy manly force and thy renown: The waters and the mountains stir and urge thee on:

verses.sa:
त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः ।
त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतं ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishnurbrihankshayo mitro grinati varunah |
tvam shardho madatyanu marutam ||
verses.en: Vishnu in the lofty ruling power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Maruts' company have great delight.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः ।
अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
verses.rom:
namaste agna ojase grinanti deva krishtayah |
amairamitramardaya ||
verses.en: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe

verses.sa:
कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिं ।
उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
kuvitsu no gavishtaye'gne samveshisho rayim |
urukriduru naskridhi ||
verses.en: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid to win the cattle, win the wealth? Maker of room, make room for us

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्ने महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा ।
संवर्गं सं रयिं जय ॥
verses.rom:
ma no agne mahadhane para vargbharabhridyatha |
samvargam sam rayim jaya ||
verses.en: In the great fight cast us not off, Agni, as one who bears a load: Snatch up the wealth and win it all!

verses.sa:
समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः ।
समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥
verses.rom:
samasya manyave visho vishva namanta krishtayah |
samudrayeva sindhavah ||
verses.en: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.

verses.sa:
वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतः शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना ।
वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
verses.rom:
vi chidvritrasya dodhatah shiro bibheda vrishnina |
vajrena shataparvana ||
verses.en: Even fiercely-moving Vritra's head he served with his thunderbolt, His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.

verses.sa:
ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्त्तयत् ।
इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ojastadasya titvisha ubhe yatsamavarttayat |
indrashcharmeva rodasi ||
verses.en: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.

verses.sa: सुमन्मा वस्वी रन्ती सूनरी ॥
verses.rom: sumanma vasvi ranti sunari ||
verses.en: Kind-thoughted is the noble, gladdening, friendly one.

verses.sa:
सरूप वृषन्ना गहीमौ भद्रौ धुर्यावभि ।
ताविमा उप सर्पतः ॥
verses.rom:
sarupa vrishanna gahimau bhadrau dhuryavabhi |
tavima upa sarpatah ||
verses.en: Approach, O beauteous hero, this auspicious pair that draws the car! These two are coming near to us.

verses.sa:
नीव शीर्षाणि मृढ्वं मध्य आपस्य तिष्ठति ।
शृङ्गेभिर्दशभिर्दिशन् ॥
verses.rom:
niva shirshani mridhvam madhya apasya tishthati |
shringebhirdashabhirdishan ||
