verses.en: Bend lowly down, as 'twere, your beads: be stands amid the water-flood, Pointing with his ten horns the way.

verses.sa:
पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय ।
सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥
verses.rom:
panyampanyamitsotara a dhavata madyaya |
somam viraya shuraya ||
verses.en: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draugbt most excellent, for him The brave, the: hero, for his joy!

verses.sa:
एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायं ।
इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसं ॥
verses.rom:
eha hari brahmayuja shagma vakshatah sakhayam |
indram girbhirgirvanasam ||
verses.en: The two stroing bay steeds, voked by prayer, hither shall bring to us our friend, Indra, song-lover, through our songs.

verses.sa:
पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् ।
नि यमते शतमूतिः ॥
verses.rom:
pata vritraha sutama gha gamannare asmat |
ni yamate shatamutih ||
verses.en: The Vritra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aids Approach, nor stay afar from us!

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vishantvindavah samudramiva sindhavah |
na tvamindrati richyate ||
verses.en: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee.

verses.sa:
विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे ।
य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते ॥
verses.rom:
vivyaktha mahina vrishanbhaksham somasya jagrive |
ya indra jathareshu te ||
verses.en: 'Thou' wakeful hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.

verses.sa:
अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् ।
अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
aram ta indra kukshaye somo bhavatu vritrahan |
aram dhamabhya indavah ||
verses.en: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms!

verses.sa:
जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय ।
स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकं ॥
verses.rom:
jarabodha tadvividdhi vishevishe yajniyaya |
stomam rudraya drishikam ||
verses.en: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra's praise, Adorable in every house

verses.sa:
स नो महां अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः ।
धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
sa no maham animano dhumaketuh purushchandrah |
dhiye vajaya hinvatu ||
verses.en: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered, excellently bright, Urge us to holy thought and wealth

verses.sa:
स रेवां इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः ।
उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa revam iva vishpatirdaivyah ketuh shrinotu nah |
ukthairagnirbrihadbhanuh ||
verses.en: Like soma rich lord of men, may he, Agni, the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds!

verses.sa:
तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने ।
शं यद्गवे न शाकिने ॥
verses.rom:
tadvo gaya sute sacha puruhutaya satvane |
sham yadgave na shakine ||
verses.en: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him, your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull!

verses.sa:
न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः ।
यत्सीमुपश्रवद्गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
na gha vasurni yamate danam vajasya gomatah |
yatsimupashravadgirah ||
verses.en: He, excellent, withholdeth not his bounteous gift of wealth in kine. When lie bath listened to our songs.

verses.sa:
कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत् ।
शचीभिरप नो वरत् ॥
verses.rom:
kuvitsasya pra hi vrajam gomantam dasyuha gamat |
shachibhirapa no varat ||
verses.en: May he with might unclose for us the cow's stall, whosesoe'er it be, To which the Dasyu-slayer goes!

verses.sa:
इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदं ।
समूढमस्य पांसुले ॥
verses.rom:
idam vishnurvi chakrame tredha ni dadhe padam |
samudhamasya pamsule ||
verses.en: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः ।
अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ॥
verses.rom:
trini pada vi chakrame vishnurgopa adabhyah |
ato dharmani dharayan ||
verses.en: Vishnu, the guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps, thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे ।
इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh karmani pashyata yato vratani paspashe |
indrasya yujyah sakha ||
verses.en: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen

verses.sa:
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः ।
दिवीव चक्षुराततं ॥
verses.rom:
tadvishnoh paramam padam sada pashyanti surayah |
diviva chakshuratatam ||
verses.en: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place of Vishnu, like An eye extended through the heavens.

verses.sa:
तद्विप्रासो विपन्युवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते ।
विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदं ॥
verses.rom:
tadvipraso vipanyuvo jagrivamsah samindhate |
vishnoryatparamam padam ||
verses.en: This, Vishou's station most sublime, the sages, ever-vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.

verses.sa:
अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे ।
पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
ato deva avantu no yato vishnurvichakrame |
prithivya adhi sanavi ||
verses.en: May the Gods help and favour us out of the place whence Vishnu strode Over the back and ridge of earth.

verses.sa:
मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् ।
आरात्ताद्व सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu tva vaghatashcha nare asmanni riraman |
arattadva sadhamadam na a gahiha va sannupa shrudhi ||
verses.en: Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us! Even from far away come thou unto our feast, or listen it already here!

verses.sa:
इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न मक्ष आसते ।
इन्द्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः ॥
verses.rom:
ime hi te brahmakritah sute sacha madhau na maksha asate |
indre kamam jaritaro vasuyavo rathe na padama dadhuh ||
verses.en: For here, like rites on honey, those who pray to thee sit by the juice that they have poured. Wealth-craving singers have on Indra set their hope, as men set foot upon a car.

verses.sa:
अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत ।
पूर्वीरृतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
astavi manma purvyam brahmendraya vochata |
purvirritasya brihatiranushata stoturmedha asrikshata ||
verses.en: Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer. They have sung many a Brihati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यं ।
सं शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
samindro rayo brihatiradhunuta sam kshoni samu suryam |
sam shukrasah shuchayah sam gavashirah soma indramamandishuh ||
verses.en: Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the sun. Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे ।
नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma patave vritraghne pari shichyase |
nare cha dakshinavate devaya sadanasade ||
verses.en: For Vritra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, And for the guerdon-giving man, the hero sitting in his seat.

verses.sa:
तं सखायः पुरूरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः ।
अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यं सनेम वाजपस्त्यं ॥
verses.rom:
tam sakhayah pururucham yuyam vayam cha surayah |
ashyama vajagandhyam sanema vajapastyam ||
verses.en: Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this most resplendent one, Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength!

verses.sa:
परि त्यं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण ।
यो देवान्विश्वां इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
pari tyam haryatam harim babhrum punanti varena |
yo devanvishvam itpari madena saha gachchhati ||
verses.en: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all. Who with exhilarating juice flows forth to all the deities.

verses.sa:
कस्तमिन्द्र त्वावसो मर्त्यो दधर्षति ।
श्रद्धा इत्तेमघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
kastamindra tvavaso martyo dadharshati |
shraddha ittemaghavanparye divi vaji vajam sishasati ||
verses.en: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!

verses.sa:
मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु ।
तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता ॥
verses.rom:
maghonah sma vritrahatyeshu chodaya ye dadati priya vasu |
tava praniti haryashva suribhirvishva tarema durita ||
verses.en: In battles with the foe urge on our mighty ones who give the treasures dear to thee And may we with our princes, Lord of tawny steeds! pass through all peril, led by thee!

verses.sa:
एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरं सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः ।
एवा हि वीर स्तवते सदावृधः ॥
verses.rom:
edu madhormadintaram sinchadhvaryo andhasah |
eva hi vira stavate sadavridhah ||
verses.en: Come, priest, and of the savoury juice pour forth a yet more gladdening draught! So is the hero praised who ever prospers us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां न किष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिं ।
उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना ॥
verses.rom:
indra sthatarharinam na kishte purvyastutim |
udanamsha shavasa na bhandana ||
verses.en: Indra, whom tawny coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

verses.sa:
तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः ।
अप्रायुभिर्ज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यं ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo vajanam patimahumahi shravasyavah |
aprayubhirjnebhirvavridhenyam ||
verses.en: We, seeking glory, have invoked this God of yours, the Lord of wealth, Who must be magnified by constant sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे ।
देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे ॥
verses.rom:
tam gurdhaya svarnaram devaso devamaratim dadhanvire |
devatra havyamuhishe ||
verses.en: Sing praise to him, the Lord of light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.

verses.sa:
विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीडिष्व यन्तुरं ।
अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यं ॥
verses.rom:
vibhutaratim vipra chitrashochishamagnimidishva yanturam |
asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvaraya purvyam ||
verses.en: Agni, the bounteous giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari, Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice!

verses.sa:
आ सोम सवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।
जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दध्रिषे ॥
verses.rom:
a soma savano adribhistiro varanyavyaya |
jano na puri chamvorvishaddharih sado vaneshu dadhrishe ||
verses.en: Expressed by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep, Thou, entering the press-boards, even as men a fort, goldbued, hast settled in the vats.

verses.sa:
स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीड्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।
अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिरृक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa mamrije tiro anvani meshyo midvantsaptirna vajayuh |
anumadyah pavamano manishibhih somo viprebhirrikvabhih ||
verses.en: He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, the bounteous, like the racing steed, Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards.

verses.sa:
वयमेनमिदा ह्योऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणं ।
तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥
verses.rom:
vayamenamida hyo'pipemeha vajrinam |
tasma u adya savane sutam bhara nunam bhushata shrute ||
verses.en: Here, verily, yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day! Now range you by the glorious one!

verses.sa:
वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति ।
सेमं न स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया ॥
verses.rom:
vrikashchidasya varana uramathira vayuneshu bhushati |
semam na stomam jujushana a gahindra pra chitraya dhiya ||
verses.en: Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees. So graciously accepting, Indra, this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us!

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः ।
तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यं ॥
verses.rom:
indragni rochana divah pari vajeshu bhushathah |
tadvam cheti pra viryam ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, in your deeds of might ye deck heaven's lucid realms: Famed is that hero strength of yours.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्परि उप प्र यन्ति धीतयः ।
ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु ॥
verses.rom:
indragni apasaspari upa pra yanti dhitayah |
ritasya pathya anu ||
verses.en: To Indra and to Agni prayers go forward from the holy task. Along the path of sacred Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वां सधस्थानि प्रयांसि च ।
युवोरप्तूर्यं हितं ॥
verses.rom:
indragni tavishani vam sadhasthani prayamsi cha |
yuvorapturyam hitam ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, powers are yours, yours are oblations and abodes: Good is your zealous energy.

verses.sa:
क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे ।
अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्रयन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
ka im veda sute sacha pibantam kadvayo dadhe |
ayam yah puro vibhinattyojasa mandanah shiprayandhasah ||
verses.en: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

verses.sa:
दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे ।
न किष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महांश्चरस्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
dana mrigo na varanah purutra charatham dadhe |
na kishtva ni yamada sute gamo mahamshcharasyojasa ||
verses.en: As a wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way mad with heat, None may restrain thee, yet come hither to the draught! Thou, movest mighty in thy power.

verses.sa:
य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः ।
यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ugrah sannanishtritah sthiro ranaya samskritah |
yadi stoturmaghava shrinavaddhavam nendro yoshatya gamat ||
verses.en: When he, the terrible, ne'er o'erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight-- When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

verses.sa:
पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः ।
अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana asrikshata somah shukrasa indavah |
abhi vishvani kavya ||
verses.en: The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice, For holy lore of every kind.

verses.sa:
पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत ।
पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana divasparyantarikshadasrikshata |
prithivya adhi sanavi ||
verses.en: From heaven, from out the firmament hath PavamAna been effused Upon the back and ridge of earth.

verses.sa:
पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः ।
घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasa ashavah shubhra asrigramindavah |
ghnanto vishva apa dvishah ||
verses.en: The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautified swift Somadrops, Driving all enemies afar.

verses.sa:
तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता ।
इन्द्राग्नी वाजसातमा ॥
verses.rom:
tosha vritrahana huve sajitvanaparajita |
indragni vajasatama ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni I invoke, joint-victors, bounteous, unsubdued, Foe-slayers, best to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः ।
इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥
verses.rom:
pra vamarchantyukthino nithavido jaritarah |
indragni isha a vrine ||
verses.en: Indra and Agni, singers skilled in melody hymn you bringing lauds: I choose you both to bring me food.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतं ।
साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
indragni navatim puro dasapatniradhunutam |
sakamekena karmana ||
verses.en: Together, with one mighty deed, Indra and Agni, ye shook down. The ninety forts which Dasas held.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा रण्वसन्दृशं प्रयस्वन्तः सहस्कृत ।
अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva ranvasandrisham prayasvantah sahaskrita |
agne sasrijmahe girah ||
verses.en: O Child of Strength, to thee whose look is lovely, with oblations we, O Agni, have poured forth our songs.

verses.sa:
उप च्छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयं ।
अग्ने हिरण्यसन्दृशः ॥
verses.rom:
upa chchhayamiva ghrineraganma sharma te vayam |
agne hiranyasandrishah ||
verses.en: To thee for shelter are we come, as to the shade from fervent heat, Agni, who glitterest like gold

verses.sa:
य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृङ्गो न वंसगः ।
अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ ॥
verses.rom:
ya ugra iva sharyaha tigmashringo na vamsagah |
agne puro rurojitha ||
verses.en: Mighty as one who slays with shafts, or like a bull with sharpened horn, Agni, thou brakest down the forts.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिं ।
अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanam vaishvanaramritasya jyotishaspatim |
ajasram gharmamimahe ||
verses.en: To give eternal glow, we pray Vaisvanara the holy one, Lord of the light of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
य इदं प्रतिपप्रथे यज्ञस्य स्वरुत्तिरन् ।
ऋतूनुत्सृजते वशी ॥
verses.rom:
ya idam pratipaprathe yajnasya svaruttiran |
ritunutsrijate vashi ||
verses.en: Who, furthering the light of Law, hath spread himself to meet this work: He sends the seasons, mighty one.

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्रियेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य ।
सभ्राडेको वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
agnih priyeshu dhamasu kamo bhutasya bhavyasya |
sabhradeko vi rajati ||
verses.en: Love of what is and what shall be, Agni, in his beloved forms, Shines forth alone as sovran Lord.

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्रत्नेन जन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वा३ं स्वां ।
कविर्विप्रेण ववृधे ॥
verses.rom:
agnih pratnena janmana shumbhanastanva3m svam |
kavirviprena vavridhe ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्ज्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषं ।
अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
urjjo napatama huve'gnim pavakashochisham |
asminyajne svadhvare ||

verses.sa:
स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा ।
देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
sa no mitramahastvamagne shukrena shochisha |
devaira satsi barhishi ||

prose.en:
I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni whose glow is bright and pure, In this well-ordered sacrifice.

So, Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour seat thyself. With Gods upon our sacred grass!

verses.sa:
उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः ।
नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
utte shushmaso asthu raksho bhindanto adrivah |
nudasva yah parispridhah ||
verses.en: O thou with stones for arms, thy powers, rending the fiends, have raised themselves: Drive off the foes who compass us

verses.sa:
अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसङ्गे धने हिते ।
स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥
verses.rom:
aya nijaghnirojasa rathasange dhane hite |
stava abibhyusha hrida ||
verses.en: Hence conquering with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked, With fearless heart will I sing praise.

verses.sa:
अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या ।
रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥
verses.rom:
asya vratani nadhrishe pavamanasya dudhya |
ruja yastva pritanyati ||
verses.en: None, evil-minded, may assail this Pavamana's holy laws Crush him who fain would fight with thee!

verses.sa:
तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनं ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरं ॥
verses.rom:
tam hinvanti madachyutam harim nadishu vajinam |
indumindraya matsaram ||
verses.en: For Indra to the streams they urge the tawny rapture-dropping steed, Indu, the bringer of delight.

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः ।
मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव तां इहि ॥
verses.rom:
a mandrairindra haribhiryahi mayuraromabhih |
ma tva ke chinni yemurinna pashino'ti dhanveva tam ihi ||
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacocks' plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!

verses.sa:
वृत्रखादो वलं रुजः पुरां दर्मो अपामजः ।
स्थाता रथस्य हर्योरभिस्वर इन्द्रो दृढा चिदारुजः ॥
verses.rom:
vritrakhado valam rujah puram darmo apamajah |
sthata rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dridha chidarujah ||
verses.en: Vritra's devourer, he who burst the cloud, brake forts, and drave the floods, Indra, who mounts his chariot at his bay steeds' cry, shatters e'en things that stand most firm.

verses.sa:
गम्भीरां उदधींरिव क्रतुं पुष्यसि गा इव ।
प्र सुगोपा यवसं धेनवो यथा ह्रदं कुल्या इवाशत ॥
verses.rom:
gambhiram udadhimriva kratum pushyasi ga iva |
pra sugopa yavasam dhenavo yatha hradam kulya ivashata ||
verses.en: Like pools of water deep and full, like kine thou cherishest thy might; Like the milch-cows that go well-guarded to the mead, like water-brooks that reach the lake.

verses.sa:
यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणं ।
आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
yatha gauro apa kritam trishyannetyaverinam |
apitve nah prapitve tuyama gahi kanveshu su sacha piba ||
verses.en: Even as the wild bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!

verses.sa:
मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते ।
आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः ॥
verses.rom:
mandantu tva maghavannindrendavo radhodeyaya sunvate |
amushya somamapibashchamu sutam jyeshtham taddadhishe sahah ||
verses.en: May the drops gladden thee, Lord Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice! Soma, shed in the press, thou stolest and didst drink, and hence hast won surpassing might.

verses.sa:
त्वमङ्ग प्र शुंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यं ।
न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamanga pra shumsisho devah shavishtha martyam |
na tvadanyo maghavannasti marditendra bravimi te vachah ||
verses.en: Thou as a God. O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

verses.sa:
मा ते राधांसि मा त ऊतयो वसोऽस्मान्कदा चना दभन् ।
विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ ॥
verses.rom:
ma te radhamsi ma ta utayo vaso'smankada chana dabhan |
vishva cha na upamimihi manusha vasuni charshanibhya a ||
verses.en: Let not thy bounteous gifts, let not thy saving help all fail us good Lord, at any time! And measure out to us, thou lover of man-kind, all riches hitherward from men

verses.sa:
प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः ।
दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता ॥
verses.rom:
prati shya sunari jani vyuchchhanti pari svasuh |
divo adarshi duhita ||
verses.en: This Lady, excellent and kind, after her sister shining forth, Daughter of Heaven, hath shown herself.

verses.sa:
अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी ।
सखा भूदश्विनोरुषाः ॥
verses.rom:
ashveva chitrarushi mata gavamritavari |
sakha bhudashvinorushah ||
verses.en: Red, like a mare, and beautiful, holy, the mother of the kine, The Dawn became the Asvins' friend.

verses.sa:
उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि ।
उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे ॥
verses.rom:
uta sakhasyashvinoruta mata gavamasi |
utosho vasva ishishe ||
verses.en: Yea, and thou art the Asvins', friend the mother of the cows art thou: O Dawn, thou rules over wealth

verses.sa:
एषो उषा अपूर्व्य व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः ।
स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
esho usha apurvya vyuchchhati priya divah |
stushe vamashvina brihat ||
verses.en: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise

verses.sa:
या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणां ।
धिया देवा वसुविदा ॥
verses.rom:
ya dasra sindhumatara manotara rayinam |
dhiya deva vasuvida ||
verses.en: Children of Ocean, mighty ones, discoverers of riches, Gods, Finders of treasure through our prayer!

verses.sa:
वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि ।
यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥
verses.rom:
vachyante vam kakuhaso jurnayamadhi vishtapi |
yadvam ratho vibhishpatat ||
verses.en: Your lofty coursers hasten over the everlasting realm, whea your car flies with winged steeds.

verses.sa:
उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति ।
येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ushastachchitrama bharasmabhyam vajinivati |
yena tokam cha tanayam cha dhamahe ||
verses.en: O Dawn who hast a store of wealth, bring unto us that splendid gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons

verses.sa:
उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि ।
रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति ॥
verses.rom:
usho adyeha gomatyashvavati vibhavari |
revadasme vyuchchha sunritavati ||
verses.en: Thou radiant Lady of sweet strains, with wealth of horses and of kine Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn, auspiciously

verses.sa:
युङ्क्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वां अद्यारुणां उषः ।
अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह ॥
verses.rom:
yunkshva hi vajinivatyashvam adyarunam ushah |
atha no vishva saubhaganya vaha ||
verses.en: O Dawn who hast a store of wealth, yoke red steeds to thy car to-day. Then bring us all delight and all felicities

verses.sa:
अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ।
अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतं ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina vartirasmada gomaddasra hiranyavat |
arvagratham samanasa ni yachchhatam ||
verses.en: O Asvins, wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold!

verses.sa:
एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी ।
उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
eha deva mayobhuva dasra hiranyavarttani |
usharbudho vahantu somapitaye ||
verses.en: Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma, both the Gods, Health-givers, wonder-workers, borne on paths of gold!

verses.sa:
यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः ।
आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवं ॥
verses.rom:
yavittha shlokama divo jyotirjanaya chakrathuh |
a na urjam vahatamashvina yuvam ||
verses.en: Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to men, Do ye, O Asvins, bring strength hither unto us!

verses.sa:
अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः ।
अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
agnim tam manye yo vasurastam yam yanti dhenavah |
astamarvanta ashavostam nityaso vajina isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: I think of Agni who is kind, whom, as their home, the milch-kine seek; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring, steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
अग्निर्हि वाजिनं विशे ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः ।
अग्नी राये स्वाभुवं स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhi vajinam vishe dadati vishvacharshanih |
agni raye svabhuvam sa prito yati varyamisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: For Agni, God of all mankind, gives the strong courser to theman. Agni gives ready gear for wealth, he gives the best when he ix pleased. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः ।
समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सं सुजातासः सूरय इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
so agniryo vasurgrine sam yamayanti dhenavah |
samarvanto raghudruvah sam sujatasah suraya isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: The Agni who is praised as kind, to whom the milch-kine come. in herds, To whom the racers, swift of foot, to whom our wellborn princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

verses.sa:
महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती ।
यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
mahe no adya bodhayosho raye divitmati |
yatha chinno abodhayah satyashravasi vayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en: O heavenly Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence today, Even as thou didst waken us with Satyasravas, Vayya's, Son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः ।
सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
ya sunithe shauchadrathe vyauchchho duhitardivah |
sa vyuchchha sahiyasi satyashravasi vayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en: Daughter of heaven, thou dawnedst of Sunitha, Suchadratha's son; So dawn thou on one mightier still, on Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः ।
यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि याय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
sa no adyabharadvasurvyuchchha duhitardivah |
yo vyauchchhah sahiyasi satyashravasi yayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en: So bringing treasure, shine to-day on us, thou daughter, of the Sky, As on one mightier thou hast dawned, on Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
प्रति प्रियतमं रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनं ।
स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.rom:
prati priyatamam ratham vrishanam vasuvahanam |
stota vamashvinavrishi stomebhirbhushati prati madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en: To meet your treasure-bringing car, the car that is most dear to us, Asvins the Rishi is prepared, your worshipper with, songs of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call

verses.sa:
अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहं सना ।
दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी सुषुम्णा सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.rom:
atyayatamashvina tiro vishva aham sana |
dasra hiranyavarttani sushumna sindhuvahasa madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en: Pass, Asvins, over all away. May I obtain you for myself, Wonderful, with your golden paths, most gracious, bringers of the flood! Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!

verses.sa:
आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवं ।
रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवं ॥
verses.rom:
a no ratnani bibhratavashvina gachchhatam yuvam |
rudra hiranyavarttani jushana vajinivasu madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en: Come to us, O ye Asvins twain, bringing your precious treasures, come Ye Rudras, on your paths of gold, rejoicing, with your store of wealth! Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!

verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासं ।
यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
abodhyagnih samidha jananam prati dhenumivayatimushasam |
yahva iva pra vayamujjihanah pra bhanavah sasrate nakamachchha ||
verses.en: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames mounting to the vault of heaven.

verses.sa:
अबोधि होता यजथाय देवानूर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमनाः प्रातरस्थात् ।
समिद्धस्य रुशददर्शि पाजो महान्देवस्तमसो निरमोचि ॥
verses.rom:
abodhi hota yajathaya devanurdhvo agnih sumanah pratarasthat |
samiddhasya rushadadarshi pajo mahandevastamaso niramochi ||
verses.en: For the Gods' worship hath the priest been wakened: kind Agni hath arisen erect at morning. Kindled, his radiant might is made apparent, and the great God hath been set free from darkness.

verses.sa:
यदीं गणस्य रशनामजीगः शुचिरङ्क्ते शुचिभिर्गोभिरग्निः ।
आद्दक्षिणा युज्यते वाजयन्त्युत्तानामूर्ध्वो अधयज्जुहूभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadim ganasya rashanamajigah shuchirankte shuchibhirgobhiragnih |
addakshina yujyate vajayantyuttanamurdhvo adhayajjuhubhih ||
verses.en: When he hath roused the line of his attendants, with the bright milk bright Agni is anointed. Then is prepared the effectual oblation, which spread in front, with tongues, erect, he drinketh,

verses.sa:
इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा ।
यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायैवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक् ॥
verses.rom:
idam shreshtham jyotisham jyotiragachchitrah praketo ajanishta vibhva |
yatha prasuta savituh savayaiva ratryushase yonimaraik ||
verses.en: This light is come, amid all lights the fairest: born is the brilliant, far-extending brightness. Night, sent away for Savitar's uprising, hath yielded up a birthplace for the morning.

verses.sa:
रुशाद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः ।
समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने ॥
verses.rom:
rushadvatsa rushati shvetyagadaraigu krishna sadananyasyah |
samanabandhu amrite anuchi dyava varnam charata aminane ||
verses.en: The fair, the bright is come with her white offspring to her the Dark one hath resigned her dwelling. Akin, immortal, following each other, changing their colours both the heavens move onward.

verses.sa:
समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे ।
न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे ॥
verses.rom:
samano adhva svasroranantastamanyanya charato devashishte |
na methete na tasthatuh sumeke naktoshasa samanasa virupe ||
verses.en: Common, unending is the sisters' pathway: taught by the Gods alternately they travel, Fair-formed, of different hues and yet one-minded, Night and Dawn clash not, neither do they tarry.

verses.sa:
आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद्विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः ।
अर्वाञ्चा नूनं रथ्येह यातं पीपिवांसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
a bhatyagnirushasamanikamudvipranam devaya vacho asthuh |
arvancha nunam rathyeha yatam pipivamsamashvina gharmamachchha ||
verses.en: Agni, the bright face of the Dawns, is shining: the singers' pious voices have ascended. Borne on your chariot, Asvins, turn you hither, and come unto our brimming warm libation!

verses.sa:
न संस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठान्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह ।
दिवाभिपित्वेवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्त्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा ॥
verses.rom:
na samskritam pra mimito gamishthanti nunamashvinopastuteha |
divabhipitvevasagamishtha pratyavarttim dashushe shambhavishtha ||
verses.en: Most frequent guests, they scorn not what is ready: even now the lauded Asvins are beside us. With promptest aid they come at morn and evening, the worshipper's most healthful guards from trouble.

verses.sa:
उता यातं संगवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यन्दिन उदिता सूर्यस्य ।
दिवा नक्तमवसा शन्तमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान ॥
verses.rom:
uta yatam samgave pratarahno madhyandina udita suryasya |
diva naktamavasa shantamena nedanim pitirashvina tatana ||
verses.en: Yea, come at milking-time, at early morning, at noon of day, and when the Sun is setting, By day, at night, with most auspicious favour! Not only now the draught hath drawn the Asvins.

verses.sa:
एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते ।
निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
eta u tya ushasah ketumakrata purve ardhe rajaso bhanumanjate |
nishkrinvana ayudhaniva dhrishnavah prati gavo'rushiryanti matarah ||
verses.en: These Dawns have raised their banner: in the eastern half of middle air they spread abroad their shining light. Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the fray, the cows are coming on, the mothers, red of hue.

verses.sa:
उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत ।
अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः ॥
verses.rom:
udapaptannaruna bhanavo vritha svayujo arushirga ayukshata |
akrannushaso vayunani purvatha rushantam bhanumarushirashishrayuh ||
verses.en: Rapidly have the ruddy beams of light shot up: the red cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked. The Dawns have made their pathways as in former times: redhued, they have attained refulgent brilliancy.

verses.sa:
अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः ।
इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
archanti narirapaso na vishtibhih samanena yojanena paravatah |
isham vahantih sukrite sudanave vishvedaha yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en: They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away, Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice.

verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्यू३षाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा ।
आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद्देवः सविता जगत्पृथक् ॥
verses.rom:
abodhyagnirjma udeti suryo vyu3shashchandra mahyavo archisha |
ayukshatamashvina yatave ratham prasaviddevah savita jagatprithak ||
verses.en: Agni is wakened: Surya riseth from the earth. Bright Dawn hath opened out the mighty twain with light. The Asvins have equipped their chariot for the course. God Savitar hath roused the world in sundry ways.

verses.sa:
यद्युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतं ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadyunjathe vrishanamashvina ratham ghritena no madhuna kshatramukshatam |
asmakam brahma pritanasu jinvatam vayam dhana shurasata bhajemahi ||
verses.en: When, O ye Asvins, ye equip your mighty car, with fatness and with honey balm, ye twain, our power! To our devotion give victorious strength in war: may we win riches in the heroes' strife for spoil!

verses.sa:
अर्वाङ्त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः ।
त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
arvantrichakro madhuvahano ratho jirashvo ashvinoryatu sushtutah |
trivandhuro maghava vishvasaubhagah sham na a vakshaddvipade chatushpade ||
verses.en: Nigh to us come the Asvins' lauded three wheeled car, the car laden with meath and drawn by fleet-foot steeds, Three-seated, opulent, bestowing all delight: may it bring weal to us, to cattle and to men!

verses.sa:
प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः ।
अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणं ॥
verses.rom:
pra te dhara asashchato divo na yanti vrishtayah |
achchha vajam sahasrinam ||
verses.en: Thy streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven, To bring a thousand stores of wealth.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति ।
हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priyani kavya vishva chakshano arshati |
haristunjana ayudha ||
verses.en: He, flows beholding on his way all well-beloved sacred lore, Green-tinted, brandishing his arms.

verses.sa:
स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः ।
श्येनो न वंसु षीदति ॥
verses.rom:
sa marmrijana ayubhiribho rajeva suvratah |
shyeno na vamsu shidati ||
verses.en: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants, Sits as a falcon in the wood.

verses.sa:
स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि ।
पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vishva divo vasuto prithivya adhi |
punana indava bhara ||
verses.en: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified. All treasures both of heaven and earth!

verses.sa:
प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा ।
देवां अनु प्रभूषतः ॥
verses.rom:
prasya dhara aksharanvrishnah sutasyaujasa |
devam anu prabhushatah ||
verses.en: Forward have flowed the streams of power, of this the mighty one effused, Of him who waits upon the Gods.

verses.sa:
सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा ।
ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.rom:
saptim mrijanti vedhaso grinantah karavo gira |
jyotirjajnanamukthyam ||
verses.en: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the steed Born as thelight that merits laud.

verses.sa:
सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो ।
वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यं ॥
verses.rom:
sushaha soma tani te punanaya prabhuvaso |
vardha samudramukthyam ||
verses.en: These things thou winnest quickly, while men cleanse thee, Soma, nobly rich!

verses.sa: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे ॥
verses.rom: esha brahma ya ritviya indro nama shruto grine ||
verses.en: This Brahman, comer at the due time, named Indra, is renowned and praised.

verses.sa: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते यन्ति गिरो न संयतः ॥
verses.rom: tvamichchhavasaspate yanti giro na samyatah ||
verses.en: To thee alone, O Lord of Strength, go, as it were, all songs of praise.

verses.sa: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथा इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः ॥
verses.rom: vi srutayo yatha patha indra tvadyantu ratayah ||
verses.en: Like streams of water on their way, let bounties, Indra, flow from thee!

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्त्तयामसि ।
तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्रं शविष्ठ सत्पतिं ॥
verses.rom:
a tva ratham yathotaye sumnaya varttayamasi |
tuvikurmimritishahamindram shavishtha satpatim ||
verses.en: Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee nigh to favour us, Strong in thy deeds, quelling attack, Indra, Lord, mightiest! of the brave.

verses.sa:
तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते ।
आ पप्राथ महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
tuvishushma tuvikrato shachivo vishvaya mate |
a papratha mahitvana ||
verses.en: Great in thou power and wisdom, strong, with thought that comprehendeth all! Wide hast thou spread in majesty.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायन्तमीयतुः ।
हस्ता वज्रं हिरण्ययं ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te mahina mahah pari jmayantamiyatuh |
hasta vajram hiranyayam ||
verses.en: Thou very mighty one, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness wield The golden bolt that beaks its way!

verses.sa:
आ यः पुरं नार्मिणीमदीदेदत्यः कविर्नभन्यो३ नार्व ।
सूरो न रुरुक्वाञ्छतात्मा ॥
verses.rom:
a yah puram narminimadidedatyah kavirnabhanyo3 narva |
suro na rurukvanchhatatma ||
verses.en: He who hath lighted up the joyous castle, wise courser like the steed of cloudy heaven, Bright like the Sun with hundredfold existence

verses.sa:
अभि द्विजन्मा त्री रोचनानि विश्वा रजांसि शुशुचनो अस्थात् ।
होता यजिष्ठो अपां सधस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dvijanma tri rochanani vishva rajamsi shushuchano asthat |
hota yajishtho apam sadhasthe ||
verses.en: He, doubly born, hath spread in his effulgence through the three luminous realms, through all the regions, Best sacrificing Priest where waters gather.

verses.sa:
अयं स होता यो द्विजन्मा विश्वा दधे वार्याणि श्रवस्या ।
मर्तो यो अस्मै सुतुको ददाश ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa hota yo dvijanma vishva dadhe varyani shravasya |
marto yo asmai sutuko dadasha ||
verses.en: Priest doubly born, he through his love of glory hath in his keeping all things worth the choosing. The man who brings him gifts hath noble offspring.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तमद्याष्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृषं ।
ऋध्यामा त ओहैः ॥
verses.rom:
agne tamadyashvam na stomaih kratum na bhadram hridisprisham |
ridhyama ta ohaih ||
verses.en: Agni, with hymns may we now accomplish that which thou lovest, Strength, like a horse auspicious, with service!

verses.sa:
अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः ।
रथीरृतस्य बृहतो बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
adha hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakshasya sadhoh |
rathirritasya brihato babhutha ||
verses.en: For, Agni, thou art now the promoter of strength auspicious, Lofty sacrifice, power effective.

verses.sa:
एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ्क्स्वा३र्ण ज्योतिः ।
अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः ॥
verses.rom:
ebhirno arkairbhava no arvanksva3rna jyotih |
agne vishvebhih sumana anikaih ||
verses.en: Through these our praises, come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, Agni, kindly with all thy faces!

verses.sa:
अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रं राधो अमर्त्य ।
आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवां उषर्बुधः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vivasvadushasashchitram radho amartya |
a dashushe jatavedo vaha tvamadya devam usharbudhah ||
verses.en: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn. Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!

verses.sa:
जुष्टो हि दूतो असि हव्यवाहनोऽग्ने रथीरध्वराणां ।
सजूरश्विभ्यामुषसा सुवीर्यमस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
jushto hi duto asi havyavahano'gne rathiradhvaranam |
sajurashvibhyamushasa suviryamasme dhehi shravo brihat ||
verses.en: For thou art offering-bearer, well-loved messenger, and charioteer of holy rites. Accordant with the Asvins and with Dawn grant us heroic strength and lofty fame!

verses.sa:
विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनां युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान ॥
verses.rom:
vidhum dadranam samane bahunam yuvanam santam palito jagara |
devasya pashya kavyam mahitvadya mamara sa hyah samana ||
verses.en: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him Behold the God's high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.

verses.sa:
शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीडः ।
यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता ॥
verses.rom:
shakmana shako arunah suparna a yo mahah shurah sanadanidah |
yachchiketa satyamittanna mogham vasu sparhamuta jetota data ||
verses.en: Strong is the red Bird in his strength, great hero, who from of old bath had no nest to dwell in. That which he knows is truth and never idle: he wins and gives the wealth desired of many.

verses.sa:
ऐभिर्ददे वृष्ण्या प्ॐस्यानि येभिरौक्षद्वृत्रहत्याय वज्री ।
ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋतेकर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
aibhirdade vrishnya pomsyani yebhiraukshadvritrahatyaya vajri |
ye karmanah kriyamanasya mahna ritekarmamudajayanta devah ||
verses.en: Through these Thunderer gained strong manly vigour, through whom he waxed in stren gth to slaughter Vritra; These who through might of actual operation sprang forth as Gods in course of Law and Order.

verses.sa:
अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः ।
उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
asti somo ayam sutah pibantyasya marutah |
uta svarajo ashvina ||
verses.en: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this Self-luminous, the Asvins, drink.

verses.sa:
पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः ।
त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥
verses.rom:
pibanti mitro aryama tana putasya varunah |
trishadhasthasya javatah ||
verses.en: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant, Drink Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

verses.sa:
उतो न्वस्य जोषमा इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः ।
प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥
verses.rom:
uto nvasya joshama indrah sutasya gomatah |
pratarhoteva matsati ||
verses.en: Yea, Indra, like the Hotar-priest, will in the early morning drink, At pleasure, of the milky juice:

verses.sa:
बण्महां असि सूर्य बडादित्य महां असि ।
महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्तम मह्ना देव महां असि ॥
verses.rom:
banmaham asi surya badaditya maham asi |
mahaste sato mahima panishtama mahna deva maham asi ||
verses.en: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatn.ess thou art great.

verses.sa:
बट्सूर्य श्रवसा महां असि सत्रा देव महां असि ।
मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यं ॥
verses.rom:
batsurya shravasa maham asi satra deva maham asi |
mahna devanamasuryah purohito vibhu jyotiradabhyam ||
verses.en: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High-Priest, divine, farspread unconquerable light.

verses.sa:
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.rom:
upa no haribhih sutam yahi madanam pate |
upa no haribhih sutam ||
verses.en: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libations with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!

verses.sa:
द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.rom:
dvita yo vritrahantamo vida indrah shatakratuh |
upa no haribhih sutam ||
verses.en: Known as best Vritra-slayer erst, as Indra $atakratu, come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!

verses.sa:
त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi vritrahannesham pata somanamasi |
upa no haribhih sutam ||
verses.en: For, Vritra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे महेवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वं ।
विशः पूर्वीः प्र चर चर्षणिप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe mahevridhe bharadhvam prachetase pra sumatim krinudhvam |
vishah purvih pra chara charshaniprah ||
verses.en: Bring to the wise, the great, who waxeth mighty your offerings and make ready your devotion. Go forth to many tribes as man's controller!

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचसे महिने सुवृक्तिमिन्द्राय ब्रह्म जनयन्त विप्राः ।
तस्य व्रतानि न मिनन्ति धीराः ॥
verses.rom:
uruvyachase mahine suvriktimindraya brahma janayanta viprah |
tasya vratani na minanti dhirah ||
verses.en: For Indra the sublime, the far-pervading, have singers generateo prayer and praises; The sages never violate his statutes.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वाणीरनुत्तमन्युमेव सत्रा राजानं दधिरे सहध्यै ।
हर्यश्वाय बर्हया समापीन् ॥
verses.rom:
indram vaniranuttamanyumeva satra rajanam dadhire sahadhyai |
haryashvaya barhaya samapin ||
verses.en: The choirs have established Indra King for ever for victory him, whose anger is resistless: And for the bays' Lord strengthened those he loveth.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय ।
स्तोतारमिद्दधिषे रदावसो न पापत्वाय रंसिषं ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra yavatastvametavadahamishiya |
stotaramiddadhishe radavaso na papatvaya ramsisham ||
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I would support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and, not abandon him to woe.

verses.sa:
शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे ।
न हि त्वदन्यन्मघवन्न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता च न ॥
verses.rom:
shiksheyaminmahayate divedive raya a kuhachidvide |
na hi tvadanyanmaghavanna apyam vasyo asti pita cha na ||
verses.en: Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were. No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even, is no more.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवं विपिपानस्याद्रेर्बोधा विप्रस्यार्चतो मनीषां ।
कृष्वा दुवांस्यन्तमा सचेमा ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi havam vipipanasyadrerbodha viprasyarchato manisham |
krishva duvamsyantama sachema ||
verses.en: Here thou the call of the juice-drinking press-stone: mark thou the sage's hymn who sings and lauds thee! Take to thine inmost self these adorations!

verses.sa:
न ते गिरो अपि मृष्ये तुरस्य न सुष्टुतिमसुर्यस्य विद्वान् ।
सदा ते नाम स्वयशो विवक्मि ॥
verses.rom:
na te giro api mrishye turasya na sushtutimasuryasya vidvan |
sada te nama svayasho vivakmi ||
verses.en: I know and ne'er forget the hymns and praises of thee, theconqueror, of thy power immortal. Thy name I ever utter, self-refulgent!

verses.sa:
भूरि हि ते सवना मानुषेषु भूरि मनीषी हवते त्वामित् ।
मारे अस्मन्मघवञ्ज्योक्कः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuri hi te savana manusheshu bhuri manishi havate tvamit |
mare asmanmaghavanjyokkah ||
verses.en: Among mankind many are thy libations, and many a time the pious sage invokes thee. O Maghavan, be not long distant from us!

verses.sa:
प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत ।
अभीके चिदु लोककृत्सङ्गे समत्सु वृत्रह ।
अस्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
pro shvasmai purorathamindraya shushamarchata |
abhike chidu lokakritsange samatsu vritraha |
asmakam bodhi chodita nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en: Sing strength to Indra that shall. set his chariot in the foremost place! Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encorager! Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak mies!

verses.sa:
त्वं सिन्धूंरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिं ।
अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यं ।
तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
tvam sindhumravasrijo'dharacho ahannahim |
ashatrurindra jajnishe vishvam pushyasi varyam |
tam tva pari shvajamahe nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en: Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to Earth. Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak enemies! Destroyed be all malignitics and all our enemy's designs!

verses.sa:
वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः ।
अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघांसति ।
या ते रातिर्ददिवसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
vi shu vishva aratayo'ryo nashanta no dhiyah |
astasi shatrave vadham yo na indra jighamsati |
ya te ratirdadivasu nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en: Thy bolt thou castest at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak enemies!

verses.sa:
रेवां इद्रेवत स्तोता स्यात्त्वावतो मघोनः ।
प्रेदु हरिवः सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
revam idrevata stota syattvavato maghonah |
predu harivah sutasya ||
verses.en: Rich be the praiser of one rich and liberal, Lord of days! like thee: High rank be his who lauds the juice!

verses.sa:
उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत ।
न गायत्रं गीयमानं ॥
verses.rom:
uktham cha na shasyamanam nago rayira chiketa |
na gayatram giyamanam ||
verses.en: His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.

verses.sa:
मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः ।
शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ma na indra piyatnave ma shardhate para dah |
shiksha shachivah shachibhih ||
verses.en: Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud: Help, mighty one, with power and might!

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिं ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahi haribhirupa kanvasya sushtutim |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, with thy bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
atra vi nemireshamuram na dhunute vrikah |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day I have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा ग्रावा वदनीह सोमी घोषेण वक्षतु ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a tva grava vadaniha somi ghoshena vakshatu |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: May the stone bring thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mandayannindraya madhumattamah ||
verses.en: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight!

verses.sa: ते सुतासो विपश्चितः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत ॥
verses.rom: te sutaso vipashchitah shukra vayumasrikshata ||
verses.en: Bright, meditating sacred song, these juices have sent Vayu forth.

verses.sa: असृग्रं देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
verses.rom: asrigram devavitaye vajayanto ratha iva ||
verses.en: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots speeding in the race.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसोः सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् ।
य ऊर्ध्वरो स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा ।
घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु शुक्रशोचिष आजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hotaram manye dasvantam vasoh sunum sahaso jatavedasam vipram na jatavedasam |
ya urdhvaro svadhvaro devo devachya kripa |
ghritasya vibhrashtimanu shukrashochisha ajuhvanasya sarpishah ||
verses.en: Agni I deem our Hotar priest, munificent wealth-giver, Son of Strength, who knoweth all that is even as the Sage who knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, he when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longs for it as it grows bright.

verses.sa:
यजिष्ठं त्वा यजमाना हुवेम ज्येष्ठमङ्गिरसां विप्र मन्मभिर्विप्रेभिः शुक्रमन्मभिः ।
परिज्मानमिव द्यां होतारं चर्षणीनां ।
शोचिष्केशं वृषणं यमिमा विशः प्रावन्तु जूतये विशः ॥
verses.rom:
yajishtham tva yajamana huvema jyeshthamangirasam vipra manmabhirviprebhih shukramanmabhih |
parijmanamiva dyam hotaram charshaninam |
shochishkesham vrishanam yamima vishah pravantu jutaye vishah ||
verses.en: We, sacrificing, call on the best worshipper thee eldest of Angirasas, singer! with hyrnns, thee, brilliant one! with singers' hymn; Thee, wandering round, as 'twere the sky, thee who art Hotar-priest of men, whom, Bull with hair of flame, the people must observe, tile people that he speed them on.

verses.sa:
स हि पुरू चिदोजसा विरुक्मता दीद्यानो भवति द्रुहन्तरः परशुर्न द्रुहन्तरः ।
वीडु चिद्यस्य समृतौ श्रुवद्वनेव यत्स्थिरं ।
निष्षहमाणो यमते नायते धन्वासहा नायते ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi puru chidojasa virukmata didyano bhavati druhantarah parashurna druhantarah |
vidu chidyasya samritau shruvadvaneva yatsthiram |
nishshahamano yamate nayate dhanvasaha nayate ||
verses.en: He with his blazing Power refulgent far and wide, he verily it iswho conquers demon foes, conquers the demons like an axe: At whose close touch things solid partg and what is stable yields he keeps his ground and flinches not,like trees. Subduing all from the skilled archer flinches not.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो ।
बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्य३ं दधासि दाशुषे कवे ॥
verses.rom:
agne tava shravo vayo mahi bhrajante archayo vibhavaso |
brihadbhano shavasa vajamukthya3m dadhasi dashushe kave ||
verses.en: O Agni, strength and fame are thine: thy fires blaze forth on high, O thou refulgent God! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper with power, the wealth that merits laud.

verses.sa:
पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना ।
पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.rom:
pavakavarchah shukravarcha anunavarcha udiyarshi bhanuna |
putro matara vicharannupavasi prinakshi rodasi ubhe ||
verses.en: With brilliantg purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy mothers, aidest them as son; thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः ।
त्वे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napajjatavedah sushastibhirmandasva dhitibhirhitah |
tve ishah sam dadhurbhurivarpasashchitrotayo vamajatah ||
verses.en: O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs! In thee have they heaped viands various, many formed; wealthborn, of wondrous help are they.

verses.sa:
इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य ।
स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि दर्शतं क्रतुं ॥
verses.rom:
irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rayo amartya |
sa darshatasya vapusho vi rajasi prinakshi darshatam kratum ||
verses.en: Agni, spread forth, as ruler, over living things: give wealth, to us, immortal God! Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to beauteous Power.

verses.sa:
इष्कर्त्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तं राधसो महः ।
रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिं रयिं ॥
verses.rom:
ishkarttaramadhvarasya prachetasam kshayantam radhaso mahah |
ratim vamasya subhagam mahimisham dadhasi sanasim rayim ||
verses.en: I laud the Sage, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control. Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, thou givest wealth that wins success.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः ।
श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanam mahisham vishvadarshatamagnim sumnaya dadhire puro janah |
shrutkarnam saprathastamam tva gira daivyam manusha yuga ||
verses.en: The men have set before them, for his favour, Agni, strong, visible to all, the holy. Thee, Lord divine, with ears to hear, most famous, mens' generations magnify with praise-songs.

verses.sa:
प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुविराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः ।
यस्य त्वं सख्यमाविथ ॥
verses.rom:
pra so agne tavotibhih suvirabhistarati vajakarmabhih |
yasya tvam sakhyamavitha ||
verses.en: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

verses.sa:
तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे ।
त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
tava drapso nilavanvasha ritviya indhanah sishnava dade |
tvam mahinamushasamasi priyah kshapo vastushu rajasi ||
verses.en: Thy spark is black and crackling; kindled in due time, O bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.

verses.sa:
तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः ।
तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा ॥
verses.rom:
tamoshadhirdadhire garbhamritviyam tamapo agnim janayanta matarah |
tamitsamanam vaninashcha virudho'ntarvatishcha suvate cha vishvaha ||
verses.en: Him, duly coming, as their germ have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life. So, in like manner, do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिन्द्राय पवते दिवि शुक्रो वि राजति ।
महिषीव वि जायते ॥
verses.rom:
agnirindraya pavate divi shukro vi rajati |
mahishiva vi jayate ||
verses.en: Agni grows bright for Indra: he shines far resplendent in the sky: He sends forth offspring like a queen.

verses.sa:
यो जागार तमृचः कामयन्ते यो जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति ।
यो जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥
verses.rom:
yo jagara tamrichah kamayante yo jagara tamu samani yanti |
yo jagara tamayam soma aha tavahamasmi sakhye nyokah ||
verses.en: The sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches the holy verses. This Soma saith to him Who wake my dwelling in thy friendship.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जागार तमृचः कामयन्तेग्निर्जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति ।
अग्निर्जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjagara tamrichah kamayantegnirjagara tamu samani yanti |
agnirjagara tamayam soma aha tavahamasmi sakhye nyokah ||
verses.en: Agni is watchful, and the Richas love him: Agni is watchful, Sama hymns approach him. Agni is watchful, to him saith this Soma, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.

verses.sa:
नमः सखिभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यो नमः साकन्निषेभ्यः ।
युञ्जे वाचं शतपदीं ॥
verses.rom:
namah sakhibhyah purvasadbhyo namah sakannishebhyah |
yunje vacham shatapadim ||
verses.en: Praise to the friends who sit in front! to those seated together,praise I use the hundred-footed speech speech.

verses.sa:
युञ्जे वाचं शतपदीं गाये सहस्रवर्त्तनि ।
गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
yunje vacham shatapadim gaye sahasravarttani |
gayatram traishtubham jagat ||
verses.en: I use the hundred-footed speech, I sing what hath a thousand paths, Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn.

verses.sa:
गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगद्विश्वा रूपाणि सम्भृता ।
देवा ओकांसि चक्रिरे ॥
verses.rom:
gayatram traishtubham jagadvishva rupani sambhrita |
deva okamsi chakrire ||
verses.en: Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn,the forms united and complete, Have the Gods made familiar friends.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरग्निरिन्द्रो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरिन्द्रः ।
सूर्यो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjyotirjyotiragnirindro jyotirjyotirindrah |
suryo jyotirjyotih suryah ||
verses.en: Agni, is light, light is Agni, Indra is light, light is Indra Surya is light, light is Surya.

verses.sa:
पुनरूर्जा नि वर्त्तस्व पुनरग्न इषायुषा ।
पुनर्नः पाह्यंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
punarurja ni varttasva punaragna ishayusha |
punarnah pahyamhasah ||
verses.en: O Agni, turn again with strength, turn thou again with food and life: Save us again from grief and woe!

verses.sa:
सह रय्या नि वर्तस्वाग्ने पिन्वस्व धारया ।
विश्वप्स्न्या विश्वतस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
saha rayya ni vartasvagne pinvasva dharaya |
vishvapsnya vishvataspari ||
verses.en: O Agni, turn again with wealth sprinkle thou us from everyside. With thine own all-supporting stream!

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् ।
स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadindraham yatha tvamishiya vasva eka it |
stota me gosakha syat ||
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were like thee, the single ruler over wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine.

verses.sa:
शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे ।
यदहं गोपतिः स्यां ॥
verses.rom:
shiksheyamasmai ditseyam shachipate manishine |
yadaham gopatih syam ||
verses.en: I should be fain, O Lord of power, to strengthen and enrich thesage, Where I the ford of herds of kine.

verses.sa:
धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते ।
गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
dhenushta indra sunrita yajamanaya sunvate |
gamashvam pipyushi duhe ||
verses.en: Thy goodness, Indra, is a cow yielding in plenty kine and steeds. To worshippers who press the juice.

verses.sa:
आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन ।
महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
apo hi shtha mayobhuvasta na urje dadhatana |
mahe ranaya chakshase ||
verses.en: Yea, Waters, ye bring health and bliss: so help ye us to energy. That we may look on great delight!

verses.sa:
यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः ।
उशतीरिव मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vah shivatamo rasastasya bhajayateha nah |
ushatiriva matarah ||
verses.en: Give us a portion of the dew, the most auspicious that ye have, Like mothers in their longing love!

verses.sa:
तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ ।
आपो जनयथा च नः ॥
verses.rom:
tasma aram gamama vo yasya kshayaya jinvatha |
apo janayatha cha nah ||
verses.en: For you we gladly go to hirn to whose abode ye speed us on, And, Waters, give us procreant strength!

verses.sa:
वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे ।
प्र न आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
vata a vatu bheshajam shambhu mayobhu no hride |
pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life!

verses.sa:
उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा ।
स नो जीवातवे कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
uta vata pitasi na uta bhratota nah sakha |
sa no jivatave kridhi ||
verses.en: Thou art our father, Vata, yea, thou art our brother and our friend: So give us strength that we may live!

verses.sa:
यददो वात ते गृहे३ऽमृतं निहितं गुहा ।
तस्य नो धेहि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yadado vata te grihe3'mritam nihitam guha |
tasya no dhehi jivase ||
verses.en: The store of Amrit that laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home-- Give us strength that we may live!

verses.sa:
अभि वाजी विश्वरूपो जनित्रं हिरण्ययं बिभ्रदत्कं सुपर्णः ।
सूर्यस्य भानुमृतुथा वसानः परि स्वयं मेधमृज्रो जजान ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vaji vishvarupo janitram hiranyayam bibhradatkam suparnah |
suryasya bhanumritutha vasanah pari svayam medhamrijro jajana ||
verses.en: The fleet steed wearing divers forms, the eagle bearing his golden raiment to his birthplace, Clothed in due season with the light of Surya, red, hath begot the sacrifice in person.

verses.sa:
अप्सु रेतः शिश्रिये विश्वरूपं तेजः पृथिव्यामधि यत्सम्बभूव ।
अन्तरिक्षे स्वं महिमानं मिमानः कनिक्रन्ति वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः ॥
verses.rom:
apsu retah shishriye vishvarupam tejah prithivyamadhi yatsambabhuva |
antarikshe svam mahimanam mimanah kanikranti vrishno ashvasya retah ||
verses.en: Multiform seed he laid in waters, lustre which gathered on the earth and there developed. In the mid-air establishing his greatness, he cries aloud, seed of the vigorous courser.

verses.sa:
अयं सहस्रा परि युक्ता वसानः सूर्यस्य भानुं यज्ञो दाधार ।
सहस्रदाः शतदा भूरिदावा धर्त्ता दिवो भुवनस्य विश्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sahasra pari yukta vasanah suryasya bhanum yajno dadhara |
sahasradah shatada bhuridava dhartta divo bhuvanasya vishpatih ||
verses.en: He hath, enduing thousand robes that suit him, as sacrifice upheld the light of Surya, Giver of ample gifts in hundreds, thousands, supporter of the heavens, earth's Lord and ruler.

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युं ॥
verses.rom:
nake suparnamupa yatpatantam hrida venanto abhyachakshata tva |
hiranyapaksham varunasya dutam yamasya yonau shakunam bhuranyum ||
verses.en: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यञ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि ।
वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्व३र्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo gandharvo adhi nake asthatpratyanchitra bibhradasyayudhani |
vasano atkam surabhim drishe kam sva3rna nama janata priyani ||
verses.en: Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons: Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us..

verses.sa:
द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् ।
भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि ॥
verses.rom:
drapsah samudramabhi yajjigati pashyangridhrasya chakshasa vidharman |
bhanuh shukrena shochisha chakanastritiye chakre rajasi priyani ||
verses.en: When as a spark he cometh ilear the ocean, looking with vulture's eye as Law commandeth, His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the loftiest region.

verses.sa:
आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनां ।
सङ्क्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ashuh shishano vrishabho na bhimo ghanaghanah kshobhanashcharshaninam |
sankrandano'nimisha ekavirah shatam sena ajayatsakamindrah ||
verses.en: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people. With eyes that close not, bellowing, sole hero, Indra subdued at once a hundred armies.

verses.sa:
सङ्क्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना ।
तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा ॥
verses.rom:
sankrandanenanimishena jishnuna yutkarena dushchyavanena dhrishnuna |
tadindrena jayata tatsahadhvam yudho nara ishuhastena vrishna ||
verses.en: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful victcr, bold, hard to overthrow, rouser of battle, Indra. the strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes, now, now vanquish in the combat!

verses.sa:
स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन ।
सं सृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्यू३ग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता ॥
verses.rom:
sa ishuhastaih sa nishangibhirvashi samsrashta sa yudha indro ganena |
sam srishtajitsomapa bahushardhyu3gradhanva pratihitabhirasta ||
verses.en: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering strong of arm the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well- laid arrows.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्रां अपबाधमानः ।
प्रभञ्जन्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानां ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate pari diya rathena rakshohamitram apabadhamanah |
prabhanjansenah pramrino yudha jayannasmakamedhyavita rathanam ||
verses.en: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen! Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies!

verses.sa:
बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान्वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित् ॥
verses.rom:
balavijnayah sthavirah pravirah sahasvanvaji sahamana ugrah |
abhiviro abhisatva sahoja jaitramindra rathama tishtha govit ||
verses.en: Conspicuous. by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kinewinner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra!

verses.sa:
गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा ।
इमं सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वं ॥
verses.rom:
gotrabhidam govidam vajrabahum jayantamajma pramrinantamojasa |
imam sajata anu virayadhvamindram sakhayo anu sam rabhadhvam ||
verses.en: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it-- Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage!

verses.sa:
अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः ।
दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाडयुध्यो३ऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gotrani sahasa gahamano'dayo virah shatamanyurindrah |
dushchyavanah pritanashadayudhyo3'smakam sena avatu pra yutsu ||
verses.en: Piercing with conquering strength the cow-stalls, Indra, pitiless hero with unbounded anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless--may he protect our armies in our battles!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः ।
देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रं ॥
verses.rom:
indra asam neta brihaspatirdakshina yajnah pura etu somah |
devasenanamabhibhanjatinam jayantinam maruto yantvagram ||
verses.en: Indra guide these! Brihaspati, and Soma, the guerdon and the sacrifice precede them; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रं ।
महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya vrishno varunasya rajna adityanam marutam shardha ugram |
mahamanasam bhuvanachyavanam ghosho devanam jayatamudasthat ||
verses.en: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna the Maruts, and Adityas! Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, hightninded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.

verses.sa:
उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनांसि ।
उद्वृत्रहन्वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
uddharshaya maghavannayudhanyutsatvanam mamakanam manamsi |
udvritrahanvajinam vajinanyudrathanam jayatam yantu ghoshah ||
verses.en: Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits, of my warring heroes! Urge on the strong steed's might, O Vyitra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु ।
अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्मां उ देवा अवता हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamindrah samriteshu dhvajeshvasmakam ya ishavasta jayantu |
asmakam vira uttare bhavantvasmam u deva avata haveshu ||
verses.en: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be ther arrows of our army! May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset!

verses.sa:
असौ या सेना मरुतः परेषामभ्येति न ओजसा स्पर्धमाना ।
तां गूहत तमसापव्रतेन यथैतेषामन्यो अन्यं न जानात् ॥
verses.rom:
asau ya sena marutah pareshamabhyeti na ojasa spardhamana |
tam guhata tamasapavratena yathaiteshamanyo anyam na janat ||
verses.en: That army of the foemen, O ye Maruts, which, striving in its. mighty strength, approaches, Hide ye and bury it in pathless darkness that not a man oF them may know the other!

verses.sa:
अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि ।
अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्तां ॥
verses.rom:
amisham chittam pratilobhayanti grihananganyapve parehi |
abhi prehi nirdaha hritsu shokairandhenamitrastamasa sachantam ||
verses.en: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies, and depart, O Agha! Attack them, set their hearts on fare with sorrows; so let our foes abide in utter darkness!

verses.sa:
प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु ।
उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ ॥
verses.rom:
preta jayata nara indro vah sharma yachchhatu |
ugra vah santu bahavo'nadhrishya yathasatha ||
verses.en: Advance, O heroes, win the day, May Indra be your sure defence! Mighty and awful be your arms, that none may wound or injure you!

verses.sa:
अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसंशिते ।
गच्छामित्रान्प्र पद्यस्व मामीषां कं च नोच्छिषः ॥
verses.rom:
avasrishta para pata sharavye brahmasamshite |
gachchhamitranpra padyasva mamisham kam cha nochchhishah ||
verses.en: Loosed from the bowstring fly away, thou arrows sharpened by our prayer! Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one be left alive!

verses.sa:
कङ्काः सुपर्णा अनु यन्त्वेनान्गृध्राणामन्नमसावस्तु सेना ।
मैषां मोच्यघहारश्च नेन्द्र वयांस्येनाननुसंयन्तु सर्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
kankah suparna anu yantvenangridhranamannamasavastu sena |
maisham mochyaghaharashcha nendra vayamsyenananusamyantu sarvan ||
verses.en: Let ravens and strong-pinioned birds pursue them: yea, let that army be the food of vultures! Indra, let none escape, no sin-remover: behind them all let following birds be gathered!

verses.sa:
अमित्रसेनां मघवन्नस्माञ्छत्रुयतीमभि ।
उभौ तामिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नग्निश्च दहतं प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
amitrasenam maghavannasmanchhatruyatimabhi |
ubhau tamindra vritrahannagnishcha dahatam prati ||
verses.en: This host of foemen Maghavan! that cometh on in warlike show-- Meet it, O Vritra-slayer, thou, Indra, and Agni, with your flames!

verses.sa:
यत्र बाणाः सम्पतन्ति कुमारा विशिखा इव ।
तत्रा नो ब्रह्मणस्पतिरदितिः शर्म यच्छतु विश्वाहा शर्म यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatra banah sampatanti kumara vishikha iva |
tatra no brahmanaspatiraditih sharma yachchhatu vishvaha sharma yachchhatu ||
verses.en: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn. Even there may Brahmanaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days!

verses.sa:
वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज ।
वि मन्युमिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदासतः ॥
verses.rom:
vi raksho vi mridho jahi vi vritrasya hanu ruja |
vi manyumindra vritrahannamitrasyabhidasatah ||
verses.en: Drive Rakshasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vritra's jaws: O Vritra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us!

verses.sa:
वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः ।
यो अस्मां अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः ॥
verses.rom:
vi na indra mridho jahi nicha yachchha pritanyatah |
yo asmam abhidasatyadharam gamaya tamah ||
verses.en: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य बाहू स्थविरौ युवानावनाधृष्यौ सुप्रतीकावसह्यौ ।
तौ युञ्जीत प्रथमौ योग आगते याभ्यां जितमसुराणां सहो महत् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya bahu sthavirau yuvanavanadhrishyau supratikavasahyau |
tau yunjita prathamau yoga agate yabhyam jitamasuranam saho mahat ||
verses.en: Strong, ever-youthful are the arms of Indra, fair unassailable, never to be vanquished: These first let him employ when need hath come on us, wherewith the Asuras' great might was overthrown.

verses.sa:
मर्माणि ते वर्मणा च्छादयामि सोमस्त्वा राजामृतेनानु वस्तां ।
उरोर्वरीयो वरुणस्ते कृणोतु जयन्तं त्वानु देवा मदन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
marmani te varmana chchhadayami somastva rajamritenanu vastam |
urorvariyo varunaste krinotu jayantam tvanu deva madantu ||
verses.en: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee! Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy victory may Gods be joyful!

verses.sa:
अन्धा अमित्रा भवताशीर्षाणोऽहय इव ।
तेषां वो अग्निनुन्नानामिन्द्रो हन्तु वरंवरं ॥
verses.rom:
andha amitra bhavatashirshano'haya iva |
tesham vo agninunnanamindro hantu varamvaram ||
verses.en: Blind, O my foemen, shall ye be, even as headless serpents are May Indra slay each best of you when Agni's flame hath struck you down!

verses.sa:
यो नः स्वोऽरणो यश्च निष्ट्यो जिघांसति ।
देवास्तं सर्वे धूर्वन्तु ब्रह्म वर्म ममान्तरं शर्म वर्म ममान्तरं ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah svo'rano yashcha nishtyo jighamsati |
devastam sarve dhurvantu brahma varma mamantaram sharma varma mamantaram ||
verses.en: Whoso would kill us, whether he be a stranger foe or one of us, May all the Gods discomfit him! My nearest, closest mail is prayer, my closest armour and defence.

verses.sa:
मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्था परस्याः ।
सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रूं ताढि वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
verses.rom:
mrigo na bhimah kucharo girishthah paravata a jagantha parasyah |
srikam samshaya pavimindra tigmam vi shatrum tadhi vi mridho nudasva ||
verses.en: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us!

verses.sa:
भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः ।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवां सस्तनूभिर्व्यशेमहि देवहितं यदायुः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram karnebhih shrinuyama deva bhadram pashyemakshabhiryajatrah |
sthirairangaistushtuvam sastanubhirvyashemahi devahitam yadayuh ||
verses.en: Gods, may our ears hear that which is auspicious, may our eyes see that which is good, ye holy! Extolling you with still strong limbs and bodies, may we attain the age by Gods appointed!

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः ।
स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु ॥
ॐ स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
svasti na indro vriddhashravah svasti nah pusha vishvavedah |
svasti nastarkshyo arishtanemih svasti no brihaspatirdadhatu ||
om svasti no brihaspatirdadhatu ||
verses.en: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra bless us, may Pushan bless us, master of all riches! May Tarkshya with uninjured fellies bless us! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour!
